ᵛjanmanjanman sarveṣu manutpeṣu ᵛnihitaḥ ᵛjātavedāḥ ᵛviśvāmitrebhiḥ viśvāmitraiḥ |
maharṣiṇā viśvāmitreṇa yo jātavedāḥ ᵛajasaḥ ajasramanavaratam ᵛidhyate dīpyate |
ᵛsumatau vartamānaḥ ᵛvayaṃ ᵛtasya ᵛyajñiyasya yajñārhasya agneḥ ᵛbhadre bhajanīye ᵛsaumanase sumanobhāve anugraha- buddhau ᵛapi ᵛsyāma api bhavema |
imaṃ ya॒jñaṃ sa̭hasāvan tvaṃ nau de॒vatrā̭ dhehi su॒kṛto̭ ra॒rāṇaḥ |
pra ya̭ṃsi ho॒tṛbhya̭tīri॒po na 'o'gne mahi dravi̭ṇamā yajasva ||
imam | ya॒jñam | sa̭hasā'van | tvam | naḥ | de॒va'trā̭ | dhehi | su॒kṛtaḥ iti su'kṛtaḥ | ra॒rāṇaḥ | pra | ya̭ṃsi | ho॒tṛḥ | ba॒hatīḥ | i॒rṣaḥ | naḥ | a॒gne | mahi̭ | dravi̭ṇam | ā | ya॒jasva || 22 ||
he sahasāvan sahasvan balavan sukṛto śobhanakarman he ame rarāṇa: sarvadā ramamāṇa: śabdaṃ kurvāṇo vā tvaṃ na: asmadīyam imaṃ yajñaṃ devatrā deveṣu dhehi nidhehi |
he hota: devānā- māhvāta: bṛhatī: mahatī: drupa: ajñāni na: asmabhyaṃ pra yaṃsi prayaccha |
he ame mahi mahan draviṇaṃ paśvādilakṣaṇaṃ dhanaṃ ā yajasva prayaccha |

iḻāmagre purudaṃsaṃ saniṃ go: śaśvattamaṃ havamānāya sādha | syānna: sunustanayo vijāvāgre sā tai sumatirbhūtvasme || 23 || iḻām | agre | puru'daṃsam | sanim | go: | śaśvat'tamam | havamānāya | sādha | syāt | na: | sunu: | tanaya: | vijā'vā | agre | sā | te | sumati: | bhūtu | asme iti ||23||
iyaṃ marveṣāṃ paśnāṃ paśupuroḍāśasya sviṣṭakṛta: puronuvākyā |
sūyate hi-' iḻāmagre purudaṃsaṃ saniṃ gorhaṃtā yakṣadagni puroḍāśasya svadasva havyā samidho didīhīti puroḍāśasviṣṭakṛta: ' (āśva. śrau. 3. 5) iti ||
he ame purudaṃsaṃ bahukarmāṇaṃ go: gavāṃ saniṃ pradātrīm iḻāṃ bhūmiṃ havamānāya stuvate mahyaṃ śaśvattamaṃ cirakālaṃ yathā bhavati tathā sādha sādhaya |
na: asmākaṃ sūnu: putra: tanaya: maṃtanasya vistārayitā vijāvā putrapautrādirūpeṇa svayaṃ vijāyata iti vijāvā syāt |
he ame mā prasiddhā te sumati: svadīyānugrahabuddhi: asme asmāsu bhūtu bhavatu ||
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—' vaiśvānarāya pajjonā vaiśvānarīyaṃ tu jāgataṃ tu ' iti |
pṛṣṭhābhipṛvikayo- stutīye'hanyāgnimārute ' vaiśvānarāya dhipaṇām ' iti vaiśvānaranividdhānīyaṃ sūktam |
' tṛtīyāsya ' iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ—' vaiśvānarāya dhipaṇāṃ dhārāvarā maruta: ' (āśva. śrau. 7. 7) iti ||

vaiśvānarāya dhipaṇāmṛtāvṛdhe ghṛtaṃ na pūtamagre janāmāsi | dvitā hotāraṃ manuṣaśca vāghato dhiyā rathaṃ na kuliśa: samaṇvati || 1 || vaiśvānarāya | dhipaṇām | ṛta'vṛdhe | ghṛtam | na | pūtam | agre | janāmāsi | dvitā | hotāram | manuṣa: | ca | vāghata: | dhiyā | ratham | na | kuliśa: | sam | ṛṇvati ||1||
ṛtāvṛdhe ṛtasyodakasya yajñasya vā vardhayitre vaiśvānarāya |
vaiśvānaraśabdo yāskena vyākhyāta:— ' vaiśvānara: kasmādvaiśvānarajayati viśva enaṃ narā nayantīti vā |
api vā viśvānara eva syāt pratyuta: sarvāṇi bhūtāni tasya vaiśvānarastasyaiṣā bhavati ' (niru. 7. 21) iti |
tasmai ame pūtaṃ ghṛtaṃ na ghṛtamiva dhipaṇāṃ stutiṃ janāmāsi janayāma: |
yathā ghṛtaṃ prītiṃ janayati tathā prītiṃ karomi

ᵥdvitā dvidhā gārhapatyāhavanīyarūpābhyāṃ yuktaṃ ᵥhotāraṃ devānāmāhvātāramagniṃ ᵥmanuṣaḥ manuṣyāḥ ᵥvāvataḥ ᵥca ṛtvijaśca ᵥdhiyā karmaṇā ᵥkuliśaḥ vāsyādiḥ ᵥrathaṃ ᵥna rathamiva ᵥsamaṇvati saṃskurvanti ||
sa raucayajjanuṣā rodasī ubhe sa mātrorabhavatputra īḍyaḥ |
saḥ | rocayat | januṣā | rodasī iti | ubhe iti | saḥ | mātroḥ | abhavat | putraḥ | īḍyaḥ | havya'vāṭ | agniḥ | ajaraḥ | carnaḥ'hitaḥ | duḥ'dabhaḥ | viśām | atithiḥ | vibhāvasuḥ ||2||
ᵥsaḥ agniḥ ᵥjanuṣā janmanā ᵥubhe ᵥrodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau ᵥrocayat arocayat prakāśayati |
ᵥsa ᵥmātroḥ dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ ᵥīḍyaḥ stutyaḥ ᵥputraḥ ᵥabhavat |
ᵥhavyavāṭ havyānāṃ voḍhā ᵥagniḥ aṅgādiguṇayuktaḥ ᵥajaraḥ jarārahitaḥ |
ᵥcano'dhaṃ hitaṃ yajamāne nihitaṃ yenāsau ᵥcanohitaḥ ᵥdūlabhaḥ hiṃsitumaśakyaḥ |
ᵥso'yaṃ ᵥvibhāvasuḥ prabhādhanaḥ ᵥviśāṃ manuṣyāṇām ᵥatithiḥ iva pūjyo bhavati ||
kratvā dakṣasya taruṣā vidharmaṇi devāsoṃ agniṃ janayanta cittibhiḥ |
rurucānaṃ bhānunā jyotiṣā mahāmatyaṃ na vājaṃ saniṣyannupa bruve ||
kratvā | dakṣasya | taruṣā | vi'dharmaṇi | devāsaḥ | agnim | janayanta | citti'bhiḥ | rurucānam | bhānunā | jyotiṣā | mahām | atyam | na | vājam | saniṣyan | upa | bruve ||3||
ᵥcittibhiḥ jñānairupalakṣitāḥ ᵥdevāsaḥ devāḥ ᵥtaruṣā vyasanebhyastārakasya ᵥdakṣasya balasya ᵥkratvā karmaṇā ᵥvidharmaṇi vidhārake yajñe ᵥagniṃ janayanta ajanayan |
ᵥbhānunā bhāsamānena ᵥjyotiṣā ᵥrurucānaṃ rocamānaṃ ᵥmahāṃ mahāntamagnim ᵥatyaṃ ᵥna bhārasahamaśvamiva ᵥvājam annaṃ ᵥsaniṣyan lipsamāno'ham ᵥupa ᵥbruve staumi ||
ā mandrasya saniṣyanto vareṇyaṃ vṛṇīmahe ahyaṃ vājamṛmiyam |
rātri bhṛgūṇāmuśijaṃ kavikratumagniṃ rājantaṃ divyena śociṣā ||
ā | mandrasya | saniṣyantaḥ | vareṇyam | vṛṇīmahe | ahyam | vājam | ṛmiyam | rātrim | bhṛgūṇām | uśijam | kavi'kratum | agnim | rājantam | divyena | śociṣā ||4||
ᵥmandrasya stutyasya vaiśvānarasya saṃbandhin ᵥvareṇyaṃ varaṇīyam ᵥahyam aljāvaham ᵥṛmiyaṃ praśasyaṃ ᵥvājam annaṃ ᵥsaniṣyantaḥ lipsamānā vayaṃ ᵥbhṛgūṇām ṛṣīṇāṃ ᵥrātrim abhilapitārthapradātāram
ᵥuśijam abhilaṣyantaṃ ᵥkavikratuṃ krāntaprajñaṃ ᵥdivyena divibhavena ᵥśociṣā rociṣā ᵥrājantaṃ ājamānam ᵥagnim ᵥā ᵥvṛṇīmahe saṃbhajāmahe ||
agniṃ sumnāya dadhire puro janā vājaśravasamiha vṛktabarhiṣaḥ |
yatasrucaḥ surucaṃ viśvadevyaṃ rudraṃ yajñānāṃ sādhadaṣṭimupasām ||
agnim | sumnāya | dadhire | puraḥ | janāḥ | vājaśravasam | iha | vṛkta'barhiṣaḥ | yata'srucaḥ | su'rucam | viśva'devyam | rudram | yajñānām | sādhat'iṣṭim | apasām ||5||
ᵥvṛktabarhipaḥ stīrṇabarhipaḥ ᵥyatasrucaḥ prāptasruca ṛtvijaḥ ᵥsumnāya sukhārthaṃ ᵥvājaśravasamanuṣyebhyaḥ preritānnaṃ ᵥsurucaṃ praśastadīptimantaṃ ᵥ
aśva iva kavi: krānta: sarvatra vyāsa: canohita: nihitānna: sa: ayamagni: vājasātaye vājasya annasya kīrtarvā sātaye lābhāya pari ṇīyate yajñārthaṃ nīyate ||
namasyata | havya'dātim | su'adhvaram | duvasyata | damyam | jāta'vedasam | rathī: | ṛtasya | bṛhata: | vi'carṣaṇi: | agni: | devānām | abhavat | pura:'hita: ||8||

rathī: netā bṛhata: mahata: ṛtasya yajñasya vicarṣaṇi: draṣṭā ya: agni: devānāṃ purohita: purastāt draṣṭavyatayā sthāpita: abhavat havyadātiṃ devebhyo haviṣāṃ dātāraṃ svadhvaraṃ śobhanayajñaṃ damyaṃ damebhyo gṛhebhyo hitaṃ jātavedasaṃ jātaprajñaṃ tamagniṃ namasyata pūjayata duvasyata paricarata ||
tāsāmekāmadadhumartye bhujamu lokamu dve upa jāmimīyatu: ||
tisra: | yahasya | sam'idha: | pari'jamana: | agne: | apunan | uśija: | amartyava: | tāsām | ekāṃ | adadhu: | martye | bhujam | ū~ iti | lokam | ū~ iti | dve iti | upa | jāmim | īyatu: || 9 ||
uśija: kāmayamānā: amartyava: martyarahitā devā: yahasya mahata: parijamana: parito gantu: samidha: samindhikā: prakāśikā: tisra: pārthivavaidyutasūryasvarūpāstisrastanu: apunan aśodhayan |
te devā: bhujaṃ sarveṣāṃ pālayitrīṃ tāsāṃ tanūnāṃ madhye ekāṃ pārthivīṃ tanuṃ martye martyaloke adadhu: nyadadhu: |
itare dve tanū jāmiṃ lokam āsannantarikṣam upa īyatu: gacchata: |
athavā tisra: samidha āghārasamidhau dve anūyājasamidhaṃketi |
tāsāṃ samidhābhekāmanūyājasamidhaṃ martye iha loke bhogahetumandyājaparyanta madadhu: dhārayanti |
'prajā vā anūyājā: ' iti prajāvainānūyājānāṃ saṃstavāt tadāśrayatvāccānūyājasamidha: |
itare dve samidhā- vantarikṣe divyabho hetu upeyatu: upagacchata: |
viśāṃ kaviṃ viśapatiṃ mānuṣīripa: saṃ sīṃkruṇvantasvadhitiṃ na tejase |
sa uddhatau nivatau yāti vervipatsa garbheṣu bhuvaneṣu dīdharat ||
viśām | kavim | viśapatim | mānuṣī: | ipa: | sam | sīm | akuṇvan | sva'dhitim | na | tejase | sa: | ut'vata: | ni'vata: | yāti | vervipat | sa: | garbheṣu | bhuvaneṣu | dīdharat ||10||

'ipa: paścādilakṣaṇaṃ dhanamicchantya: 'mānupī: manuṣyaprajā: 'viśāṃ prajānāṃ 'vispatiṃ prabhuṃ 'kaviṃ medhāvinaṃ 'sīmaṃ enaṃ 'svadhivitaṃ 'na asimava 'tejase taikṣṇyārthaṃ 'sam 'akṛṇvan samastakurvan |
'sa: agni: 'udgata: uccchāyavata: 1 'nivata: nīcairbhāvataśca pradeśān 'cevipat vyāpnuvan 'yāti gacchati |

sa jinvate jaṭhareṣu prajāñjinvānvāṃ citreṣu nānadan miṃha: | vaiśvānara: pṛthupājā amartyo vasu ratnā daryamāno tri dāśuṣe || 11 || sa: | jinvate | jaṭhareṣu | prajāñjinvān | vṛpā | citreṣu | nānadat | na | siṃha: | vaiśvānara: | pṛthu'pājā: | amartya: | vasu | ratnā | daryamāna: | vi | dāśuṣe || 11 ||
citreṣu nānāvidheṣvaraṇyeṣu 'nānadat atyarthaṃ śabdaṃ kurvan 'siṃha: 'na siṃha iva |
'amartya: maraṇadharmarahita: 'dāśuṣe haviṣāṃ pradātre yajamānāya 'ratnā ramaṇīyāni 'vasu vasūni dhanāni 'vi viśeṣeṇa 'dayamāna: prayacchan ||

vaiśvānara: pratnathā nākumāruhadivaspṛṣṭhaṃ bhandamāna: sumanmabhi: | sa pūrvavajjanayañjanatve dhanaṃ samānamajaṃ paryauti jāgṛvi: || 12 || vaiśvānara: | pratna'thā | nākam | ā | aruhat | diva: | pṛṣṭham | bhandamāna: | sumanma'bhi: | sa: | pūrva'vat | janayan | jantave | dhanam | samānam | ajam | pari | eti | jāgṛvi: || 12 ||
'sumanmabhi: stotṛbhi: 'bhandamāna: stūyamāna: 'vaiśvānara: jātamātra eva 'pratnathā pratna iva cirantana iva 'nākam |

'sa: vaiśvānara: 'pūrvavat pūrvebhya: ṛṣibhya iva 'jantave stotre yajamānāya 'dhanaṃ paścādilakṣaṇaṃ 'janayan saṃpādayan 'jāgṛvi: sadā prabuddha: 'samānaṃ sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ sādhāraṇam 'ajam ākāśamārgaṃ 'paryaiti sūryarūpeṇa gacchati ||

ṛtāvānaṃ yajñiyaṃ vipramukhyaṃ māṃ dudhe māturiśvā divi kṣayam | taṃ citrayāṃ hariṃkeśamīmahe sudītimimaṃ suvitāya narvyase || 13 || ṛta'vānam | yajñiyam | vipram | ukthyam | ā | yam | dudhe | māturiśvā | divi | kṣayam | tam | citra'yāmam | hari'keśam | īmahe | su'dītim | agnim | suvitāya | narvyase || 13 ||
^ṛtāvānaṃ balavantaṃ ^yajñiyaṃ yajñāṃ ^vipraṃ medhāvinam ^ukthyaṃ stutyaṃ ^divi dyuloke ^kṣayaṃ nivasantaṃ ^yam agniṃ ^mātariśvā vāyurdyulokādāhṛtya pṛthivyām ^ā ^dadhe āhitavān |
^citrayaṃ nānāvidhagamanaṃ ^harikeśaṃ piṅgalācipaṃ ^sudītaṃ śobhanadīptiṃ ^tam ^agniṃ ^nadhyase navatarāya ^suvitāya suṣṭhu prāptavyāya dhanāya tadartham ^īmahe yācāmahe ||

śuciṃ na yārmanviṣpiṃ svarhaśaṃ ketuṃ divo raucanasthāṃmuparbudham | agniṃ mūrdhānaṃ divo apratiṣkṛtaṃ tamīmahe narmasā vājinaṃ bṛhat || 14 || śucim | na | yārman | iṣpim | svaḥ'dṛśam | ketum | divaḥ | rocana'sthām | upaḥ'budham | agnim | mūrdhānam | divaḥ | aprati'skṛtam | tam | īmahe | narmasā | vājinam | bṛhat || 14||
^śuciṃ dīptaṃ ^yāmana yāmani yajñe ^iṣpim eṣaṇīyaṃ ^svarhaśaṃ sarvadṛśaṃ sarvapadārthavijñānayuktaṃ ^divaḥ dyulokasya ^ketuṃ prajñāpakaṃ ^rocanasthāṃ rocanastham |

^uparbudham agnihotrarūpeṇa ^upasi prabudhyamānaṃ ^divaḥ svargasya ^mūrdhānaṃ pradhānam ^apra- tiṣkṛtam apratihataśabdaṃ ^vājinam annavantaṃ ^bṛhat mahāntaṃ ^tam ^agniṃ ^namasā stotreṇa ^īmahe yācāmahe ||

mandraṃ hotāraṃ śucimdvayāvinaṃ dmūnasamukthyaṃ viśvarṣaṇim | rathaṃ na citraṃ vapuṣāya darśataṃ manurhitaṃ sadamidrāya īmahe || 15 || mandram | hotāram | śucim | advayāvinam | dmūnasam | ukthyam | viśva'rṣaṇim | ratham | na | citram | vapuṣāya | darśatama | manuḥ'hitam | sadam | it | rāyaḥ | īmahe ||15||

^mandraṃ stutyaṃ ^hotāraṃ devānāmāhvātāraṃ ^śuciṃ sarvadā śuddham ^advayāvinaṃ dvayahīnam^2 akuṭilaṃ ^dmūnasaṃ dānamanasam ^ukthyaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ ^viśvarṣaṇiṃ viśvasya draṣṭāraṃ ^citraṃ nānāvidhavarṇaṃ ^rathaṃ ^na rathamiva ^vapuṣāya rūpārthaṃ ^darśataṃ darśanīyaṃ ^sadamit sadaiva ^manurhitaṃ sarvebhyo manuṣyebhyo hitaṃ tamagni ^rāyaḥ dhanāni ^īmahe yācāmahe |
pūrvamukte ‘ vaiśvānarīya tu jāgataṃ tu ’ ityuktvātsyāpi sūktasya jagatī chando vaiśvānaro'gnirdevatā |
sūyate ^hi - ‘ vaiśvānarāya pṛthupājase śaṃ naḥ karayavate ’ ( āśva. śrau. 5. 20 ) iti ||

vaiśvānarāya pṛthupārjase vipo ratnā vidhanta dhuruṇeṣu gātave | agniṃ devā~ amṛtau duvasyathā dharmāṇi sanatā na dūduṣat || 1 || vaiśvānarāya | pṛthupārjase | vipaḥ | ratnā | vidhanta | dhuruṇeṣu | gātave | agniḥ | hi | devān | amṛtaḥ | duvasyati | artha | dharmāṇi | sanatā | na | dūduṣat || 1 || pavipaḥ medhāvinaḥ stotāraḥ papṛthupārjase bahuprajñāya vahnāya vā | pājaḥśabdasya balānnārthāḥ pāṭhāt | pavaiśvānarāya agnaye padhuruṇeṣu dharmeṣu yajñeṣu paratnā ramaṇīyāni stotrāṇi pagātave sanmārga- lābhāya pavidhanta paricaranti kurvanti | paamṛtaḥ maraṇarahitaḥ paagniḥ padevān paduvasyati haviṣāṃ pradānena paricarati | hiḥ prasiddhā | paatha ataḥ kāraṇāt ko'pi pasanatā sanātanāni padharmāṇi yajñān pa na padūduṣat na dūṣayati ||

antardūtau rodasī dasma īyate hotā niṣatto manuṣaḥ purohitaḥ | kṣayaṃ bṛhantaṃ pari bhūṣati yubhirdevairbhiragiririṣito dhiyāvasuḥ || 2 || antaḥ | dūtaḥ | rodasī iti | dasmaḥ | īyate | hotā | ni'sattaḥ | manuṣaḥ | puraḥ'hitaḥ | kṣayam | bṛhantam | pari | bhūṣati | yubhiḥ | devaiḥ | agniḥ | iṣitaḥ | dhiyā'vasuḥ ||2|| padasmaḥ darśanīyaḥ pahotā agniḥ padūtaḥ devānāṃ dūtaḥ san parodasī rodasyorvāpṛthivyoḥ paantaḥ madhye paīyate gacchati | pamanuṣaḥ manojātasya manuṣyasya papurohitaḥ āhavanīyādirūpeṇa purataḥ sthāpitaḥ paniṣattaḥ niṣaṇṇaḥ san paagniḥ padyubhiḥ dīptibhiḥ pabṛhantaṃ mahāntaṃ pakṣayaṃ yajñagṛhaṃ pari pabhūṣati alaṃkurute | padevebhiḥ devaiḥ paiṣitaḥ preritaḥ padhiyāvasuḥ prajñā' vyākhyātaḥ | ete dve agniviśeṣaṇe ||

ketuṃ yajñānāṃ vidathasya sādhanaṃ viprāso agniṃ mahayanta cittibhiḥ | apāṃsi yasminnadhi saṃdadhurgirastasminsumnāni yajamāna ā cake || 3 || ketum | yajñānām | vidathasya | sādhanam | viprāsaḥ | agnim | mahayanta | citti'bhiḥ | apāṃsi | yasmin | adhi | sam'dadhuḥ | giraḥ | tasmin | sumnāni | yajamānaḥ | ā | cake ||3|| payajñānāṃ paketuṃ prajñāpakaṃ pavidathasya yajñasya gṛhasya vā pasādhanaṃ prāptisādhanamasādhāraṇa- kāraṇaṃ santamapaagniṃ paviprāsaḥ viprāḥ pacittibhiḥ svakarmabhiḥ pamahayanta pūjayanti | kiṃca pagiraḥ stotāraḥ payasmin agnau paapāṃsi svānuṣṭheyāni karmāṇi paadhi pasaṃdadhuḥ saṃdadhate payajamānaḥ patasmin agnau pasumnāni sukhāni2 vā paā pacake kāmayate ||

sūtritaṃ ca- 'samidhyamāno adhvare samiddho agna āhuteti dve' (āśva. śrau. 1.2) iti |

'pṛthupājā amartya iti ṣaṭ dhāryāḥ sāmidhenām' (āśva. śrau. 8.6) iti sūtritam |

ādi- tyājjāyate vṛṣṭiryairannaṃ tataḥ prajāḥ ' (manu. 3. 76) iti |
'dīryāta dīvyamānaṃ 'bṛhat ata eva mahāntaṃ tvā 'tvām agniṃ 'samidhīmahi samyagdīpayāmaḥ |

'agne jupasva ' iti ṣaṭkaṃ ṣoḍaśa sūktaṃ vaiśvāmitramāgneyam |
tṛtīyā tuṣṇip caturthī triṣṭup pañcamī jagatī |
'agne jupasva ' iti savanīyapuroḍāśe sviṣṭakṛtaḥ prātaḥsava- nīyānuvākyā |
sūtritaṃ ca-'atha sviṣṭakṛto'gne jupasva no haviḥ ' (āśva. śrau. 5. 4) iti |
atirātre āśvinaśastre parihite sati camasagaṇaiḥ sahāśvinordvikapālaḥ puroḍāśaḥ sarvahuto hotavyaḥ |
yadi puroḍāśamavaśeṣya sviṣṭakṛtaṃ kuryāstasya sviṣṭakṛtaḥ ' puroḻā agne ' ityeṣā yājyā |
'yadyetasya puroḍāśasya sviṣṭakṛtā careyuḥ puroḻā agne pacataḥ ' (ādha. śrau 6. 5) iti sūtritam |

uta | abhaye | puruhūta | śravaḥ'bhiḥ | ekaḥ | dṛḻaham | avadaḥ | vṛtrahā | san | ime iti | cit | indra | rodasī iti | apāre iti | yat | sam'gṛbhṇāḥ | maghavan | kāśiḥ | it | te || 5 ||
'ekaḥ asahāyastvaṃ 'vṛtrahā vṛtrahantā 'san 'abhaye asurebhyaḥ sakāśānmā bibhīteti devān prati yadvākyam 'avadaḥ avocastadvākyaṃ 'dṛḍhaṃ satyameva |

sargācchandasi dhāvarthe ' iti vatiḥ' | pratyayasvaraḥ | pramṛṇan | 'mṛṇa hiṃsāyām' | jahi | 'hana hiṃsāgatyoḥ' | ityasya loṭi sipo hirādeśaḥ | tasmin 'hanterjaḥ' iti jādeśaḥ | 'ato heḥ' iti luki prāpte ābhācchāstrasyāsiddhatvātnivṛttiḥ | herhitvādanudāttaḥ | pratīccaḥ | 'acca gatipūjanayoḥ' | 'accchandasyasarvanāmasthānam' iti vibhakterudāttatvam | parācaḥ | 'aniganto'nnatau vapratyaye' iti gateḥ prakṛtisvaratvam | kṛṇuhi | 'kṛvi hiṃsākaraṇayoḥ' | astu | 'ama bhuvi' ||
yasmai dhāyuradhā matryābhaktaṃ cidbhajate gehaṃ saḥ |
bhadrā te indra sumatirghṛtācī sahasradānā puruhūta rātiḥ ||
yasmai | dhāyuḥ | ardhāḥ | matryāya | abhaktam | cit | bhajate | geham | saḥ | bhadrā | te | indra | sumatiḥ | ghṛtācī | sahasradānā | puruhūta | rātiḥ || 7 ||
he indra dhāyuḥ nirantaramaiśvaryaṃ dadhānastvaṃ yasmai matryāya manuṣyāya ardhāḥ yadīyaṃ dadhāsi maḥ matryaḥ abhaktaṃ cit pūrvamaprāptamapi gehaṃ gṛheṣu bhavaṃ kanakapaśvādi kaṃ bhajate prāpnoti |
tathā ca somājya- puroḍāśādilakṣaṇaṃ haviratti prāpnotīti ghṛtācī |
te tava sumatiḥ śobhanā buddhiḥ bhadrā kalyāṇakarī |
tathā tava rātiḥ dānaśaktiḥ sahasradānā aparimitadhanadānasametā |
indrasya bahudātṛtve mantravarṇaḥ—' bhūridā bhūri dehi no mā dabhraṃ bhūrī bhara ' (ṛ. saṃ. 4. 32. 20) iti ||
gehaśabdāt 'tatra bhavaḥ' ityarthe 'bhave chandasi' iti yan |
abhi vṛtraṃ vardhamānaṃ piyārumapādamindra tuvasā jaghantha ||
sahadāṃnu | puruhūta | śiyantam | ahastam | indra | sam | piṇak | kuṇāram | abhi | vṛtram | vardhamānam | piyārum | apādam | indra | tuvasā | jaghantha || 8 ||
dānuḥ dānavī vṛtramātā tayā saha vartamānam |
tathā ca mantravarṇaḥ—' dānuḥ śaye sahavatsā ' (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 32. 9) iti |

1. ta-la-vatipratyayaḥ | 2. kha-ga-ca-ja-ṇa-pa-pha-bha-sa-parasmai | 3. ta-nidadhāsi | 4. kha-ga-gha- ca-ja-ṇa-bha-sa-kanakapaśvādikam | 5. kha-ga-ca-ja-ṇa-' tathā ' nāsti | 6. kha-ga-ca-dhanaśaktiḥ | 7. kha-ga-gha-ca-ja-ṇa-bha-' dānuḥ ' nāsti |

saha vartata iti sahadānuḥ | taṃ 'kṣiyantaṃ bādhamānaṃ 'kuṇāhaṃ kkaṇaśīlaṃ kaṃcidasuram 'aharataṃ hastahīnaṃ kṛtvā 'saṃ 'piṇak samyak cūrṇīkuru | kiṃca he 'indra 'vardhamānaṃ sarvata iṣumātraṃ vardhamānam | ‘ sa iṣu- mātramiṣumātraṃ viśvaḍḍhavadhata ’ (tai.saṃ. 2.4. 12. 2) iti śruteḥ | 'piyāruṃ hiṃsaṃ 'vṛtraṃ vṛtrāsuram 'apādaṃ pādahīnaṃ kṛtvā 'tavasā balena 'abhi 'jaghantha hatavānasi | yadvā sahadānumudakadānopetaṃ kṣiyantamākāśe nivasantaṃ kuṇahaṃ garjantaṃ vṛtram | vṛṇotyācchādayati nabha iti vṛtro meghaḥ | tamimaṃ vardhamānaṃ meghaṃ hastapādaśūnyaṃ kṛtvā saṃpiṇhū saṃpiṇḍa | tathā ca yāskaḥ— ‘ ahastamindra kṛtvā saṃpiṇḍa parikraṇanaṃ megham ’ (niru. 6. 1) iti || sahadānum | ‘ do avakhaṇḍane ’ | ‘ dābhyāṃ nuḥ ’ iti nupratyayaḥ | catīti dānurdānam | bahuvrīhau pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ | kṣiyantam | ‘ kṣi nivāsagatyoḥ ’ | tudāditvācchaḥ | pratyayasvaraḥ | piṇak | ‘ piñ sañcūrṇe ’ | rudhāditvāt bham | helek | pakārasya kakāraśchāndasaḥ | kuṇaham | ‘ kuṇa śabde ’ | bāhulakādūpasiddhiḥ | ādyudāttaḥ | jaghantha | ‘ hana hiṃsāgatyoḥ ’ ityasya liṭi thali rūpam | ‘ abhyāsācca ’ iti dhātuhakārasya ghatvam | nighātaḥ | ‘ upadeśe'cvataḥ ’ itītpratiṣedhaḥ ||
ni sāmanāmiśirāmindra bhūrmiṃ mahīmapārāṃ sardane sasattha |
ni | sāmanāma | iṣirām | indra | bhūrmim | mahīm | apārām | sardane | sasattha | astabhnāt | dyām | vṛṣabhaḥ | antarikṣam | arpant | āpaḥ | tvayā | iha | pra'sṛtāḥ ||9||
he 'indra 'mahīṃ mahītana eva 'apārām 'iṣirāṃ sthānābhāvena calantīm evaṃvidhāṃ 'bhūmiṃ 'sāmanāṃ 'samānām |
tathā ca mantravarṇaḥ— ‘ gāvau te sāmanāvitaḥ ’ (ṛ. saṃ. 10. 85. 11) iti |
tathā ca śatapathe śrūyate— ‘ yadeva samaḥ ’lupiṇā samo maśakena samo nāgena sama 'etaistribhilokaistasmādeva sāma ’ (śa. brā. 14. 4. 1) iti |
tathā 'vṛṣabhaḥ abhimata- phalānāṃ varṣaka indraḥ 'dyāṃ dyulokam 'astabhnāt yathā na patati tathā dhārayat |
evaṃ dyāvāpṛthivyoravasthitau satyāṃ 'tvayā 'prasṛtāḥ meghabhedena preritāḥ 'āpaḥ 'iha bhūmau 'arpantu āgacchantu |
tathā ca mantravarṇaḥ— ‘ yaḥ pṛthivīṃ vyathamānāmahaṃta ’ (ṛ. saṃ. 2. 12. 2) iti ||
‘ ṣaṭ viśaraṇagatyavasādaneṣu ’ ityasyāntarbhāvitaṇyaryasya liṭi dhali ‘ upadeśe'cvataḥ ’ itītpratiṣedhaḥ |

arṣenu | 'ṛpī gatau' | vyatyayena śap-pratyayaḥ | guṇaḥ | pādāditvādanighātaḥ | āpaḥ | 'āplu vyāptau' | kip dhātorhrasvaśca | jasi 'apnunttuc' ityādinā dīrghaḥ | jasaḥ suhavādanudāttatve dhātusvaraḥ | prasūtāḥ | 'pṛ preraṇe' ityasya karmaṇi niṣṭhā | 'gatiranantaraḥ' iti gateḥ prakṛtisvaratvam ||
alātṛṇo vula indra vrajo goḥ purā hantorbhayamāno vyāra |
sugānpatho akṛṇonni raje gāḥ prāvanvāṇīḥ puruhūtaṃ dharmantīḥ ||
alātṛṇaḥ | vulaḥ | indraḥ | vrajaḥ | goḥ | purā | hantaḥ | bhayamānaḥ | vi | āra | sugān | pathaḥ | akṛṇot | niḥ | anai | gāḥ | pra | āvan | vāṇīḥ | puru'hūtam | dharmantīḥ || 10 ||

ha indra alātṛṇaḥ | bahudakatayā alamarthyamānucyate hiṃsyata ityalātṛṇaḥ | goḥ : mādhyamikāyāḥ vācaḥ vrajaḥ : goṣṭhabhūtaḥ valaḥ | vṛṇotyākāśamiti valo meghaḥ | puga hantoḥ tava vajraprahārāt prāk bhayamānaḥ bibhyan vyāra viṣṭo babhūva | anantaraṃ sa indraḥ gāḥ apaḥ niraje nirgamayituṃ sugān sugamān pathaḥ mārgān akṛṇot akarot | ataḥ vāṇīḥ vananīyāḥ dharmantīḥ śabdayamānāstā āpaḥ puruhūtaṃ bahubhirāhūtaṃ pārthivamudakaṃ prati prāvan abhyāgacchan | etāmṛcaṃ yāska evaṃ vyākhyat— 'alātṛṇo vala indra vrajo goḥ | alātṛṇo'lamātardnā megho valo vṛṇotervājāṃ vrajaḥ yantarikṣaṃ goratasyā mādhyamikāyā vācaḥ purā hanādvayamānāṃ vyāra suganpatho akṛṇonni raje gāḥ | sugamānpatho'karonnirgamanāya gavām | prāvanvāṇīḥ puruhūtaṃ dharmantīḥ | āpo vā vahanādvāco vā vadanādbahubhirgṛhyatamudakaṃ bhavati | dharmatirgatikarmā' (niru. 6. 2.) || alātṛṇaḥ | 'tṛhi hiṃsāyām' | alaṃpūrvāt tṛheḥ 'ghañarthe kavidhānam' iti karmaṇi kapratyayaḥ | alamo makārasyākāraḥ | samāsasvaraḥ | valaḥ | 'vala saṃvaraṇe' | vahana ācchādyane namo'neneti valo meghaḥ | 'puṃsi saṃjñāyām' iti ghaḥ | pratyayasvaraḥ | vrajaḥ | 'vraja gatau' | 'gocarasaṃcara' (pā0 sū. 3.3.119) ityādinā ghapratyayāntatvena nipātanāt kutvābhāvaḥ | vrajastvantarikṣa iti | pratyayasvaraḥ | bhayamānaḥ | 'tribhī bhaye' | vyatyayena śap | āra | 'ṛ gatau' ityasya liṭi gali rūpam | nighātaḥ | sugān | 'gamlū gatau' ityasmādadhikaraṇe 'suduro- radhikaraṇe' iti ḍapratyayaḥ | dvitvāṭṭilopaḥ | kṛtsvaraḥ | niraje | 'aja gatikṣepaṇayoḥ' ityasmān saṃpadādilakṣaṇāṃ bhāve kip | kṛduttarasvaraḥ | āvan | ava rakṣaṇagatyādiṣu ityasya laṅi rūpam | puruhūtam | hayaterniṣṭhāyāṃ yajāditvāt saṃprasāraṇam | 'halaḥ' iti dīrghaḥ | dhātādisvaraḥ | dharmantīḥ | 'dhamā śabde' | śapi 'pāghrā' ityādinā dhamādeśaḥ | 'vā chandasi' iti jamaḥ savarṇadīrghaḥ | śatu- rsārbadhātukasvare kṛte dhātusvaraḥ || || 2 ||
1. ta- 'samāsasvaraḥ' nāsti | 2. kha-ga-ca-ja-ṇa-jha-sa-tamo'neneti | 3. ta-kṛtsvaraḥ | akṛṇot | kṛvi hiṃsākaraṇayoḥ ityasya laṭi (laṅi) rūpam |
eko dve vasumatī samīcī indra ā parprā pṛthivīmuta dyām |
utāntarikṣādabhi naḥ samīka iṣo rathīḥ sayurjaḥ śūra vājān ||

ekaḥ | dve iti | vasumatī iti vasu'matī | samīcī iti sam'īcī | indraḥ | ā | parprā | pṛthivīm | uta | dyām | uta | antarikṣāt | abhi | naḥ | sam'īke | iṣaḥ | rathīḥ | sa'yurjaḥ | śūra | vājān || 11 ||
yo'yam indraḥ ekaḥ asahāya eva san pṛthivīm uta api ca dyāṃ dve ete dyāvāpṛthivyau samīcī parasparaṃ saṃgate vasumatī dhanayukte sadyau ā parprā samantāt pūrayāmāsa |
uta api ca he śūra sāmarthyaupaṃta tādṛśastvaṃ rathīḥ rathavān saḥ naḥ asmākaṃ samīkaṃ samīpe iṣaḥ syātumicchan sayujaḥ saṃgatān vājān vajanti gacchantīti vājā aśvāḥ |
tān śrān antarikṣāt antarikṣakāśāt abhi preraya |

‘mīnāternigama’ iti hrasvaḥ | ‘haryaścaprasūtāḥ’ | ‘turīyā kaḥ ṇi’ iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | ānaṭ | ‘aśva vyāptau’ ityasya ‘bahula̭ chandasi’ iti laḍaḥ pluḥ | ‘abhoteśca’ iti nuḍāgamaḥ | vastrādinā patvam | yaccogādanighātaḥ ||
viśvḙ jānanti mahi॒nā yadāgādindra̭sya ka॒rma sukṛ̭tā puru॒ṇi ||
didṛkṣante | upa̭saḥ | yāma̭n | a॒ktoḥ | vi̭vasvatyāḥ | māhi̭ | ci॒tram | a॒nīka̭m | viśvḙ | jā॒na॒nti | mahi॒nā | yat | ā | a॒gāt | indra̭sya | ka॒rma | su'kṛ̭tā | pu॒ru॒ṇi ||13||

‘viśva sarve janāḥ’ ‘vivasvatyāḥ vivasvataḥ nirgamanaparāyāḥ’ ‘aktoḥ rātreḥ saṃbandhanaḥ’ ‘upaso’ ‘yāman yāmani nirgamane sati’ ‘mahi mahat’ ‘citraṃ cāyanīyam’ ‘anīkaṃ sauraṃ tejaḥ’ ‘didṛkṣante draṣṭumicchanti |
‘yat yadā’ ‘āgāt upaḥkālaḥ’ ‘samantādāgataḥ’ ‘vyapaiti tadā tejo didṛkṣamāṇāḥ sarve janāḥ’ ‘mahinā mahanīyānmihotrādīni karmāṇi’ ‘jānanti kartavyatayāvabudhyante’ |
he indra ‘puruṇi bahūni’ ‘sukṛtā suṣṭhu kṛtāni’ ‘karma karmāṇi’ ‘indrasya tavaiva’ ||
‘dṛśi prekṣaṇe’ ityasya sani ‘jñāśrusmṛdṛśāṃ sanaḥ’ ( pā. sū. 1. 3. 57 ) ityāhamānepadam |
mahi॒ jyoti̭rnihi̭taṃ va॒kṣaṇā̭svāmā pa॒kaṃ ca̭rati bibhra̭tī gauḥ |

karaṇe lyuṭ | lisrvaraḥ | pakram | pacaterniṣṭhākārasya 'paco vaḥ' iti vatvam | pratyayasvaraḥ | carati | caratigarthyarthaḥ | bibhratī | 'ḍubhṛñ dhāraṇapoṣaṇayoḥ' | juhotyādiḥ | śatarugisvāt 'ugitaśca' iti ṅīp | 'abhyastānāmādiḥ' ityādyudāttatvam | ustriyāyām | 'vasa nivāse' | 'sphāyitañca' ityādinādhikaraṇe rakpratyayaḥ | yajādivāt saṃprasāraṇam | 'śāsivasighasīnāṃ ca' iti patvābhāva- śchāndasaḥ | svārthiko ghapratyayaḥ | pratyayasvaraḥ ||
indra da‌rha yāmakośā abhūvanyajñāya śikṣa gṛṇate sakhibhyaḥ |
durmayavau durevā martyāso niṣaṅgiṇo ripavo hantvāsaḥ ||
indra̭ | da‌rha | yāma̭'kośāḥ | a॒bhūvan | ya॒jñāya̭ | śi॒kṣa | gṛ॒ṇatḙ | sa॒khi'bhya̭ḥ | dṷḥ'ma॒yava̭ḥ | dṷḥ'e॒vāḥ | ma॒rtyāsa̭ḥ | ni॒ṣaṅgiṇa̭ḥ | ri॒pava̭ḥ | ha॒ntvāsa̭ḥ || 15 ||

he indra da‌rha dṛḍha bhava | yataḥ yāmakośāḥ | yāntyasminniti yāmo mārgaḥ | tasya kośāḥ kośa- vadācchādakāḥ mārgapratibandhakā rākṣasāḥ abhūvana | tvaṃ yajñāya yajñakartre gṛṇate stotraṃ kurvate yaja- mānāya sakhibhyaḥ putrādibhyaśca śikṣa apekṣitaṃ phalaṃ datsva | durmayavaḥ | duṣṭamāyudhāni minvanti prakṣipantīti durmayavaḥ | durevāḥ | duṣṭaṃ gacchantaḥ martyāmaḥ mārayitāraḥ niṣaṅgiṇaḥ | niṣaṅgaśabdena iṣudhirabhidhīyate | tadantaḥ | evaṃvidhasāmarthyopetāḥ ripavaḥ śatravo rākṣasāḥ hantvāsaḥ tvayā hananīyāḥ || da‌rha | 'raha daha vṛha vṛhi vṛddhau' | vyatyayena śyan | loṭi rūpam | nisvaraḥ | abhūvan | 'bhū sattāyām' | asya luḍi rūpam | 'gātisthā' iti sico luk | 'bhṛsuvostiṅi' iti guṇe pratiṣiddhe 'bhuvo vugluṅliṭoḥ' iti vugāgamaḥ | nighātaḥ | śikṣa | 'śikṣa vidyopādāne' | ayaṃ dhātutra dāne vartate | vyatyayena parasmaipadam | nighātaḥ | durmayavaḥ | minoteḥ 'kṛvāpājimi' ityādinā uṇpratyayaḥ | kṛduttarapadasvaraḥ | durevāḥ | 'dṛṅ gatau' | 'iṇsīdbhyāṃ van' iti kartari vanapratyayaḥ | ripavaḥ | 'rericopadhāyāḥ' ityupapratyayaḥ | upadhāyā hrasvam | pratyayasvaraḥ | hantvāsaḥ | 'hana hiṃsāgatyoḥ' | 'kṛtyārthe tavaikenyantyatvanaḥ' iti tvan | nivādādyudāttaḥ || || 3 ||
vṛśmedhastāddhi rujā sahasva jahi rakṣo maghavannrandhayasva ||
sam | ghoṣaḥ | śṛ॒ṇve | a॒vamai̭ḥ | a॒mitrai̭ḥ | ja॒hi | ni | e॒ṣu | a॒śarnim | ta॒rpiṣṭhām | vṛ॒śma | a॒dhastā̭t | vi | ru॒ja | sa॒hasva̭ | ja॒hi | rakṣa̭ḥ | ma॒ghavan | ra॒ndhayasva || 16 ||
he indra avamaiḥ samīpe vartamānaiḥ amitraiḥ śatrubhissurairhasṛṣṭo yo'śaniḥ ghoṣaḥ dhupyamāṇaḥ saṃ śṛṇve samyagasmābhiḥ śrūyate tapiṣṭhām atiśayena tāpikāṃ tām aśanim eṣu śatrudhveva
1. kha-ga-ca-ja-ṇa-pa-pha-bha-ācchādakāḥ | 2. kha-ga-ca-ja-ṇa-na-sa-putrādibhyastvam | 3. la- ityayam | 4. kha-ga-ca-ja-ṇa-pha-bha-ādāne | 5. kha-ga-ca-ja-ṇa-ta-na-pha-bha-sa-śatruṣu ava |

nidhāya 'jahi māraya | taiḥ prayuktāmaśāni' tāneva prāpayeti bhāvaḥ | 'īm enān śatrūn 'adhastāt mūlataḥ 'vṛśca' chinatthi | kiṃca 'vi 'ruja tān viśeṣeṇa bādhasva 'sahasva' abhibhāva ca | he 'maghavan indra 'rakṣaḥ karmavighnakārīṇi rakṣāṃsi 'jahi māraya | anantaramimaṃ yajñaṃ 'randhayasva pāraṃ naya' || śṛṇve | nighātaḥ | jahi | 'hana hiṃsāgatyoḥ' | asya loṭi rūpam | aśanim | 'aś vyāptau' | 'aśyavitṛbhyo 'niḥ' 'ityanipratyayaḥ | pratyayasvaraḥ | napiṣṭhām | namraśabdādiṣṭhaḥpratyayaḥ | nitsvaraḥ | vṛśca | 'ovaśca' 'chedane' | tudādiḥ | prahijyādinā saṃprasāraṇam | mahasva | vākyabhedādanighātaḥ | randhayasva | 'radha hiṃsā saṃrāddhayoḥ' 'ityasya pyannasya loṭi 'radhijabhorantra' iti numāgam | vākyabhedādanighātaḥ ||
urduha rakṣaḥ sahamūlamindra vṛśca madhyaṃ pratyagraṃ śṛṇīhi |
ā kīvataḥ salalakaṃ cakratha brahmadviṣe tarpaṣi hetimasya |
ut | vṛha | rakṣaḥ | sahamūlam | indra | vṛśca | madhyam | pratita | agram | bhūrṇāhi | ā | kīvataḥ | salalakam | cakratha | brahmadviṣe | tarpaṣi | hetim | asya || 17 ||

he 'indra 'rakṣaḥ karmavighnakāri rakṣaḥkulaṃ 'sahamūlaṃ mūlasahitaṃ yathā bhavati tathā 'urduha uddhara | kiṃca 'madhyaṃ tasya madhyabhāgaṃ 'vṛśca chinatthi | 'pratyagram agraṃ pratyagataṃ tata 'bhūrṇāhi jahi | tasya rakṣaḥkulasya madhye 'salalakaṃ saraṇaśīlaṃ rakṣaḥ 'ā 'kīvataḥ | 'āṅ maryādāyām' | kiyataḥ aniścīyamānaparimāṇāt atidūrādeśāt 'cakratha kuru | kṛtvā ca 'brahmadviṣe brāhmaṇa dveṣakāriṇe tasmai rakṣase 'tarpaṣi tāpakaṃ 'hetiṃ ghātakamāyudhaṃ 'asya kṣipa | uktamarthaṃ yāsko'bravāt---'uddhara rakṣaḥ sahamūlamindra | mūlaṃ mocanādvā mopaṇādvā mohanādvā | vṛśca madhyaṃ prati śṛṇātyagram | adrāgataṃ bhavati | ā kiyato deśātsalalakaṃ salalañca bhavati pāpakamiti nairuktāḥ | sarukkaṃ vā syātsarteravyaratāta | tarpipastapaterhinateḥ' (niru. 6. 3) iti || vṛha | 'vṛha udyamane' ityasya loṭi rūpam | śṛṇīhi | 'śṛ hiṃsāyām' | asya loṭi hau 'ī hatyaghoḥ' 'ityūha | nighātaḥ | kīvataḥ | kiṃśabdāt kiṃ parimāṇasyetyarthe 'kimidabhyāṃ vo ghaḥ' iti kiṃśabdāt catubaratīti jñāpitatvāt vatup | vādeśābhāvaśchāndasaḥ | 'idaṃ kimorīśkī' iti kī ityadeśaḥ | salalakam | 'sṛ gatau' | chāndasī rūpasiddhiḥ | cakratha | 'ḍukṛñ karaṇe' ityasya liṭi thali rūpam | krādiśvādisadbhāvaḥ | nighātaḥ | tarpipam | 'napa saṃtāpe' ityasmāt 'atiparvāpayajitanidhanitapivyo nit' ityusipratyayo nicca | akārasya ikāraśchāndasaḥ | nitsvaraḥ | hatim | 'hana hiṃsāgatyoḥ' | 'utiyutijūtisāti' ityādinā nipātādantodāttaḥ | asya | 'asu kṣepaṇe' | loṭi rūpam ||

1. ta-na-la-rā-prayuktāmaśānim | 2. gha-ja-ṇa-nityatha | 3. ta-sa-'sahasva' nāsti | 4. kha-ga- ca-ja-ṇa-ka-nayasva | 5. ma-na-vṛśca | 6. kha-ga-ca-ja-ṇa-ta-madhyaṃ bhāgam, na-madhyaṃ madhyam; sa- madhyam | 7. ha-apramagram 8. kha-ga-ca-ja-ṇa-ka-bha-abhijñāyamānam | 9. kha-ga-ja-ṇa-na-bha-sa-vṛha |
svastyai vājibhiḥ praṇetaḥ saṃ yanmahīriṣa āsattisa pūrvīḥ |
rāyo vantārau bṛhataḥ syāmāsme astu bhaga indra prajāvān ||
svastyai | vājibhiḥ | ca | praṇetariti pra'netaḥ | sam | yat | mahīḥ | iṣaḥ | ā'sattisa | pūrvīḥ | rāyaḥ | vantārau | bṛhataḥ | syām | asme iti | astu | bhagaḥ | indra | prajāvān || 18||
praṇetaḥ prakarṣeṇa jagato nirvāhaka he indra asmān vājibhiḥ aśvaiḥ sahitān kuru svastaye ca avināśāya kuru |

yat yadā tvaṃ sam āsattisa asmākaṃ samīpe yajñanirvāhārthamāsīdasi tadā vayaṃ mahīḥ mahānta iṣaḥ annāni pūrvīḥ prabhṛtāni rāyaḥ dhanāni vantāraḥ teṣāṃ saṃbhaktāraḥ santaḥ bṛhataḥ mahāntaḥ syām bhavema |
kiṃca prajāvān apatyopetaṃ bhagaḥ dhanam arame asmāsu astu bhavatu ||
iṣo rāya iti ca dve paṣṭhyarthe dvitīye |
'vana paṇa saṃbhaktau' ityasya tṛci āgamānuśāsanasya anityatvādiḍabhāvaḥ |
asmacchandasya saptamyāḥ 'supāṃ suluk' iti śe ityādeśaḥ ||
ā nau bhara bhagamindra dyumantaṃ ni tai deṣṇasya dhīmahi prareke |
ūrvaīva prapathe kāmau asme tamā pṛṇa vasupate vasūnām ||
ā | naḥ | bhara | bhagam | indra | yu'mantam | ni | te | deṣṇasya | dhīmahi | pra'reke | ūrvaḥ'iva | prapathe | kāmaḥ | asme iti | tam | ā | pṛṇa | vasu'pate | vasūnām || 19 ||

he indra naḥ asmadarthaṃ dyumantaṃ dyutiyuktaṃ bhagaṃ dhanam ā bhara ā samantāta saṃbhara | deṣṇasya dānaśīlasya te tava saṃbandhino dhanasya prareke prarecane dāne ni dhīmahi dhanadānamya vayaṃ pātrabhūtāḥ sma ityarthaḥ | kuta ityata āha | asme asmākaṃ kāmaḥ abhilāpaḥ ūrvaiva anavāsakāmo vaḍavānala iva prapathe prabhṛto vartate | vasūnāṃ vasupate dhanānāṃ madhye uttamadhanānāmadhipate he indra taṃ mahāntaṃ kāmam ā pṛṇa bahudhanapradānenāpūraya || bhara | 'bhṛñ bharaṇe' ityasya loṭi rūpam | deṣṇasya | 'ḍudāñ dāne' | 'gādābhyāmiṇṇuṇ' itīṇṇuṇpratyayaḥ | athyarthaṃ dadātīti deṣṇaḥ | cimasvaraḥ | dhīmahi | dadhāterliṅi 'bahula chandasi' iti śapo luk | 'chandasyubhayathā' iti mahiṅaḥ sārvadhātu- katvāt sīyuṭaḥ salopaḥ | ārdhadhātukatvāt āto lopaḥ | nighātaḥ | ūrvaiva | pūrvapadasvaraḥ | prapathe | 'pratha prakhyāne' ityasya liṭi rūpam | pṛṇa | 'pṛṇa prīṇane' ityasya loṭi serhiḥ | tudādiḥ | 'ato heḥ' iti herluk | vasūnām | nistvādādyudāttaḥ ||

imaṃ kāmaṃ mandyā gobhiraśvaiścandravatā rādhasā paprathaśca | svaryavo matibhistubhyaṃ viprā indrāya vāha: kuśikāso akran || 20 || imam | kāmam | mandya | gobhi: | aśvai: | candra'vatā | rādhasā | papratha: | ca | sva:'yava: | mati'bhi: | tubhyam | viprā: | indrāya | vāha: | kuśikāsa: | akran || 20 ||
he indra ˅imaṃ dhanādiviṣayaṃ ˅kāmam asmadīyabhilāṣaṃ ˅gobhi: agnihotrādikarmasādhana- bhūtairgāvādibhirvāhnasādhanabhūtai: ˅aśvai: ca ˅candravatā dīmiyuktena ˅rādhasā dhanena ˅ca ˅rūndaya |

ā nau gotrā dardahi gopate gā: samasmabhyaṃ sunayo yantu vājā: | divakṣā asi vṛṣabha satyaśuṣmo'smabhyaṃ su maghavanbodhi godā: || 21 || ā | na: | gotrā | dardahi | go'pate | gā: | sam | asmabhyam | sunaya: | yantu | vājā: | divakṣā: | asi | vṛṣabha | satya'śuṣma: | asmabhyam | su | maghavan | bodhi | godā: ||21||

˅gotrai' svargādhipate he indra ˅na: asmadartha ˅gotrā gotrāṇyatrāṇi ˅gā: apa: prati ˅ā ˅dardahi ādiyasva | atrāṇi vidīrya' jalāni prāpayetyartha | tata: ˅sanaya: saṃbhajanīyāni ˅vājā: annāni ˅asmabhyam asmadartha ˅saṃ ˅yantu samāgacchantu | ˅vṛṣabha kāmānāṃ varṣitahe' indra tvaṃ ˅divakṣā: ˅asi divaṃ vyāpya vartamānatvena mahānasi' | ata eva ˅satyaśuṣma: satyasāmarthya: ˅maghavan dhanavan he indra ˅asmabhyaṃ ˅godā: gavāṃ pradātā bhavāmīti ˅su ˅bodhi suṣṭhu budhdyasva || dardahi | ' dṛhū ādare ' | yaṅluki loṭi rūpam | ' ṛtaśca ' ( pā. sū. 7. 4. 92 ) ityabhyāsasya rugāgama: | nighāta: | gā: | ' auto'msāso: ' ( pā. sū. 6. 1. 93 ) ityokārasyākāra: | ekādeśasvara: | asmabhyam | ' bhyaso bhyam ' iti caturthībahuvacanasya bhyāmādeśa: | yantu | ' iṇ gatau ' | loṭi rūpam | divakṣā: | ' aś vyāptau ' | asun | divaṃ vyāpnotīti divakṣā: | kuduttara- padasvara: | godā: | ' hudāña dāne ' | asmān vic | kuduttarapadasvara: ' ||
1. kha-ga-ca-ta- ' ca ' nāsti | 2. ta-gopate gavāṃ pate | 3. kha-ga-ca-ja-ṇa-pa-pha-bha-la-sa- vidārya | 4. pha-varṣaka he | 5. ja-ṇa-bha-bhavasi | 6. la-ityasmāt | 7. ta-kuduttarapadaprakṛtisvara: |

śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau | śṛṇvantamugramūtaye sumatsu hantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām || 22 || śunam | huvema | maghavānam | indram | asmin | bhare | nṛtamam | vāja'sātau | śṛṇvantam | ugram | ūtaye | sumat'su | hantam | vṛtrāṇi | sam'jitam | dhanānām || 22 ||
vājasyānnasya sātiḥ lābhaḥ ' yasmin so'yaṃ vājasātiḥ tasmin |
bibhrati jayalakṣmīmanena yoddhāra iti bharaḥ saṃgrāmaḥ |
sukhakaraṃ 'maghavānaṃ dhanavantam ata eva 'indraṃ niratiśayaiśvaryasaṃpannaṃ 'nṛtamaṃ sarvasya jagato'tiśayena netāraṃ tvāṃ 'huvema kuśikā vayaṃ yajñārthamāhvayema |

tathā 'śṛṇvantam asmābhiḥ kriyamāṇāṃ stutiṃ śṛṇvantam 'ugraṃ śatrūṇāṃ bhayaṃkaraṃ 'samatsu saṃgrāmeṣu 'vṛtrāṇi vṛtropalakṣitāni sarvāṇi rakṣāṃsi 'hantaṃ hiṃsantaṃ 'dhanānāṃ śatrumandhināṃ 'saṃjinaṃ samyagjetāraṃ tvām 'ūtaye rakṣaṇāya vayamāhvayema ||
hvayateḥ 'bahula chandasi' iti saṃprasāraṇe kṛte śapo luki kṛte ca liṅi rūpam |
atrānukramaṇikā—' śāsat kuśiko viśvāmitra eva vā śṛteḥ ' iti |
irpātsva putraḥ kuśiko viśvāmitra eva vā ṛṣiḥ |
caturthābhiṣeke'hani mādhyaṃdine' savane' acchāvākasya ārambhaṇīyāyā ūrdhvamahīnasūkta- saṃjñakametasūktaṃ śaṃsanīyam |
sūtritaṃ ca —' asmā idu pranavase śāsaddihiratīrāvarhānasūkte' ( āśva. śrau. 7. 4 ) iti |
'imāmū vicchanti tvā śāsaddihiriti saṃpātāḥ ' ( āśva. śrau. 7.5 ) iti ||

śāsaddirduhiturnaryaṃ gādidvāṃ ṛtasya dīdhitiṃ saparyana | pitā yatra duhituḥ sekamujjhantaṃ śagmyena manasā dadhanve || 1 || śāsat | vahneḥ | duhituḥ | naryam | gāt | vidvān | ṛtasya | dīdhitim | saparyana | pitā | yatra | duhituḥ | sekam | ṛjhan | sam | śagmyena | manasā | dadhanve || 1 ||

1. ca-pha-saṃbhajanam | 2. gha-ja-ṇa-asmin | 3. kha-ga-ja-ṇa-bha-'śunaṃ' nāsti | 4. kha-ga- ca-ja-ṇa-ta-na-bha-la-sa-'yadvā......sukhakaraṃ' nāsti | 5. la-ghatvam | 6. la-'tuk' nāsti | 7. kha-ga-ja-ṇa-ta-bha-sa-mādhyaṃdinasavane |
kuśikaḥ' prasaṅgāt kaṃcit śāstrārthaṃ brūte'-'aputrasya' pituḥ putrī dāyādā putrikā satī|
aputro' yaḥ pitā kanyāmanyakulaṃ prāpayati sa 'vahviḥ ityucyate'|
asyāṃ yo jāyate putraḥ sa me putro bhavediti' (vāsiṣṭha. 17. 17) smṛtyuktam' anuśāsanaṃ kurvan 'duhituḥ putrikāyāḥ 'naśya naptṛbhavaṃ piṇḍadānādikaṃ kartavyatayā' gān gacchati|

'vidvān aryāṃ duhitari jātaḥ putro mama svadhākaro bhaviṣyatīti jānan 'ṛtasya' satyasya putrotpādanasamarthasya' retasaḥ 'dīdhiti dhatīraṃ jāmātaraṃ tatpatiṃ' 'saparyan vastrādyalaṃkārādinā pūjayan 'pitā naptṛbhavaṃ' gacchati|
'yatra yasyāḥ 'duhituḥ pitā pālakaḥ patirjāmātā 'sekaṃ tayāṃ reta:sekam 'tra ṛn prasā
bhaginyaśca nijādaṃśātsvāṃśaṃ tu turīya kam' (yājña. 2. 124) iti yājñavalkyasmaraṇāt |
strīpuṃsalakṣaṇasyāpatyasyakopādha- tvāviśeṣānpumapatyasya ko viśeṣa ityāśaṅkya viśeṣaṃ darśayati |
avahniḥ strī vahviḥ pumān svabhāryāyā voḍhṛtvāt' |
tathāpi tayormadhye 'anyaḥ puṃlakṣaṇaḥ 'sukṛtoḥ śobhanasya piṇḍadānādeḥ karmaṇaḥ 'kartā bhavati |
piṇḍadānādi- kartṛtvātputro dāyādaḥ duhitustathātvaṃ 'neti' na dāyārhā sā tu kevalaṃ parasmai dīyate |
jāmiranye'syāṃ janayanti jāmapatyaṃ jamatervā syādvitakarmaṇo nirgamanaprayā bhavati |

tānva ātmajaḥ putro rikthaṃ prāricatrapādāccakāraināṃ garbhinadhānīṃ sanirtuhastagrāhasya yadiha mātaro'janayanta vahni putramavahviṃca striyamanyataraḥ saṃtānakartā bhavati pumānadāyādo'nyataro'dhayitvā jāmiḥ pradīyate parasmai' (niru. 3. 6) iti ||
'ricir virecane' ityasya luṅi sici 'vadavaja0' ityādinā vṛddhiḥ |
'pitā mātrā' iti pituḥ śeṣe prāpte mātuḥ śeṣaśchandasaḥ |
agnirjajñe juhvā rejamāno mahasputrā~ arupasya prayakṣai |
mahāngarbho mahā jñātameṣāṃ mahī pravadvayaścasya yajñaiḥ ||
agniḥ | jajñe | juhvā | rejamānaḥ | mahaḥ | putrān | arupasya | prayakṣai | mahān | garbhaḥ | mahi | ā | jñātam | eṣām | mahī | pravat | hari | aścasya | yajñaiḥ || 3 ||
he indra 'arupasya rocamānasya' tava 'prayakṣai yajñārthaṃ 'juhvā jvālābhiḥ 'rejamānaḥ kampamānaḥ 'agniḥ 'mahaḥ prabhūtān 'putrān raśmīna 'jajñe utpādayāmāsa |
kiṃca eṣāṃ raśmīnāṃ melanam 'ā 'jātaṃ sarvata oṣadhyātmanā jātaṃ 'mahi mahadabhūt |
kiṃca eṣāṃ raśmīnāṃ 'pravat anena prakāreṇa pravṛttiḥ 'haryaśvasya indrasya 'yajñaiḥ yajanāhaiḥ ' somājyāhutibhiḥ 'mahī mahatī bhavati ||
'juhoterde dīrghaśca' iti kvip dvivacanaṃ dīrghaśca dhātoḥ |

agne nayatsupadyakṣarāṇāmacchā rave prathamā jānatī gāt ||

tasyāsiddhatvāt 'ato heḥ' iti haluk na bhavati |

tam | aṅgirasvat | namasā | saparyana | navyam | kṛṇomi | sanyase | purā'jām | duhaḥ | vi | yāhi | bahulāḥ | adevīḥ | svaḥ'iti svaḥ | ca | naḥ | magha'van | sātaye | dhāḥ || 19 ||

he indra 'aṅgirasvat aṅgirasa iva 'namasā stotreṇa 'saparyana pūjayan viśvāmitro'haṃ 'ta tādṛśamahimāpetaṃ 'purājāṃ purātanaṃ tvāṃ 'sanyase saṃbhajanāya 'navyaṃ 'kṛṇomi stotravyatayābhinavaṃ karomi | 'adevīḥ tamorūpatvenādyotamānān 'bahulāḥ bahūn 'duhaḥ drāghna śatrūbhūtān rākṣasān 'vi 'yāhi viśeṣeṇa mṛrti prāpaya | he 'maghavan indra 'naḥ asmabhyaṃ 'svaḥ svaṃ 'dhanaṃ 'ca 'sātaye saṃbhajanāthaṃ 'dhāḥ dhehi || aṅgirasvat | aṅgirasa iva | 'tena tulyam' iti vatipratyayaḥ | 'nabho'ṅgiromanuṣāṃ vatyupasaṃ- khyānam' iti bhayaṃtrāyāṃ sakārasya rutvābhāvaḥ | saparyana | saparaśabdaḥ kaṇvādiḥ | navyam | 'ṇu stutau' ityasmāt 'aco yat' iti yatpratyayaḥ | 'dhātornanimittamya' iti vāntādeśaḥ | 'yato'nāvaḥ' ityāyudāttatvam | kṛṇomi | kuverlaṭi rūpam | sanyase | sanataṃbhāve kip | 'yasu prayatne' | asmāt kip | sanaḥ saṃbhajanasya yase yatnāya | saṃbhajanārthamityarthaḥ | purājām | janerviṭi ātve rūpam | yāhi | yāterloṭi rūpam | svaḥ | 'svarādinipāta mavyayam' ityavyayasaṃjñāyām 'avyayādāpsupaḥ' iti mugo luk | sātaye | 'paṇa saṃbhaktau' | bhāve kin | 'janasana' ityādinā ātvam | 'ūtiyuti' ityādinā nipātādādyudāttaḥ ||
mihaḥ pāvakāḥ pratatā abhūcantsvasti naḥ pipṛhi pāramāsām |
indra tvaṃ rathiraḥ pāhi no riṣo makṣūmakṣū kṛṇhi gojitoṃ naḥ ||
mihaḥ | pāvakāḥ | pra'tatāḥ | abhūvan | svasti | naḥ | pipṛhi | pāram | āsām | indra | tvam | rathiraḥ | pāhi | naḥ | riṣaḥ | makṣū'makṣū | kṛṇuhi | go'jitaḥ | naḥ ||20||
he indra te 'pāvakāḥ pāpanāṃ śodhayiṣyaḥ 'mihaḥ secanasādhanānyāpaḥ 'pratatāḥ loke prakarṣeṇa vistṛtāḥ 'abhūvan |
'āsām apāṃ 'svasti vināśarahitaṃ 'pāraṃ tīraṃ 'naḥ asmadarthaṃ 'pipṛhi jaleḥ saṃpūrṇa kuru |
'rathiraḥ rathavān 'tvaṃ 'ripaḥ hiṃsakāta śatroḥ sakāśāt 'naḥ asmān 'pāhi pālaya |
anantaraṃ 'naḥ asmān 'makṣumakṣu' atiśīghraṃ 'gojitaḥ gavādipaśūnāṃ jetṛn 'kṛṇuhi kuru |
vṛṣṭipradānena taṭākādijalāśayān saṃpūrṇān kṛtvā gavādidhanayuktān kurviti bhāvaḥ ||

ntoyādiḥ | ‘ atipippyauśca ’ ityabhyāsasyatvam | herhrasvādguṇaḥ | nighātaḥ | rathiḥ | makharthe ‘ medhārathābhyāmirñiracau ’ itīracpratyayaḥ | ripaḥ | ‘ ripa hiṃsāyām ’ | kip | ‘ sāvekācaḥ ’ iti vibhakterudāttatvam | makṣabhakṣa | ‘ niravīpsayoḥ ’ iti dvivacanam | saṃhitāyām ‘ ṛcitanughamaśrutak ’ iti dīrghaḥ ||

adediṣṭa vṛtrahā gopatirgā anta: kṛṣṇā~ aruṣairdhāmabhirgāt | pra sūnṛtā diśamāna ṛtena duraśca viśvā avṛṇodapa svāḥ || 21 || adediṣṭa | vṛtrahā | gopatiḥ | gāḥ | antaḥ | iti | kṛṣṇān | aruṣaiḥ | dhāmabhiḥ | gāt | pra | sūnṛtāḥ | diśamānaḥ | ṛtena | duraḥ | ca | viśvāḥ | avṛṇot | apa | svāḥ || 21 ||
‘vṛtrahā vṛtrasya hantā ’gopatiḥ gavāṃ svāmī saindraḥ ’gāḥ ’adediṣṭa asmabhyaṃ dadātu |
sūtritaṃ ca—' indra somamindraḥ pūrbhiditi madhyaṃdinaḥ ' ( āśva. śrau. 9. 8 ) iti ||

indra somaṃ somapate pibaṃ mādyaṃdinaṃ sarvaṃ cāru yatte | pramudhyā śipre maghavaṛjīṣinvimucyā harī iha mādayasva || 1 || indra̭ | soma̭m | soma̭'pate | piba̭ | i॒mam | mā॒dya̭ṃdinam | sa॒rva̭m | cā॒ru | yat | te॒ | pra॒'mu॒dhya | śi॒pre iti̭ | ma॒ghava̭n | ṛ॒jīṣin | vi॒'mu॒cya | harī̭ iti̭ | i॒ha | mā॒da॒ya॒sva॒ ||1||

^yat yasmāt ^te tvadarthaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ ^mādhyaṃdinaṃ madhyaṃdina- saṃbandha ^savanaṃ niṣkevalyaṃ śasraṃ ^cāru ramaṇīyaṃ vartate |

gavāśiraṃ manthinamindra śukraṃ pibā somaṃ rarimā te madāya | brahmakṛtā mārutenā guṇena sajoṣo rudraistṛpadā vṛṣasva || 2 || go'āśiram | ma॒nthina̭m | i॒ndra॒ | śu॒kram | piba̭ | soma̭m | ra॒ri॒mā | te॒ | ma॒dā̭ya | brahma̭'kṛtā | mā॒ru॒tena̭ | gu॒ṇena̭ | sa॒joṣa̭āḥ | ru॒draiḥ | tṛ॒pa॒t | ā | vṛ॒ṣa॒sva॒ || 2 ||
he ^indra ^gavāśiraṃ gavyasya payasa āśīrmīśraṇaṃ yasmin taṃ ^somam |
api ca ^manthinaṃ manthasaṃyuktaṃ ^śukrama abhinavaṃ yadvā śukrāmanthagrahe vartamānam |
^te tava ^madāya harṣāya ^rarima taṃ somaṃ vayaṃ prayacchāmaḥ |
indrastotraṃ kurvāṇena mārutena ^gaṇena ^rudraiḥ ekādaśa- saṃkhyākaiḥ rudraiśca ^sajoṣaḥ saṃgatastvaṃ ^tṛpat somapānena tṛpyan ^ā ^vṛṣasva |
śrīṇāteḥ 3 āṅpūrvāt kipi ‘ apastṛdhethāmānucuḥ ’ ityādinā nipātānāṃ āśīrādeśaḥ |
1. lasa-hetumati ṇic | 2. kha-ga-ca-ja-ṇa-ta-na-bha-sa-brahmakṛtā | 3. kha-ga-ca-ja-ṇa-ta-na-bha-ṛṇāteḥ | 4. la-śirādeśaḥ | 5. kha-ga-ca-ja-ṇa-ta-na-bha-sa-piba | ka. 1 - 43

rarima | rāteḥ chāndase' vartamāne liṭi rūpam | asamānavākyatvātnighātābhāvaḥ | ' āgamā anudāttāḥ iti ito'nudāttatvāna pratyayasvaraḥ | nṛpat | ' tṛpa prīṇane ' | tudādiḥ | āgamānuśāsanasyānityatvāna numabhāvaḥ | vṛṣasva | ' vṛṣu secane ' | vyatyayena śaḥ ||
ye te śuṣmaṃ ye taviṣīmavardhanta indra marutasta ojaḥ |
mādhyaṃdine savane vajrahasta pibā rudrebhiḥ sagaṇaḥ suśipa ||
ye | te | śuṣmam | ye | taviṣīm | avardhan | arcantaḥ | indra | marutaḥ | te | ojaḥ | mādhyaṃdine | savane | vajra'hasta | piba | rudrebhiḥ | sa'gaṇaḥ | su'śipa || 3 ||

he indra ' ye ' marutaḥ ' te tava ' śuṣmaṃ śatrūṇāṃ śoṣakaṃ tejaḥ ' ye ca marutaḥ ' taviṣīṃ balaṃ ca 'avardhan' yuddhasahakāritayāvardhayan te marutaḥ 'arcantaḥ' tvāṃ stuvantaḥ santaḥ 'te tava 'ojaḥ yuddhasāma- rthyam' avardhayan |
' śipra hanū nāsike vā ' iti yāskaḥ |
ta itvasya madhumadvipra indrasya śardho maruto ya āsana |
te | itva | nu | asya | madhu'mat | vivipre | indrasya | śardhaḥ | marutaḥ | ye | āsana | yebhiḥ | vṛtrasya | iṣitaḥ | viveda | amarmaṇaḥ | manyamānasya | marma || 4 ||
tatra sahāyā vayamāramahe tvaṃ yuddhamabhigaccheti mādhuryopetaṃ vākyaṃ yathā bhavati tathā 'vivipre 'nu kṣipraṃ prerayan |
aviditamarmasthānasya ata eva 'manyamānasya na ko'pi mama hantyabhimanyamānasya 'vṛtrasya asurasya 'marma yasmin sthānaṃ prahṛtau satyāṃ sa mariṣyati tādṛśaṃ sthānaṃ 'viveda ajñāsīt ||
ircaḥ ' iryo re ' iti re iyādeśaḥ |

1. ca-ja-ṇa-bha-chandasi | 2. kha-ga-gha-ca-ja-ṇa-pa-pha-bha-sa- ' śatrūṇāṃ śoṣakaṃ ' nāsti | 3. kha- ga-gha-ca-ja-ṇa-pha-bha-avardhan avardhayan | 4. ca-pha-vividhasāmarthyam | 5. sa-vajrayukto hastau | 6. ca-abhiprerayan | 7. pha-jñānavān |
manuṣ‌vadindra sarvaṃ juṣāṇaḥ pibā somaṃ śaśvate vīryāya |
sa ā vavṛtsva haryaśva yajñaiḥ saraṇyubhirpo arṇo sisarṣi ||
manuṣ‌vat | indra | sarvam | juṣāṇaḥ | piba | somam | śaśvate | vīryāya | saḥ | ā | vavṛtsva | harya'aśva | yajñaiḥ | saraṇyubhiḥ | apaḥ | arṇaḥ | sisarṣi || 5 ||
he indra ! manuṣ‌vat manorath‌vamiva savanaṃ yajñaṃ juṣāṇaḥ sevamānastvaṃ śaśvate śāśvatāya vīryāya paraparibhavalakṣaṇāya māmarthāyamaṃ somaṃ piba |
he haryaśva haritavarṇāśvopeta ! saḥ tādṛśastvaṃ yajñaiḥ yajanīyaiḥ mahadbhiḥ mākam ā vavṛtsva āgaccha |
kiṃca saraṇyubhiḥ ekaśrutimanmantrāṇāmama icchadbhiḥ yadvā saraṇyubhiḥ maraṇaśīlairmarudbhiḥ sahitastvam apaḥ antarikṣasthānyudakāni arṇaḥ pārthivānyadakāni sisarṣi prāpaya |
samāno raṇe dhvaniyeṣāṃ te saraṇā mantrāḥ |
tvamapo yad vṛtraṃ jaghanvā~ atyā~iva prāsṛjaḥ sartavājī |
śayānamindra caratā vadhena vavrivāṃsaṃ pari devīrdaivam ||
tvam | apaḥ | yat | ha | vṛtram | jaghanvān | atyān'iva | pra | asṛjaḥ | sartavai | ajīḥ | śayānam | indra | caratā | vadhena | vavrivāṃsam | pari | devīḥ | adevam || 6 ||

he indra tvaṃ devīḥ devanśīlāḥ apaḥ pari vavrivāṃsaṃ parita āvṛtya vartamānamata eva adevaṃ bahudakatāyasvacchatvenāpratibhāsamānaṃ śayānam ekatra niścalatayā vartamānaṃ vṛtraṃ meghaṃ yat yadā caratā tamuddiśya vartamānena vadhena jaghanvān hatavānasi tadā tvam ājī yuddhe sartavai ativegagamanāya atyāniva yathāśvān prerayasi tathā tvamapaḥ udakānyantarikṣādākāśān prāsṛjaḥ ha prakarṣeṇa meghabhedanaṃ kṛtvā sṛjaḥ khalu |
ityasya kasau 'vibhāṣā gamahanavidaviśām' itīṭo vikalpitatvādana iḍābhāvaḥ |
'antaśca tavai yugapat' iti dhātoḥ pratyayasya codāttatvam |
1. na-la-sa- 'haritavarṇāśvopeta' nāsti | 2. kha-ga-ja-ṇa-bha-sa-prāpaya sa | 3. tra-pa-pha-bha- yathā tvamabhān | 4. ca-pha-śavikaraṇaḥ |

bhājo | ‘aja gatikṣepaṇayoḥ’ | ‘ajyātibhyāṃ ca’ (u.sū. 4.570) iti iṇpratyayaḥ | ṇittvādupadhāvṛddhiḥ | ajanti gacchantyasminnidhyājiyurddham | pratyayasvaraḥ | sartavājāvityatra saṃhitāyām āyādeśe kṛte tasya ‘lopaḥ śākalyasya’ iti yakāralopaḥ | sarvavidhīnāṃ chandasi vikalpitatvāt savarṇa- dīrghatve kartavye yalopo nāsiddho bhavati | savarṇadīrghaḥ | śayānam | ‘śīṅ svapne’ | śānac | adāditvācchapo luk | ḍittvālasārvadhātukasvareṇa śānaco'nudāttatve dhātusvaraḥ | vadhena | hanterbhāve ‘hanaśca vadhaḥ’ ityaṇpratyayo vadhādeśaśca dhātorantodāttaśca | vavrivāṃsam | ‘vṛñ varaṇe’ ityasya kvasau iḍāgamaśchāndasaḥ | pratyayasvaraḥ ||
yasya̭ pri॒ye ma॒marturya̭jñiya̭sya na roda̭sī mahi॒māna̭ṃ ma॒mātḙ ||
yajāmaḥ | it | namasā | vṛddham | indram | bṛhantam | ṛṣvam | ajaram | yuvānam | yasya | priye iti | mamatuḥ | yajñiyasya | na | rodasī iti | mahimānam | mamāte iti || 7 ||
˅priye priyatamaṃ aparimita ˅rodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau ˅yajñiyasya yajñārhasya ˅yasya indrasya tava ˅mahimānaṃ vaibhavaṃ ˅na ˅mamatuḥ na paricchettuṃ śakataḥ |
‘māṅ māne śabde ca’ ityasya liṭgātāmi rūpam ||
indra̭sya ka॒rma sukṛ̭tā pu॒rūṇi̭ vra॒tāni̭ de॒vā na mi̭nanti॒ viśvḙ |
dā॒dhāra॒ yaḥ pṛ̭thi॒vīṃ dyāmu॒temāṃ ja॒jāna॒ sūrya̭mu॒ṣasa॒ṃ suda̭ṃsāḥ ||

1. la-pratyayasvaraḥ | yajñiyasya | yajñaśabdādahetyarthe ‘yajñartibhyāṃ ghakhamo’ iti ghapratyayaḥ | ghasya iyādeśaḥ | pratyayasvaraḥ | 2. kha-ga-gha-ca-ja-ṇa-na-bha-sarvāṇi |
'sudaṃsāḥ sukarmā śobhanakarmā sañjhindraḥ 'sūrya lokaprakāśakamādityam 'upasam agnihotrādikarmanirvāhakamuṣaḥkālaṃ 'jajāna utpādayāmāsa |
'indrasya karma sukṛtā puruṇi ' ityetatpadakadambakam 'eko dve vasumatī ' ityasmin varge paṭhitam (ṛ. saṃ. 3.30.13) |
atrāpi tadeva' paṭhyate 'kimiti' padakāle notsṛjyata iti cenna |
tatra 'indrasya karma sukṛtā puruṇi ' ityekaṃ vākyam |
atra tu ' karma sukṛtā ' ityekaṃ vākyaṃ ' puruṇi vratāni ' ityaparam |
kiṃca tatratyaṃ padakadambakaṃ prathamāntam atratyaṃ dvitīyāntam |
adraugha satyaṃ tav tanmahitvaṃ sadyo yajjāto arpibo ha somam |
na dyāvaṃ indra tava̭sta ojo nāhā na māsāḥ śaradau varanta |
adraugha | satyam | tav | tat | mahi'tvam | sadhaḥ | yat | jātaḥ | arpibaḥ | ha | somam | na | dyāvaḥ | indra | tavasaḥ | te | ojaḥ | na | ahā | na | māsāḥ | śaradaḥ | varanta ||9||
'adraugha drohavarjita he indra 'tava' 'tanmahitvaṃ tādṛśaṃ māhātmyaṃ 'sadhyaṃ yathārtham |
kiṃca 'tavasaḥ balavataḥ 'te tava 'ojaḥ sāmarthyaṃ 'dyāvaḥ divaḥ 'divopalakṣitāḥ sarvai lokāḥ 'na 'varanta na vārayanti |
tathā 'māsāḥ caitrādyāḥ 'śaradaḥ saṃvatsarāśca tava sāmarthyaṃ na vārayanti |
kiṃtu ' tava sāmarthyamanusmṛtya sarve vartanta iti bhāvaḥ |
sadyastrīnāmnyakāhe niṣkevalyaśastre ' tvaṃ sadyo apibaḥ' iti sūktamukhyā |
sūtritaṃ ca—' tvaṃ sadyo apibojāta indrānu tvāhime adha deva devāḥ ' ( āśva. śrau. 9. 5 ) iti |

1. kha-ga-ja-ṇa-bha-tadevamucyate; ca-na-pha-sa-tadeva ucyate | 2. kha-ga-ca-ja-ṇa-pha-sa-'kimiti' nāsti | 3. kha-ca-pha-bha-'vibhaktibhedācca' nāsti | 4. ta-abhyāsadīrghaḥ | 5. kha-ga-ta-na-la- sa-te tava | 6. gha-na-la-sa-'divaḥ' nāsti | 7. ta-nivārayanti | 8. ta-'kiṃtu' nāsti | 9. kha-ga-ja-ṇa-na-bha-sa-gulmavanaspatīnām |

ojāyamānam| ojaḥśabdādācārārthe 'kartuḥ kyaṅ salopaśca' iti kyaṅpratyayaḥ| salopaśca| ṅittvādadātmanepadam| pratyayasvaraḥ| tadyān | tu iti sautro dhātuḥ| asmāt tṛjantāt 'tucchandasi' itīyasun| 'turiṣṭhemeyaḥsu' iti tuco lopaḥ| bhasaṃjñāyāmorguṇaḥ| ikāralopaśchāndasaḥ| niruccaraḥ| bhūt| bhavaterluṅi rūpam| sphigyā| 'yaci bham' iti bhasaṃjñāyāḥ bādhitatvāt 'svādiṣva- sarvanāmasthāne' iti padasaṃjñāyāṃ jaśtvam| tṛtīyāyāḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ| kṣām| 'kṣi nivāsagatyoḥ'| 'anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate' iti nirupapadādapi ḍapratyayaḥ| tataṣṭāp| kṣiyanti nivasantyasyāṃ prāṇina iti śrā bhūmiḥ| udāttanivṛttisvareṇāntodāttaḥ| avasthāḥ| 'vama ācchādane' dṛśyasya laṅi anudāttatvāna ātmanepadam| thāmi adāditvācchapo luk| yathogādanighātaḥ| bhaḍāgamamvaraḥ||

yajño hi taṃ indra vardhano bhūduta priyaḥ sutasomo miyedhaḥ | yajñena yajñamava yajñiyaḥ sanyajñaste vajrmahitya āvat || 12 || yajñaḥ | hi | te | indra | vardhanaḥ | bhūt | uta | priyaḥ | suta'somaḥ | miyedhaḥ | yajñena | yajñam | ava | yajñiyaḥ | san | yajñaḥ | te | vajram | ahi'hatyai | āvat ||12||

he indra ammadīyo'yaṃ yajñaḥ te tava vardhanaḥ haviṣpradānena vardhayitā bhūt hi bhavati khalu| uta api ca sutasomaḥ abhiputasomavān miyedhaḥ mārabhūto'yaṃ yajñaḥ tava priyaḥ| sa tvaṃ yajñiyaḥ yajñārhaḥ man yajñaṃ yajñasya kartāraṃ yajamānaṃ yajñena anuṣṭhīyamānenānena ava phalapradānena rakṣa| kiṃcāyaṃ yajñaḥ te tava vajrmahitye vṛtrahanane karmaṇi āvan rakṣatu| vardhanaḥ| 'vṛdhu vardhane' dṛśyasya ṇyantasya nancāditvāt hyupratyayaḥ| litsvaraḥ| bhūt| hiyogādanighātaḥ| ava| avaterloṭi rūpam| nighātaḥ| san| aseḥ śatṛ rūpam| pratyayasvaraḥ| ahihatye| 'hana hiṃsāgatyoḥ' dṛśyasya bhāve 'hanasta ca' iti kyap nakāraśchāntādeśaḥ| kudunarapadasvaraḥ| āvana| avateśchandase laṅi rūpam| nighātaḥ||

yajñenendramavasā cakre arvāgainaṃ sumnāya narvyase vavṛtyām | yaḥ stomairbhā'vṛdhe pūrvyairbhyo madyumebhiruta nūtanebhiḥ || 13 || yajñena | indram | avasā | ā | cakre | arvāk | ā | enam | sumnāya | narvyase | vavṛtyām | yaḥ | stomaibhiḥ | vavṛdhe | pūrvyaibhiḥ | yaḥ | madyumebhiḥ | uta | nūtanebhiḥ || 13 ||
he indra sarvo yajamānaḥ avasā svarakṣaṇena yajñena indraṃ tvām arvāk ā cakre haviṣpradānenābhimukhaṃ karoti|
tathāhaṃ narvyase navatarāya sumnāya dhanāya enaṃ tvām ā vavṛtyām
1. la-bhasaṃjñāṃ bādhitvā| 2. kha-ga-ca-ja-ṇa-ta-na-bha-sa-nivāse| 3. kha-ja-ṇa-pa-bha-te tava| 4. kha-ga-ca-ṇa-bha-'pyantasya nāsti| 5. ta-asteḥ| 6. ta-kuryāt|

yajenāvṛttaṃ madamimukhaṃ kuryām | kīraśasvam | yaḥ pūryaibhiḥ purātanaiḥ stomebhiḥ stotraiḥ | vavṛdhe | tathā yaḥ indraḥ madhyamebhiḥ madhye bhavaḥ stotraiḥ | uta api ca nūtanebhiḥ asmābhiḥ kriyamāṇaiḥ adhunātanaiḥ stotrairvardhate || cakre | karoterliṭi rūpam | nayase | navaśabdādīyasuni bhasaṃjñāyāmakāralope īkāralopaśchāndasaḥ | niccādādyudāttaḥ | vavṛdhām | 'vṛt vartane' | liṅi 'bahulaṃ chandasi' iti śapaḥ luḥ | vyatyayena parasmaipadam | nighātaḥ | vavṛdhe | 'vṛdhu vardhane' ityasya liṭi rūpam | pratyayasvaraḥ | madhyamebhiḥ | madhyaśabdāt śaiṣikārthe 'madhyamānmaḥ' (pā. sū. 4. 3. 8) iti mapratyayaḥ | pratyayasvaraḥ | nūtanebhiḥ | navaśabdasya 'sanasananvāśca pratyayā vaktavyā na iyādeśaśca' (pā. ma. 5. 4. 30. 6) iti tananpratyayo n iyādeśaśca ||
viveṣa yanmā dhiṣaṇā jujān stavai purā pāryādindramahaḥ |
aṃhaso yatra pīparadyathā no nāveva yāntamubhaye havante ||
viveṣa | yat | mā | dhiṣaṇā | jujān | stavai | purā | pāryāt | indram | ahaḥ | aṃhasaḥ | yatra | pīparat | yathā | naḥ | nāvā'iva | yāntam | ubhaye | havante || 14 ||
yan yadā dhiṣaṇā indraṃ stavānīti madīyāṃ buddhimāṃ vivepa vyāpnot tadāhaṃ stotraṃ jajāna karomi |
ahaṃ pāryāt pāre bhavādatidūravartinaḥ vighnakāriṇaḥ ahaḥ purā pūrvaṃ stavai stavāni |
yatra yasyāṃ dhiṣaṇāyāmeva jātāyāṃ satyāṃ sa indraḥ naḥ asmān aṃhasaḥ pāparūpādahṛdayāt yathā pīparat yathā pāraṃ nayet tathāramadubhayapārśvavartinārthino janāḥ havante āhvayanti |
yathā nadyādiṣu naukayā yāntaṃ puruṣam ubhaye ubhayakūlavartinaḥ janā havante āhvayanti tadvat ||
viṣu vyāptau ityasya liṭi ṇali rūpam |
jana janane ityasya liṭyuttame ṇali rūpam |
pṛ pālanapūraṇayoḥ ityasya luṅi caṅi hrasvābhyāsetvadīrgha- guṇāḥ |
juda preraṇe ityasmān glānudibhyāṃ ḍauḥ (u. sū. 2. 222) iti ḍaupratyayaḥ |
ubhaśabdāt parasya tayapaḥ ubhādātto nityam (pā. sū. 5. 2. 44) ityayajādeśaḥ |
mādhyadine savana āmīyrīyasya 'āpūrṇo asya' iti sthitayājyā |
sannitaṃ ca 'āpūrṇo asya kalaśaḥ svāheti mādhyadinyaḥ' (āśva. śrau. 5. 5) iti ||
5. ta-yathā hvena nadyāṃ gacchantaṃ nadyāde- rasmadubhayapārśvavartinaḥ dhanārthinaḥ |
āpūrṇo asya kalaśaḥ svāhā sekkeva kośaṃ siṣice pibadhyai |
samu priyā āvavṛtranmadāya pradakṣiṇidbhi somāsa indram |
āpūrṇaḥ | asya | kalaśaḥ | svāhā | sektā'iva | kośam | siṣice | pibadhyai | sam | ū~ iti | priyāḥ | ā | avavṛtran | madāya | pra'dakṣiṇit | abhi | somāsaḥ | indram || 15 ||
he indra vasya tava pānārtha vkalaśaḥ droṇakalaśaḥ māṃmena vāpūrṇaḥ |
vsvāhā' svāhākṛto dattaśca somasahitaḥ kalaśaḥ vpibadhyai tava pānārtha vsiṣice |
yathā sektā secakaḥ jalapūrṇāt kośāt vteḥ sakāśāt jalapātrāntare siñcati tadvat |
vpriyāḥ svādutamāḥ vsomāsaḥ dattāste somāḥ vindraṃ tvām va

‘ gāṣṭa pratiṣṭhālipsayorgranthe ca ’ | asmān īracpratyayaḥ | ’ | dhakārasya bhakāraḥ ākārasya hrasvaśca ‘ gambhīragambhīrī ’ ( u. sū. 4. 475 ) ityanena nipātyate | ciśvaraḥ | sindhuḥ | ‘ syanda prastravaṇe ’ | ‘ syandeḥ saṃprasāraṇaṃ caśca ’ ityupratyayaḥ : saṃprasāraṇaṃ dukārasya bhakāraḥ | ‘ nit ’ ityanuvṛtterādyudāttaḥ | paripantaḥ | mantaḥ | agneḥ śatari rūpam | ‘ upasargaprādurbhyāṃmannircaparaḥ ’ iti padavam | kecit pare : ‘ kriyānvayam ’ icchanti | tadā padamanupapannam | pari | nipātasvaraḥ | santa : | pratyayasvaraḥ | varanta | ‘ vṛñ ’ varaṇe | bhauvādikaḥ | laṅi rūpam | nidhāna : | aruja : | ‘ rajo bhaṅge ’ ityasya laṅi rūpam | gavyam | gorvikāra ityarthe ‘ gopayamoryana ’ iti yat | ‘ yano'nāva ’ ityādyudāttatvam ||

parvatānāṃ girīṇāṃ śailānām upasthāt ujjhannirgamya uśatī samudragamanaṃ kāmayamāne| gamane dṛṣṭāntaḥ| aśveva yathā vipite mandirāto vimukte hāsamāne anyonyajavena spardhamāne| yadvā hyanyathāśve iva vaḍave iva svarayā gacchantyau parasparaṃ hyanyanyau| tathā gāveva śubhre| yathā dvau gāvau śobhamānau vartete tadvacchubhre śobhamāne| kiṃca mātarā| yathā mātarau dhenū rihāṇe| antarṇītamanyartho lihiḥ| vasmaṃ jihvayā leḍhumicchantyau śīghraṃ gacchantastadat samudraṃ gantaṃ javāta gacchantyau payasā saṃyukte vipāṭ| kūlavipāṭanāt vipāśanādvā vimocanādvā vipāṭ| sutudrī| su kṣipraṃ tu tnā tunneva dravati gacchatīti sutudrī| etannāmake nadyau javete samudraṃ prati śīghraṃ gacchataḥ| atra nirūktaṃ—parvatānā- mupasthādupasthānādṛśyau kāmayamāne aśva iva vimukte iti vā vipaṇe iti vā hāsamāne hyanyataḥ spardhāyo haryamāṇe vā gāvāviva śubhre śobhane mātare rihāṇe vipāṭchutūdrī payasā prajavete (niru. 9. 39) iti || uśatī| vaśa kāntau| abhya śaturdvitvāna mahiñyāvavi ityādinā prasāraṇam| vipite| piñ bandhane ityasya karmaṇi niṣṭhā| saṃhitāyāṃ parinivibhyaḥ sevasitamaya- siyusaha ityādinā patvam| gatiranantaraḥ iti gateḥ prakṛtisvaraḥ| hāsamāne| hāmatiḥ spardhārkarmā hase hasane vā| śānac| tasya lasārvadhātukasvare kṛtaṃ dhātusvaraḥ| rihāṇe| liha āsvādane| svaritatvādubhayapadī| śānac| adāditvācchapo luk| lakārasya rephaśchāndasaḥ| rephavalamasya ṇatvam| citvādantodāttaḥ| vipāṭ| paṭa gatau| paśa bādhanasparśanayoḥ iti vā ṇyantāvenau viprau| śakārasya vaśrādinā patvam| sutudrī| chāndasī rūpasiddhiḥ| javete| jṛ gatau| auvādiḥ| ḍittvādātmanepadam| āto ḍitaḥ iti iyādeśaḥ| nighātaḥ ||

indraiṣite prasravaṃ bhikṣamāṇe acchā samudraṃ rathyeva yāthaḥ| samārāṇe ūrmibhiḥ pinvamāne anyā vāmanyāmpaiti śubhre || 2 || indraiṣite itīndra'iṣite| pra'sravam| bhikṣamāṇe iti| acchā| samudram| rathye'iva| yāthaḥ| samārāṇe iti sam'aārāṇe| ūrmibhiḥ| pinvamāne iti| anyā| vām| anyām| arpi| eti| śubhre iti || 2 ||
he nadyau indraiṣite indreṇa preṣite prasravaṃ tanmendrasyānujñāṃ bhikṣamāṇe prārthayamāne yuvāṃ samudram acchā ābhimukhyena yāthaḥ gacchathaḥ|
samārāṇe parasparaṃ saṃgacchantyau ūrmibhiḥ taraṅgaiḥ pinvamāne parisarapradeśaṃ saṃtarpayantyau śubhre śobhamāne|
tathā vāṃ yuvayormadhye anyā ekā anyām aparām nadīm apyeti apigacchati|

1. ta-la-girīṇāṃ nāsti| 2. kha-ga-ca-pa-pha-bha-uśatī vipāṭchutūdrī; dha-ja-ṇa-vipāṭchutūdrī uśatī| 3. ta-anyonyaṃ javena| 4. ja-ṇa-hyanyanyau nāsti| 5. kha-ga-pra-ca-ja-ṇa-pa-pha-bha-gantuṃ prajavete| 6. kha-ga-ca-ja-ṇa-bha-śu; ta-tujnā| 7. ta-etannāmike| 8. ja-ṇa-samudraprāntam| 9. la-ityasya| 10. ta-svaratvam| 11. kha-ga-ja-ṇa-spaśa| 12. kha-ga-ca-ja-ṇa-bha-iti nāsti| 13. ta-niṣṭhāyām|

‘tṛtīyā karmaṇi’ iti pūrvapadasvaraḥ | prasavam | ‘pū preraṇe’ ityasya ap | thāthādisavaraḥ | bhikṣamāṇe | ‘bhikṣa yācayāyām’ | ātmanepadī | śānaco lasārvadhātukasvareṇānudāttatve dhātusvaraḥ | ryaiva | rathyyamau | tasyedam ityarthe ‘rathādyat’ iti yatpratyayaḥ | tiścaritaḥ | ivena vibhaktyalopaḥ ityādi | yādhaḥ | yāterleṭi rūpam | samārāne | ‘ṛ gatau’ ityasya liṭ | saṃpūrvasyāteḥ ‘samo gamiḥ’ ityādinā ātmanepadatvāt tasya kānajādeśaḥ | ‘ṛcchahṛtām’ iti guṇaḥ | pivvamāne | ‘pitra mecane’ | bhūvādiḥ | lasārvadhātukasvareṇa śānaco'nudāttatve dhātusvaraḥ 3 ||
vṛtsāmiva mātaraṃ saṃrihāṇe samānaṃ yonimanu saṃcarantī ||
acchā | sindhum | mātṛ'tamām | āyāsam | vi'pāśam | urvīm |

dyorbahuvacanaṃ pūjārtham | tāsāmasmākaṃ sargatakaḥ sarge gamane pravṛtta: prasavaḥ udyoga: na vartave nivartanāya' na bhavati | kiṃyu: kimicchan asau vipra: brāhmaṇa: nadya: nadī: asmān johavīti bhṛśamāhvayati || enā | etacchabdasya tṛtīyāyā enādeśa: | supāṃ suluk ' iti tṛtīyāyā ājādeśa: | aḍidam ' iti vibhakterudāttatvam | pivamānā: | piva secane ' | devakṛtam | tṛtīyā karmaṇi ' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvara: | vartave | vṛta vartane ' | tumarthe tavenpratyaya: | nisvara: | sargataka: | ke ca ' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvara: | kiṃyu: | kimicchan | kvaci māntāvyayapratiṣedha: ' (pā. sū. 3. 1. 8. 1) iti chāndasāvādana pratiṣedho na bhavatīti kvaca | kyācchandasi ' ityapratyaya: | pratyayasvara: | nadya: | chāndaso yaṇādeśa: | johavīti | heja: yaṅluki abhyastasya ca ' iti saṃprasāraṇe kṛte guṇo yaṅluko: ' ityabhyāsasya guṇa: | yaṅo vā ' iti iḍāgama: | guṇa: | nicāta: ||
ramadhvaṃ me varcase somyāya ṛtāvarīrupa muhūrtamevaiḥ |
pra sindhumacchā bṛhatī manīṣāvasturahe kuśikasya sunuḥ ||
ramadhvam | me | varcase | somyāya | ṛtavarīḥ | upa | muhūrtam | evaiḥ | pra | sindhum | accha | bṛhatī | manīṣā | avasyuḥ | ahe | kuśikasya | sunuḥ || 5 ||
tadhyo he nadyo yūyaṃ me viśvāmitrasya mama somyāya |
uttīryāhaṃ somaṃ saṃpādayāmītyevaṃ somasaṃpādine varcase tadartham evaiḥ |
sāmānyena nadīpūyamānāsu samīhitaṃ prayojanamakurvantīpu purovartinīṃ sunutrīṃ prati brūte |
kuśikasya rājarṣe: sunu: viśvāmitro'haṃ bṛhatī mahatyā manīṣā manīṣayā stutyā avasyu: ātmano rakṣaṇamicchan san sindhuṃ sutudrīṃ tvām accha ābhimukhyena pra ahe prakarṣeṇa hvayāmi |
atra niruktam— upamadhvaṃ me varcase somyāya somasaṃpādina ṛtāvarīrṛtavasya ṛtamudakanāma pratyuta bhavati muhūrtamevairayaneravairnavairvā |
prābhihyāmi sindhuṃ bṛhatyā mahatyā manīṣayā manasa īṣayā stutyā prajñayā vāvanāya kuśikasya sunuḥ |
vano ra ca ' iti ṅīp rephaśāntādeśa: |
na: kye ' iti nakārāntasya padasaṃjñāyā niyamitatvādana sakārasya rurna bhavati |
1. kha-ga-gha-ca-ja-pa-pha-bha-vartanāya; ṇa-vartamānāya; na-nivartanāya; sa-nivartamānāya | 2. ca- idaṃśabdasya | 3. ga-ca-na-bha-sevane; ja-ṇa-prīṇane | 4. la-haya: | 5. ta-sāmānyena ca |
de॒vo̭'naya॒tsavi̭tā su॒pāṇi̭stasya॒ vaya̭ṃ pra॒savḙ yāma u॒rvīḥ ||
indraḥ | a॒smān | a̭radat | va॒jra̭bāhuḥ | apa̭ | a॒ha॒n | vṛ॒tram | pa॒ri॒dhim | na॒dīnā̭m | de॒vaḥ | a॒na॒yat | sa॒vi॒tā | su॒pāṇiḥ | tasya̭ | va॒yam | pra॒savḙ | yāmaḥ | u॒rvīḥ || 6 ||

nadyaḥ pratyūcuḥ | he viśvāmitra vajrabāhuḥ | vajrayukto bāhuryasyāsau vajrabāhuḥ | tādṛśo balavān indraḥ nadyaḥ asmān aradat | radatiḥ khanatikarmā | avanat | kathamakhanat | ucyate | nadīnāṃ śabdakāriṇāmapāṃ paridhiṃ parito nihitamudakamantaḥ kṛtvā vartamānamityarthaḥ | tādṛśaṃ vṛtram | vṛṇotyākāśamiti vṛtro meghaḥ | taṃ megham apāhan jaghāna | tasmin hate āpaḥ patitāḥ | nābhiragacchantībhirvyaṃ khātaḥ | evaṃ meghahanadvāreṇāvanat | na kevalamakhanat kiṃ tarhi savitā sarvasya jagataḥ prerakaḥ | supāṇiḥ śobhanahastaḥ utpattisthitikartṛtvāttādṛśaḥ | devaḥ dyotamānaḥ indraḥ asmān anayat | meghabhedanaṃ kṛtvā udakapreraṇena samudramapūrayat | tasya tādṛśasāmarthyenasya indrasya pramave abhyanujñāyāṃ vartamānāḥ urvīḥ udakaiḥ prabhṛtāḥ vayaṃ yāmaḥ gacchāmaḥ | na tatra vacanādaparamāmaṃha | uktārthaṃ yāsko bravīti—' indro asmānaradadvajrabāhū radatiḥ khanatikarmāpāhantya paridhi nadīnāmiti vyākhyānam | devo'nayatsavitā supāṇiḥ kalyāṇapāṇiḥ | pāṇiḥ daṇāyateḥ pūjākarmaṇaḥ pragṛhya pāṇi devān pūjayanti | tasya vayaṃ prasave yāma urvīrhyaḥ ' ( niru. 5. 26 ) iti || aradat | radaterlaṅi rūpam | vajrabāhuḥ | bahuvrīhau pūrvapadasvaraḥ | ahan | hanterlaṅi rūpam | nighātaḥ | paridhim | ' ḍudhāñ dhāraṇapoṣaṇayoḥ ' dṛśyasmāt karmaṇyupasarge ' ghoḥ kiḥ ' iti vipratyayaḥ | āno lopaḥ | kruduttarapadasvaraḥ | anayana | nayaterlaṅi rūpam | supāṇiḥ | ' daṇa vyavahāre ranutau ca ' | ' aśipaṇākhyo ruḍāyalukī ca ' ( u. sū. 4. 572 ) inīṇ | āyaluka | bahuvrīhau ' nasubhyām ' iti svaraḥ | prasave | ' pū preraṇe ' | ' ṛdorap ' iti bhāve'ppratyayaḥ | ' thāthaghantā ' ityuttara- padāntodāttatvam | yāmaḥ | ' yā prāpaṇe ' dṛśyasya laṭi rūpam | nighātaḥ | urvīḥ | uruśabdāt ' voto guṇavacanāt ' iti ṅīp | ' vā chandasi ' iti savarṇadīrghaḥ | pratyayasvaraḥ ||
pravācya̭ṃ śaśva॒dhā vī॒rya̭ tadindra̭sya॒ karma̭ yadahi॒ṃ vivṛ̭ścat |
pravācyam | śaśvadhā | vīryam | tat | indra̭sya | karma̭ | yat | ahi̭m | vivṛ̭ścat | vi | va॒jreṇa̭ | pa॒ri॒sada̭ḥ | ja॒ghāna | ā॒yan | āpa̭ḥ | a॒ya॒nam | i॒ccha̭mānāḥ || 7 ||
yā'yamindraḥ ahiṃ meghaṃ vivṛścan udakapreraṇārthaṃ jaghānati yat karma chedanarūpaṃ tat idaṃ tasya indrasya vīrya sāmarthyaṃ śaśvadhā sarvadā pravācyaṃ prakarṣeṇa vacanīyam |
tathā sa indraḥ pariṣadḥ paritaḥ sīdatān pratibandhakāriṇo'surān vajreṇa vi jaghāna |

'icchamānāḥ icchantyaḥ 'āpaḥ 'āyanra yānti || pravācyam | 'vaca paribhāṣaṇe' ityasmāt 'ṛhaloṇyat' iti ṇyat | giravādyupadhāvṛddhiḥ | 'vaco'śabdasaṃjñāyām' (pā. sū. 7. 3. 67) iti kutvābhāvaḥ | vyatyayenādyudāttatvam | yadvā vācyate: 'aco yat' | 'yato'nāvaḥ' iti svaraḥ | śaśvadhā | śaśvacchabdāt svārthe dhāpratyayastakāralopaśca draṣṭavyaḥ | vivṛścata | 'ovaśca chedane' | tudādiḥ | laṅi 'grahivyāvayi' ityādinā saṃprasāraṇam | 'saha supā' ityatra saheti yogavibhāgāt samāmaḥ | samāsasvaraḥ | pariṣadaḥ | kip | saṃhitāyāṃ 'sadiprateḥ' iti padavam | jaghāna | hanterliṭi ṇali rūpam | nighātaḥ | āyan | 'aya gatau' ityasya laṅi rūpam | pādāditvādanighātaḥ | icchamānāḥ | 'iṣu icchāyām' ityasmāt vyatyayena śānac | tasya lasārvadhātukasvare kṛte pratyayasvaraḥ ||

o pu sva̭māraḥ kāra॒ve śṛṇota yayau vo̭ durāda̭nasā rathḙna | ni ṣū na̭madhvaṃ bha̭vatā supā॒rā a̭dhoakṣāḥ sindhavaḥ srotayābhiḥ || 9 || o iti | su | sva̭sāraḥ | kāra॒ve | śṛṇota | yayau | vaḥ | durāt | anasā | rathḙna | ni | su | na̭madhvam | bha̭vata | su'pā॒rāḥ | adhaḥ'akṣāḥ | sindhavaḥ | srotayābhiḥ || 9 ||
'svasāraḥ bhaginyaḥ 'sindhavaḥ he nadyaḥ 'kārave stotraṃ kurvāṇasya mama vacanaṃ 'su' suṣṭhu 'o' 'śṛṇota śṛṇuteva' |
'anasā śakaṭena 'rathena ca saha 'dūrāt viprakṛṣṭādvāt 'vaḥ yuṣmān 'yayau prāpto'smi |
rathādīnāṃ tīrāt sukhenārohaṇārohaṇe yathā syātāṃ tathā śobhanarodhasaśca bhavata |

'śru śravaṇe ' ityasya loṭi tapratyayasya 'tasanasanathanāśca ' iti tatrādeśaḥ |

etāmṛcayāska evaṃ vyācaṣṭe- ‘āśruvāma te kāro vacanāni yāhi durādanasā ca rathena ca ninamāma te pāyayamāneva yoṣā putraṃ maryāyeva kanyā pariṣvajanāya ninamā iti vā’ (niru. 2.27) iti kāro |

yadaṅga tvā bharatāḥ saṃtareyurgavyaṃ grāmaṃ iṣita indrajūtaḥ |

he nadyaḥ ‘yat yasmāt yuṣmābhiruttīryoḥ mamottaraṇamabhyanujñātaṃ tasmāt bharatāḥ : bharatakulajā madīyāḥ sarve tvā parasparamekatāmāpannā nadīṃ tvāṃ saṃtareyuḥ : samyagguttīrṇā bhaveyuḥ |
‘gavyam gā udakāni tarītumicchan iṣitaḥ : tvāmabhyanujñātaḥ indrajūtaḥ : yuṣmākaṃ pravartakendreṇa ca preritaḥ grāmaḥ : bharatānāṃ saṃghaḥ arṣāt maṃtarena |
yataḥ sargataktaḥ : gamanāya pravṛttaḥ prasavaḥ : tepāmudyogaḥ ahaṃ pūrvaṃ yuṣmābhiranujñātaḥ |
ahaṃ tu yajñiyānāṃ yajñārhāṇāṃ vaḥ : yuṣmākaṃ sumatiṃ śobhanāṃ stutim ā vṛṇe sarvataḥ saṃbhaje ||
‘ṛ gatau’ ityasya leṭi tipi ‘sibbahulam’ iti sip |

' indraḥ pūrbhin ' ityekādaśarcaṃ pañcamaṃ sūktaṃ vaiśāmitraṃ ṛṣamaindram |
agniṣṭome mādhyandinasavane brāhmaṇācchaṃsiśastre ' indraḥ pūrbhin ' iti sūktam |
' hotrakāṇām ' iti khaṇḍe sūtritam - ' indraḥ pūrbhidudu brahmāṇi ' ( āśva. śrau. 5. 16 ) iti |

1. kha-ga-ca-ja-ṇa-ta-na-bha-sa- ‘pratyayasvaraḥ’ nāsti | 2. ta-na-bha-sa-gośabdasya ca | 3. kha-ga- ja-ṇa-pa-pha-bha-svīkṛtakāmarūpāḥ santaḥ | 4. gha-ca- ‘yadvā......prajñāvantaḥ’ nāsti | 5. ta-svarūpam | 6. kha-ga-ca-ṇa-la-pūraṇam |
ᵛtat tasmāt ᵛsavituḥ sarvasya jagato'ntaryāmitayā prerayituḥ ᵛasya indrasya ᵛme mama ᵛhira- ṇyayīṃ suvarṇamayīm ᵛamatiṃ dīptiṃ ᵛnakiḥ ko vā paricchinatti khalu |
ᵛyāṃ madīyāṃ dīptim ᵛaśiśret ya āśrayati saḥ ᵛsuṣṭutī śobhanayā stutyā stutaḥ san ᵛviśvaminve sarvasya saṃtarpayittyau ᵛrodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau ᵛā ᵛvane svakīyatayā sarvato vṛṇute |
yathā yoṣā strī janimāni jātāni ᵛaparayāni vṛṇoti tadvat |
‘ṛtvayavāstadhya- vāstvamādvīhiraṇyayāni chandasi’ iti nipātāt mayaṭo makāralopaḥ |
yuvaṃ pratnasya sādhatho maho yahaivīṃ svastiḥ pari ṇaḥ syātām |
gopājihvasya tasthuṣo virūpā viśvai paśyanti māyinaḥ kṛtāni ||
yuvam | pratnasya | sādhathaḥ | mahaḥ | yat | daivīṃ | svastiḥ | pari | naḥ | syātām | gopājihvasya | tasthuṣaḥ | virūpā | viśvai | paśyanti | māyinaḥ | kṛtāni || 9 ||
he indrāvaruṇau ᵛyuvaṃ yuvāṃ ᵛpratnasya stotuḥ ᵛmahaḥ tādṛśaṃ śreyaḥ ᵛsādhathaḥ sādhayathaḥ |
ᵛyadaivīṃ ᵛsvastiḥ yadidaṃ devasaṃbandhi śreyaḥ svārājyalakṣaṇam |
kiṃca yuvāṃ ᵛnaḥ asmān ᵛpari paritaḥ ᵛsyātaṃ rakṣakau bhavetām |
goptrī jihvā mā bibhītetyetādṛśī vāgyasya sa tathoktaḥ |
ᵛtasthuṣaḥ sthiratarasyendrasya ᵛvirūpā nānāvidhāni vṛtrahananādīni ᵛkṛtāni karmāṇi ᵛpaśyanti |
yuṣmacchabdasya dvivacane ‘yavāvau dvivacane’ (pā. sū. 7. 2. 92) iti yuvādeśaḥ |
‘gupū rakṣaṇe’ ityasya āyapratyayāntasya kvipi atolopa- yalopayoḥ kṛtayo rūpaṃ gopā iti |
‘ṣṭhā gatinivṛttau’ ityasya ksau ‘vasvekājādasām’ iti prāsya hṛṭaḥ |
‘saṃprasāraṇaṃ saṃprasāraṇāśrayaṃ ca balīyaḥ’ iti saṃprasāraṇasya balīyastvātnivṛttiḥ |
1. ta-prasavituḥ | 2. ta-janitāni | 3. kha-gha-pa-nu pūraṇaḥ; na-la-sa-’ nuḥ pūraṇaḥ’ nāsti | 4. ca-pha-ameratipratyayaḥ | 5. kha-ga-ca-na-svarājyalakṣaṇam |

śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau | śṛṇvantamugramutaye samatsu ghantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām || 10 || śunam | huvema | magha'vānam | indram | asmin | bhare | nṛtamam | vāja'sātau | śṛṇvantam | ugram | ūtaye | samat'su | ghantam | vṛtrāṇi | sam'jitam | dhanānām ||10||
tatra ‘ indraṃ matiḥ ’ iti navarcaṃ prathamaṃ sūktaṃ vaiśvāmitraṃ traiṣṭubhamaindram |

indraṃ matirhṛda ā vacyamānācchā patiṃ stomataṣṭā jigāti | yā jāgṛvirvidathe śasyamānendra yatte jāyate viddhi tasya || 1 || indram | matiḥ | hṛdaḥ | ā | vacyamānā | accha | patim | stoma'taṣṭā | jigāti | yā | jāgṛviḥ | vidathe | śasyamānā | indra | yat | te | jāyate | viddhi | tasya || 1 ||
he indra ᵥhṛdaḥ hṛdayāt ᵥvacyamānā ᵥstomataṣṭā stomakāribhiḥ kṛtā ᵥmatiḥ stutiḥ ᵥpatiṃ sarvasya jagataḥ svāminaṃ svām ᵥaccha abhilakṣya ᵥā ᵥjigāti samantāt gacchatu |
ᵥyā madīyā stutiḥ ᵥjāgṛviḥ stutyasya tava jāgaraṇa kurvāṇā ᵥvidathe yajñe ᵥśasyamānā bhavati |
he ᵥindra ᵥte tvadarthaṃ ᵥyat stotraṃ mattaḥ ᵥjāyate tat ᵥviddhi jānīhi |
‘ takṣū tvakṣū tanūkaraṇe ’ ityasya karmaṇi niṣṭhā |
‘ vida jñāne ’ ityasya loṭi heḥ : ‘ hujhalbhyo hedhiḥ ’ iti dhyādeśaḥ |

divāścidā puṭhyā jāyamānā vi jāgṛvirvidathe śasyamānā | bhadrā vastrāṇyarjunā vasānā seyamusme saṃnajā pityā dhīḥ || 2 || divaḥ | cit | ā | puṭhyā | jāyamānā | vi | jāgṛviḥ | vidathe | śasyamānā | bhadrā | vastrāṇi | arjunā | vasānā | sā | iyam | asme iti | sam'jā | pityā | dhīḥ ||2||

he indra 'divaśrit dyotamānāt sūryādapi 'pūrvyā pūrve bhavā upaḥkālasaṃbandhinī 'ā 'jāyamānā yā stutilakṣaṇā vāk vibhavati 'seyaṃ vāk 'vidathe yajñe 'śayamānā 'jāgṛtiḥ stutyasya tava jāgaraṇa kurvāṇā 'bhadrā kalyāṇāni 'arjunā śuddhavarṇāni 'caruāṇi yogyatayā tejāṃsi 'vasānā 'asme asmākaṃ 'pityā pitṛkramāgata|
ata eva 'sanajā purātanī satī 'dhīḥ tava stutirbhavati ||
pitṛśabdāttata āgata ityarthe ' pitṛyacca ' iti yatpratyayaḥ |
yamā cidatra yamasūrasūta jihvāyā agraṃ patadā hasthāt |
vapūṃṣi jātā mithunā saṃcete tamohanā tarpuṣo budha etāṃ ||
yamā | cit | atra | yama'sūḥ | asūta | jihvāyāḥ | agram | patat | ā | hi | asthāt | vapūṃṣi | jātā | mithunā | sacete iti | tamaḥ'hanā | tarpuṣaḥ | budhne | ā'itā || 3 ||

prasaṃgādupaḥkālaṃ praśaṃsati | 'yamasūḥ | yamau yamalau sūta iti yamasūrūpobhimāninī devatā | sā 'yamā yamalāśvinau 'atra upaḥkāle 'asūta | aśvinoratra śayamānatvāttāvaśvinau stotuṃ mama 'jihvāyāḥ 'agraṃ 'patat cañcalam 'ā 'asthāt 'hi tiṣṭhati khalu | 'tamohanā 'tamaso hantārau 'tapuṣaḥ | tapyasmin sūrye iti tapuḥ divasaḥ | tasya 'budhne mūle 'etā etāvāgatau 'mithunā parasparaṃ saṃgatau 'tāvaśvinau 'jātā utpannau 'vapūṃṣi | upyante nidhīyante iti vapūṃṣi upaḥkāle kriyamāṇāni śastrā- dīni karmāṇi | 'sacete saṃgacchataḥ || yamasūḥ | 'ṣaḍ prāṇigarbhavimocane ' ityasya kip | kṛduttarapadasvaraḥ | asūta | tasyaiva dhātorlaṅi adādivācchapo luk | nighātaḥ | patat | ' patalū gatau ' | śatṛsārva- dhātukasvare dhātusvaraḥ | asthāt | ' ṣṭhā gatinivṛttau ' | luṅi rūpam | hiyogādanighātaḥ | vapūṃṣi | ' ḍuvap bījasaṃtāne ' | ' artipavapiyajitanidhanitapibhyo nit ' iti usipratyayaḥ | ' nicca ' ityuktvādādyudāttaḥ | sacete | ' paca samavāye ' ityasya laṭi rūpam | tapuṣaḥ | ' tapa saṃtāpe ' | ' atipvapi ' ityādinā usiḥ | budhne | ' bandha bandhane ' | ' bandherdhividhudhī ca ' (u. sū. 3. 285 ) iti napratyayaḥ | dhividhudhī etāvādekau dhātoḥ | pratyayasvaraḥ | etā | ' iṇ gatau ' ityasya karmaṇi niṣṭhā | ' gatiranantaraḥ ' iti gateḥ svaraḥ ||
nakireṣāṃ ninditā martyeṣu ye asmākaṃ pitaro goṣu yodhāḥ |
indraṃ eṣāṃ duhitā māhināvānudrotrāṇi sasṛje daṃsanāvān ||
nakiḥ | eṣām | ninditā | martyeṣu | ye | asmākam | pitaraḥ | goṣu | yodhāḥ | indraḥ | eṣām | duhitā | māhinā'vān | ut | gotrāṇi | sasṛje | daṃsanā'vān || 4 ||
1. kha-ga-ca-ja-ṇa-na-pha-bha-la-kalyāṇā | 2. gha-ja-ṇa-pitṛkramādagatā | 3. la-tamohanā nāma | 4. ta-deśaḥ | 5. na-la-parasparasaṃgatā | 6. la-ityasmāt |
he indra satre pravṛttānām ᵥasmākaṃ ᵥye ᵥpitaraḥ aṅgirasaḥ ᵥgoṣu paṇibhirapahṛteṣu tannimittaṃ ᵥyodhāḥ yoddhāro vartante teṣām ᵥeṣāṃ ᵥmartyeṣu ᵥninditā dūṣakaḥ ᵥnakiḥ na kaścidasti |
ᵥmāhināvān mahimopetaḥ ᵥdaṃsanāvān vṛtrahananādikarmavān ᵥindraḥ ᵥeṣām aṅgirasāṃ ᵥhaṃhitā haṃhitāni samṛddhāni ᵥgotrāṇi gavāṃ vṛndāni ᵥut ᵥsasṛje tebhyo'ṅgirobhyo dadau||
gavāṃ samūha ityarthe ‘khalagorathāt’ ityanuvṛttau ‘iniñakaccayaśca’ (pā. sū. 4. 2. 51) iti gośabdāt ñapratyayaḥ |
daśapeye niṣkevalye nividdhānīyasya purastāt ‘sakhā ha yatra’ ityeṣā |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘sakhā ha yatra sakhibhirnarvairiti nividdhānīyayorādhe’ (āśva. śrau. 9. 3) iti||
sakhā ha yatra sakhibhirnarvagvairabhijvā satvabhirgā anugman |
satyaṃ tadindrau daśabhirdaśagvaiḥ sūrya viveda tamasi kṣiyantam ||
sakhā | ha | yatra | sakhibhiḥ | navagvaiḥ | abhi'jvā | satvabhiḥ | gāḥ | anu'gman | satyam | tat | indraḥ | daśa'bhiḥ | daśagvaiḥ | sūryam | viveda | tamasi | kṣiyantam || 5 ||
ᵥsakhibhiḥ samānasthānaiḥ ᵥsatvabhiḥ indramabhitaḥ sīdadbhiḥ ᵥnavagvaiḥ |
medhātithiprabhṛtayo'ṅgirasaḥ kecicca māsān satramanuṣṭhāya phalaṃ lebhire keciddaśa māsānanuṣṭhāyeti |
tatra ye nava māsān satra- manuṣṭhāya labdhaphalā udatiṣṭhan te navagvāḥ |

taiḥ satvabhiḥ aṅgirobhiḥ ᵥsakhā samānasthānaḥ ᵥindraḥ ᵥyatra yasmin bile paṇibhiniruddhāḥ ᵥgāḥ abhilakṣya ᵥabhijñu abhigatajānukaṃ yathā bhavati tathā ᵥajugman anugacchan ᵥindraḥ ᵥtat tatra bile ᵥdaśagvaiḥ |
ye daśa māsān satramanuṣṭhāya labdhaphalā udatiṣṭhan te daśagvāḥ |
ᵥdaśabhiḥ daśasaṃkhyākairṛṣibhiḥ sahitaḥ san ᵥtamasi bilavartinyandhakāre ᵥkṣiyantaṃ nivasantaṃ ᵥsatyaṃ yathārthaprakāśaṃ ᵥsūrya ᵥviveda lebhe |
tato labdhaprakāśaḥ sa indrastā gā ānīyāṅgirobhyaḥ prādāditi bhāvaḥ |
‘prasaṃbhyāṃ jānunojuḥ’ iti vidhīyamāno juḥ abheruttarasya dhyasyayena bhavati |
‘padu viśaraṇagatyavasādaneṣu’ ityasmāt ‘pra īrasadyostuṭ ca’ iti kanipratyayaḥ |

1. na-la-sa- 'haṃhitā' nāsti | 2. ca-saṃbhṛtāni | 3. kha-ga-ca-ja-ṇa-pa-pha-bha-dadeṃ | ut pūraṇaḥ | 4. kha-ga-ca-ja-ṇa-pha--samānasthānaḥ | 5. na-la-sa- 'āhīṃ pūraṇau' nāsti | 6. kha-ga- ta-na-ḍisṭvam | 7. ja-ṇa-la-ityuktena | ka, 2-49
śapo luki kṛte ' gamahana ' ' ityādinā ' upadhālopaḥ | prādisamāsaḥ | śatrasvaraḥ | viveda | ' vida jñāne ' ityasmāt liṭi ṇali rūpam | kṣiyantam | ' kṣi nivāsagatyoḥ ' ityasya śatar rūpam || 25||
indro madhu saṃbhṛtamustriyāyāṃ padvirveda śaphavanme goḥ |
guhā hitaṃ guhyaṃ gūḻahampsu hastai dadhe dakṣiṇe dakṣiṇāvān ||
indraḥ | madhu | sam'bhṛtam | ustriyāyām | pat'vat | viveda | śapha'vat | name | goḥ | guhā | hitam | guhyam | gūḻaham | apa'su | hastai | dadhe | dakṣiṇe | dakṣiṇa'vān || 6 ||
indraḥ ' ustriyāyāṃ kṣīradadhyādikrameṇotsāviṇyāṃ ' bhogavatyāṃ ' gavi ' saṃbhṛtaṃ saṃpāditaṃ ' madhu kṣīrādi ' viveda ajñāsīt |
tatastadartha ' padvat pādyukta ' śaphavat khuropetaṃ godhanaṃ viveda lebhe |

tathā ' dakṣiṇāvān audāryavān samarthaḥ sa indraḥ ' guhā guhāyāṃ ' hitaṃ ' guhyaṃ pracchannam ata eva ' apsu antarikṣe ' gūḻahaṃ ' gūḍhacāriṇaṃ māyinamasuraṃ ' dakṣiṇe ' haste ' dadhe dadhāra amahīt ityarthaḥ |
dvitīyāeke ' śrudhī havam ' iśyasmin varge ' guhā hitam ' iśyetat samyagbhyadhāyi ( ṛ. saṃ. 2. 11. 5 ) ||
' guhū saṃvaraṇe ' ityasmāt ' śaṃsiguhibhyo veti vaktavyam ' iti kyap |
saṃhitāyām ' anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate ' iti pūrvapadasya dīrghaḥ |
imā giraḥ somapāḥ somavṛddha juṣasvendra purutamasya kāroḥ ||
jyotiḥ | vṛṇīta | tamasaḥ | vi'jānan | āre | syāma | duḥ'itāt | abhīkeṃ | imāḥ | giraḥ | soma'pāḥ | soma'vṛddha | juṣasva | indra | puru'tamasya | kāroḥ || 7 ||
tamasaḥ rātreḥ sakāśāt ' vijānan viśeṣeṇa jānan prādurbhavan sūryātmaka indraḥ ' jyoti- rvṛṇīta |
vayaṃ vduritāt pāpāt vāre dūre pāpavarjitāḥ santaḥ vabhīke bhayarahite sthāne vsyāma bhavema |
vsomapāḥ somasya pātaḥ ata eva vsomavṛddha somapāneṣu vṛddha he vindra vpuru- tamasya |
purun bahūn' śatrūn tāmayati galāpayatīti purutamaḥ |
tādṛśasya tava vkāroḥ stotraṃ kurvāṇasya ṛtvijaḥ vimāḥ stutilakṣaṇāḥ vgiraḥ vācaḥ vjuṣasva sevasva' ||
'nañsubhyām' ityanto- dāttatve prāpte 'kapi pūrvam' (pā. sū. 6. 2. 173 ) iti pūrvasyāntodāttatvam |
'tamu glāne' ityasmāt ṇyantāt pacādyaci 'parādiśchandasi bahulam' ityuttarapadādyudāttatvam ||
jyotiryajñāya rodasī anu pyādāre syāma duritasya bhūraiḥ |
bhūri ciddhi tuṃjato martyasya supārāsau vasavo bṛhaṇāvat ||
jyotiḥ | yajñāya | rodasī iti | anu | syāt | āre | syām | duḥ'itasya | bhūraiḥ | bhūri | cit | hi | tuṃjataḥ | martyasya | su'pārāsaḥ | vasavaḥ | bṛhaṇā'vat || 8 ||
he indra vjyotiḥ jagatprakāśakaḥ sūryaḥ vyajñāya agnihotrādikarmakaraṇāya vrodasī dyāvā- pṛthivyau vanu vdhyāt anubhavat prakāśayatu |
vayaṃ vbhūraiḥ prabhūtasya vduritasya pāpasya vāre dūre vsyāma bhavema |

he vvasavaḥ sarvasya vāsayitāra indradāya vsupārāsaḥ supārāḥ śobhanapārāḥ stutyābhimukhīkartuṃ śakyā yūyaṃ vbhūri vcit atiprabhūtaṃ vbṛhaṇāvat samṛddhiyuktaṃ dhanaṃ vtuṃjataḥ bhūripradasya vmartyasya prayacchatha' |
śṛṇvantamugramūtaye sumatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||
śunam | huvema | magha'vānam | indram | asmin | bhare | nṛtamam | vāja'sātau | śṛṇvantam | ugram | ūtaye | sumatsu | ghnantam | vṛtrāṇi | sam'jitam | dhanānām ||9||
