5. kha-ityevaṃ pūrvameva vyākhyātā; ja-ṇa- iti pūrvavat, na-vyākhyātā |
yasya niḥśvasitaṃ vedā yo vedebhyo'khilaṃ jagat |
‘indra tvā’ iti navacaṃ dvitīyaṃ sūktaṃ vaiśvāmitraṃ gāyatramaindram |
tathā cānukrāntam—‘indra tvā gāyatraṃ hi’ iti |
agniṣṭome prātaḥsavane brāhmaṇā- cchaṃsiśastre idaṃ sūktam |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘indra tvā vṛṣabhamuddebhitīti tisraḥ’ (āśva. śrau. 5. 10) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘indra tvā vṛṣabhaṃ maruto yasya’ (āśva. śrau. 5. 5) iti ||
indre tvā vṛṣabhaṃ vayaṃ sute somaṃ havāmahe |
indre | tvā | vṛṣabham | vayam | sute | some | havāmahe | saḥ | pāhi | madhvaḥ | andhasaḥ ||1||
indau savati somarase ramate krīḍatīti indraḥ |
indra ṛtuvidaṃ sutaṃ somaṃ harya puruṣṭuta |
indra | ṛtu'vidam | sutam | somam | harya | puru'stuta | piba | ā | vṛṣasva | tātṛpim || 2 ||
he indra ṛtuvidaṃ kratoḥ prajñāyā lambhakaṃ sutama abhiputamama somaṃ harya pātuṃ kāmayasva |
he puruṣṭuta pururbhirbahubhiḥ stutendra tātṛpiṃ tarpakamāpyāyanakāriṇamimaṃ somaṃ piba |
pītāmimaṃ somam ā vṛṣasva jaṭhare siñca |
yathā nābheryo na patati tathā dhārayeti bhāvaḥ ||
'tṛpa prīṇane' ityasmāt 'chandasi sadādibhyo darśanāt' (pā. sū. 3. 2. 161. 2) iti kin |
indra pra ṇo dhitāvānaṃ yajñaṃ viśvebhiridevaiḥ |
indra | pra | naḥ | dhita'vānam | yajñam | viśvebhiḥ | devaiḥ | tira | stavāna | viśvapate || 3 ||

he stavāna stotṛbhiḥ stūyamāna viśvapate viśāṃ marutāṃ pate he indra viśvebhirdevaiḥ sarvaiḥ yajanīyairdevaiḥ sahitastvaṃ dhitāvānam | vandyate saṃbhayate iti vānaṃ haviḥ | dhitaṃ nihitaṃ haviryasya tam | saṃbhṛtahaviṣkamityarthaḥ | asmadīyamimaṃ yajñaṃ pra tira prakarṣeṇa vardhaya | haviḥsvīkaraṇena saṃpūrṇa kuru iti bhāvaḥ || naḥ | 'upasargādbahulam' iti saṃhitāyāṃ ṇatvam | dhitāvānam | 'dhudhāñ dhāraṇapoṣaṇayoḥ' ityasmānniṣṭhā | bahuvrīhau pūrvapadasvaraḥ | tira | taraterdhyayanena śaḥ | pratyayasvaraḥ | stavāna | 'ṣṭuñ stutau' | 'sammānacca ratuvaḥ' ityupapadābhāve'pi karmaṇyānacapratyayaḥ | āmantrita tvāt nighātaḥ ||
indra somāḥ sutā ime tava pra yanti satpate |
indra | somāḥ | sutāḥ | ime | tava | pra | yanti | sat'pate | kṣayam | candrāsaḥ | indavaḥ || 4 ||
he satpate indra candrāsaḥ āhlādayitāraḥ indavaḥ dīptāḥ sutāḥ abhiputāḥ ime asmābhirdattāḥ somāḥ tava kṣayam |

1. kha-ga-ca-ja-ṇa-bha-āduttaratvāt | 2. ja-ṇa-yajanīyadevaiḥ | 3. kha-ga-ca-na-bha-la-sa-' tava ' nāsti | 4. kha-ga-ja-ṇa-na-bha-sa-antodātte | 5. kha-ga-ca-na-bha-la-sa-'dīptau; ja-ṇa-' dīptau ca ' nāsti | 6. la-ityasugāgamaḥ |
dadhiṣvā jaṭharai sutaṃ somamiṃdra vareṇyam | tarva yukṣāsa indavaḥ || 5 || dadhiṣva | jaṭharai | sutam | somam | indra | vareṇyam | tarva | yukṣāsaḥ | indavaḥ || 5 ||

he indra vareṇyaṃ sarvairviraṇīyaṃ sutama abhiputaṃ somaṃ jaṭhare dadhiṣva dhāraya | indavaḥ dīkṣā ime somāḥ tava yukṣāsaḥ | divi kṣiyanti nivasantīti yukṣāsaḥ | atastvaṃ svabhūtān tān dhārayeti bhāvaḥ || dadhiṣva | dadhāterloṭi rūpam | 'āgamā anudāttāḥ' itīṭo'judāttatvāt pratyayasvaraḥ | vareṇyam | 'vṛṅ saṃbhaktau' | 'vṛṅ eṇyaḥ' iti eṇyapratyayaḥ | vṛṣādivādādyudāttaḥ | yukṣāsaḥ | kṣiyateḥ 'anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate' iti ḍapratyayaḥ | kṛduttarapadasvaraḥ || ||5||
girvaṇaḥ pāhi naḥ sutaṃ madhodhārābhirajyase | indra tvādātamidyaśaḥ || 6 || girvaṇaḥ | pāhi | naḥ | sutam | madhoḥ | dhārābhiḥ | ājyase | indra | tvā'dātam | it | yaśaḥ || 6 ||
tathā ca yāskaḥ— 'girvaṇā devo bhavati gīrbhirenaṃ vanayanti' (niru. 6. 14) iti |
tādṛśendra naḥ asmadīyaṃ sutama abhiputamamiṃ somaṃ pāhi piba |
yataḥ madhoḥ madakarasya somasya dhārābhiḥ ājyase sicyase he indra tvādātam tvayā śodhitaṃ viśadīkṛtameva yaśaḥ annamasmāsu bhavati ||
'dādhā ghvadāp' ityatra adāp iti pratiṣedhena ghusaṃjñayā abhāvāt 'do daddoḥ' iti dadādeśo na_bhavati |
abhi yumnāni vunina indraṃ sacante akṣitā | pītvī somasya vāvṛdhe ||7|| abhi | yumnāni | vuninaḥ | indram | sacante | akṣitā | pītvī | somasya | vāvṛdhe || 7 ||
tasya devān saṃbhajamānasya yajamānasya yumnāni dyotamānāni akṣitā kṣayarahitāni saṃpūrṇāni somādīni havīṃṣi indram abhi abhitaḥ sacante samavayanti |
teṣu madhye somasya pītvī somaṃ pītvā vāvṛdhe sa indro vardhate ||
1. kha-ga-ca-ṇa-na-bha-sa- 'svabhūtān' nāsti | 2. kha-ga-ca-ja-ṇa-na-bha-sa- 'eṇyaḥ iti' nāsti | 3. pha-kṣeḥ | 4. ta-ataḥ | 5. ja-dhātoḥ deve'thaṃ | 6. kha-ga-ca-ta-na-pha-bha- 'vanī' nāsti |

‘ ata iniṭhanau ’ itinipratyayaḥ | tasya svaraḥ | sacante | ‘ paca samavāye ’ ityasya’ laṭi rūpam | akṣitā | ‘ kṣi kṣaye ’ ityasya niṣṭhā | atra ṇyadarthaḥ2 iti dīrghābhāvaḥ | tasmādeva ‘ kṣiyo dīrghāt ’ iti niṣṭhānatvābhāvaḥ3 | nañā samāse tasya svaraḥ | pīśvī | ‘ pā pāne ’ ityasmāt kaśvāpratyayasya ‘ snādhyādayaśca ’ iti nipātāt strī ityādeśaḥ | pratyayasvaraḥ | ‘ ghumāsthāgāpā4 ’ ityādinā ītvam ||
arvāvatau na ā gahi parāvataśca vṛtrahan |
arvāvataḥ | naḥ | ā | gahi | parāvataḥ | ca | vṛtra'han | imāḥ | juṣasva | naḥ | giraḥ ||8||
he vṛtrahan indra arvāvataḥ arvācīnāt samīpādeśāt5 parāvataḥ atidūrādeśāt vā naḥ asmānabhilakṣya ā gahi āgaccha |
āgatya ca naḥ asmadīyāḥ imāḥ ṛtilakṣaṇaḥ giraḥ vācaḥ juṣasva sevasva ||
yat | antarā | parā'vatam | arvā'vatam | ca | hūyasai | indra | iha | tat | ā | gahi ||9||
he indra yat yasmin parāvatam ativiprakṛṣṭasya deśasya arvāvataṃ atisaṃnikṛṣṭasya6 deśasya ca antarā tayormadhyadeśe hūyase samyagjyase tataḥ tasmādeśāt iha asmin yajñe ā gahi somapānārthamāgaccha ||
‘ antarā'ntareṇa yukte ’ ( pā. sū. 2. 3. 4 ) iti dvitīyā |
‘ ā tū na indra ’ iti navarcaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sūktaṃ vaiśvāmitraṃ gāyatramaindram |
atirātre dvitīye paryāye brāhmaṇācchaṃsiśastre etadādike dve sūkte |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ ā tū na indra madhyagiti sūkte ’ ( āśva. śrau. 6. 4 ) iti ||
ā tū na indra mṛdhraguvānaḥ somapītaye |
ā | tu | naḥ | indra | mṛdhrak | huvānaḥ | soma'pītaye | hari'bhyām | yāhi | adri'vaḥ ||1||
adrivaḥ7 vajrin8 he indra huvānaḥ hotṛbhirāhūyamānastvaṃ mṛdhrak madabhimukhaḥ san naḥ asmadīye yajñe somapītaye somapānārthaṃ haribhyām aśvābhyāṃ saha tu kṣipram ā yāhi |
‘ viśvadevayodhaśca ṭeradyañjātāvapratyaye ’ iti ṭeḥ adri ityādeśaḥ |

1. ja-ṇa-ityasmāt | 2. kha-ga-aṇyadarthe | 3. ja-ṇa-niṣṭhātasya natvābhāvaḥ | 4. kha-ga-ca- ja-ṇa-pa-pha-bha-sa-samīpadeśāt | 5. gha-ja-ṇa-sa-atidūradeśāt | 6. ca-na-sa-saṃnikṛṣṭasya | 7. kha-ga- ca-na-pha-bha-la-sa-he adrivaḥ he vajrin |

iti vacanāt adyādeśaḥ antodāttaḥ | yaṇādeśe kṛte ‘ udāttasvaritayoryaṇaḥ ’ iti yaṇaḥ svaritatvam | ‘ krinpratyayasya kuḥ ’ iti kutvam | somapītaye | dāsībhārādiṣvān pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | adrivaḥ | ‘ matuvasoḥ ’ iti rutvam | āmantritatvātnighātaḥ ||
sattaḥ | hotā | naḥ | ṛtviyaḥ | tittire | bahi̭ḥ | ānupak | ayṷjan | prātaḥ | adrayaḥ ||2||
he indra ٧naḥ asmadīye yajñe ٧hotā ṛtvik tavāhnānārtham ٧ṛtviyaḥ prāptakālaḥ san ٧sattaḥ nipaṇṇo vartate |
tathā ٧bahi̭rānupak anupaktaṃ parasparasaṃbaddhaṃ yathā bhavati tathā ٧tittire haviḥvāsaneṣu stīrṇamabhūt |
tathā ٧prātaḥ prātaḥsavane somābhipavārtham ٧adrayaḥ grāvāṇaḥ ٧ayṷjan parasparaṃ saṃgatā abhūvan |
pallu viśaraṇādiṣu ’ ityasmān ‘ gatyarthakarmakaślip ’ ( pā. sū. 3. 4. 72 ) ityādinā kartari ktaḥ |
‘ siti ’ iti padasaṃjñāyām ‘ orguṇaḥ ’ iti bhasaṃjñādhīno guṇo na bhavati |
‘ stṛñ ācchādane ’ ihasya karmaṇi liṭi ‘ ṛta iddhātoḥ ’ itītvam |
dvivacane ‘ śarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ ’ iti takārasya śeṣaḥ |
‘ yujir yoge ’ ityasya luḍi caleḥ ‘ irito vā ’ ityaḍādeśaḥ |
imā brahma̭ brahmavāhaḥ kriyanta ā bahi̭ḥ sīda |
imā | brahma̭ | brahma'vāhaḥ | kriyantai | ā | bahi̭ḥ | sīda | vīhi | śūra | puroḻāśam ||3||
٧brahmāṇi ٧stotrāṇi stutyatayā vahatīti brahmavāhā brahmaṇā stotreṇa prāpyate iti vā |
he stutya ٧indra tubhyam ٧imā imāni ٧brahma brahmāṇi stotrāṇi asmābhiḥ ٧kriyante |
he ٧śūra samarthendra asmābhīyamānamimaṃ ٧puroḻāśaṃ puroḻāśākhyaṃ haviḥ ٧vīhi bhakṣaya ||
‘ dāśva dāne ’ ityasmāt puraḥpūrvāt ‘ mantre śvetavokthaśapuroḻāśo ṇvin ’ ( pā. sū. 3. 2. 71 ) |
rarandhi sarvaneṣu ṇa eṣu stomeṣu vṛtrahan | uktheṣvindra girvaṇaḥ || 4 || rarandhi | sarvaneṣu | naḥ | eṣu | stomeṣu | vṛtra'han | uktheṣu | indra | girvaṇaḥ || 4 ||
he girvaṇaḥ gīrbhiḥ stutibhirvandanīya vṛtrahan vṛtrasya hanter indra naḥ asmākaṃ sambandhiṣu triṣu savaneṣu eṣu kriyamāṇeṣu stomeṣu stotreṣu uktheṣu śastreṣu ca rarandhi ramasva ||
naso nakārasya 'naśca dhātusthorupabhyaḥ' iti saṃhitāyāṃ ṇatvam ||
matayaḥ somapāmuruṃ rihanti śarvasaspatim | indraṃ vansaṃ na mātaraḥ || 5 || matayaḥ | soma'pām | urum | rihanti | śarvasaḥ | patim | indram | vatsam | na | mātaraḥ ||5||
he indra matayaḥ asmābhiḥ kriyamāṇāḥ stutayaḥ uruṃ mahāntaṃ somapāṃ somasya pātāraṃ śavasaḥ balasya patim indraṃ tvāṃ rihanti lihanti |
yathā vatsaṃ mātaraḥ dhenavo lihanti tadvat ||
'mana jñāne' ityasmāt karmaṇi 'mantra vṛpa' ityādinā ktin udāttaḥ |
'ūrṇuñ ācchādane' ityasmānmahyarthe gamyamāne 'mahati hmaśca' (u. sū. 1. 32) iti kupratyayo dhātorhrasvaḥ |
sa mandasvā hyandhaso rādhase tanvā mahe | na stotāraṃ nide karaḥ || 6 || saḥ | mandasva | hi | andhasaḥ | rādhase | tanvā | mahe | na | stotāram | nide | karaḥ ||6||
he indra saḥ tathāvidhastvaṃ mahe mahate rādhase dhanāya andhasaḥ asmābhirdīyamānasya somasya pānena tanvā śarīreṇa saha mandasva hṛṣṭo bhava |
kiṃca tvaṃ stotāraṃ māṃ nide nindāyai viṣayabhūtaṃ na karaḥ mā kārṣīḥ ||
1. kha-ga-ca-na-bha-sa- 'triṣu' nāsti | 2. kha-ga-ca-na-bha-sa- 'śastreṣu' nāsti | 3. kha-ga-ca-ta-bha-sa-rarandhi | 4. kha-ga-ja-ṇa-ta-na-cet | kra. 2-50
va॒yāmi̭ndra tvā॒yavaṷ ha॒viṣma̭nto jarāmahe | u॒ta tva̭ma॒smayṷrva॒so || 7 || va॒yam | i॒ndra | tvā॒'yava̭: | ha॒viṣma̭ntaḥ | ja॒rā॒ma॒he | u॒ta | tvam | a॒smayṷ: | va॒so iti̭ ||7||
he indra tvāyavaḥ yajñārthaṃ tvāmātmānaṃ icchantaḥ tvākāmāḥ santaḥ haviṣmantaḥ saṃbhṛta- haviṣkāḥ vayaṃ jarāmahe tvāṃ stumaḥ |
he vaso rurvasya vāsaka indra uta tvam api asmayuḥ haviḥsvīkaraṇārtham asmānātmānaṃ icchan bhava ||
tvayava iti prāptau ' yuṣmadasmadoranādeśe ' ityavibhaktyapi halādau vyatyayenātvam |
' tasau matvarthe ' iti bhasaṃjñāyāṃ sakārasya ratvābhāvaḥ |
' svaravidhau vyañjanama- vidyamānavat ' iti paribhāṣānāśrayaṇāt matupa udāttatābhāvaḥ |
māre a॒smadvi mṷmu॒co ha̭ripriyā॒rvāṅ yā̭hi | i॒ndra sva॒dhāvo̭ ma॒tsvaiha || 8 || mā | ā॒re | a॒smat | vi | mu॒mu॒caḥ | ha॒ri'pri॒ya | a॒rvāṅ | yā॒hi | i॒ndra | sva॒dhāvaḥ | ma॒tsva | i॒ha || 8 ||
he haripriya harī aśvau priyau yasya tādṛśa he indra asmat arusaḥ āre dūre sthe ye ji- tāvaśvau mā vi mumucaḥ mā vimocaya |
tārthādupeta eva arvāṅ asmadābhimukhyena yāhi āgaccha |
he svadhāvaḥ somalakṣaṇasvavan indra iha asmin devayajane makhaṃ somaṃ pītvā hṛṣṭo bhava ||
asmacchabdasya pañcamībahuvacanasya ' pañcamyā ata ' ( pā. sū. 7. 1. 31 ) ityādeśaḥ |
' muc mokṣaṇe ' ityasya pyantasya chāndase luṅi vahi rūpam |
madi stutyādiṣu ityasya loṭi ' bahulaṃ chandasi ' iti vikaraṇasya luk |

a॒rvāñca̭ tvā su॒khe rathḙ va॒hatā̭mindra ke॒śinā̭ | ghṛ॒tasnū ba॒rhirā॒sadḙ || 9 || a॒rvāñca̭m | tvā | su॒khe | rathḙ | va॒hatā̭m | i॒ndra | ke॒śinā̭ | ghṛ॒tasnū iti̭ ghṛ॒ta'snū | ba॒rhiḥ | ā॒sadḙ || 9 ||
āgatya iha asmin yajñe svadhāvaḥ he svadhāvan indra matsva mandasva |

he ᵥindra ᵥghṛtasnū śramajanitajalaprasravaṇayuktau ᵥkeśinā keśinau skandhapradeśe lasamānakeśa- yuktau harī ᵥāsade āsadanīyaṃ ᵥbarhiḥ abhilakṣya ᵥsukhe sukhakare ᵥrathe ᵥarvāñcam asmadabhimukhaṃ ᵥtvā tvāṃ ᵥvahatām |
‘upa naḥ sutam’ iti navacaṃ caturthaṃ sūktaṃ vaiśāmitraṃ gāyatramaindram |
upa naḥ sutamā gahi somamindra gavāśiram |
upa | naḥ | sutam | ā | gahi | somam | indra | go'āśiram | hari'bhyām | yaḥ | te | asmayuḥ || 1 ||
he ᵥindra ᵥnaḥ asmadīyaṃ ᵥsutam abhiputaṃ ᵥgavāśiraṃ payasā miśritaṃ ᵥsomaṃ prati ᵥupa ᵥā ᵥgahi samīpa āgaccha |
yataḥ ᵥharibhyām aśvābhyāṃ yuktaḥ ᵥte tava ᵥrathaḥ ᵥasmayuḥ asmān kāmayamāno vartate |
āṅpūrvasya śrīṇāteḥ kipi ‘apaspṛdhamānācca’ (pā. sū. 6. 1. 36) ityādinā śira ityādeśaḥ |
tamindra madamā gahi barhiḥṣṭhāṃ grāvabhiḥ sutam |
tam | indra | madam | ā | gahi | barhiḥ'sthām | grāvabhiḥ | sutam | kuvit | nu | asya | tṛṣṇavaḥ || 2 ||

he ᵥindra ᵥgrāvabhiḥ ᵥsutam abhiputaṃ ᵥbarhiḥṣṭhāṃ barhiṣi sthitaṃ ᵥmadam | mādyate aneneti madaḥ somaḥ | ᵥtam imaṃ ᵥsomam ᵥā ᵥgahi āgaccha | ᵥkuvit prabhūtaṃ yathā bhavati tathā ᵥasya somasya pānena ᵥnu kṣipraṃ ᵥtṛṣṇavaḥ tṛpto bhava || madam | ‘madī harṣe’ | ‘mado'nupasarge’ ityappratyayaḥ | tasya pittvādanudāttatve dhātusvaraḥ | barhiḥṣṭhām | ‘ṣṭhā gatinivṛttau’ | kvip | saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvapada- sakārasya ‘ādeśapratyayayoḥ’ iti ṣatvam | ṣutvam | kṛduttarapadasvaraḥ | | tṛṣṇavaḥ | ‘tṛpa prīṇane’ ityasya levyaḍāgamaḥ | kuvityogādanighātaḥ | kṣubhādiṣu ‘nṛmana tṛṇoti’ iti paṭhitam | tathāpi sarvavidhīnāṃ chandasi vikalpitatvādatra ṇatvapratiṣedho na bhavati | pratyayasvaraḥ ||
indram | itthā | giraḥ | mama | accha | aguriṣitāḥ | itaḥ | ā'vṛte | soma'pītaye || 3 ||
1. la-āsādanīyam | 2. na-la-sa-tava; pa-yaḥ te tava | 3. na-la-sa-madyate | 4. kha-ga-ja-ṇa-bha- somamimam; gha-taṃ madaṃ somam; la-sa-somamimaṃ somam | 5. na-sa-pāne | 6. ca-yadyapi kṣubhādiṣu |
he indra ᐞipitāḥ ᐞtvadarthaṃ preritāḥ ᐞitthā itthamena prakāreṇa ucyamānāḥ ᐞmama ᐞgiraḥ stuti- lakṣaṇā vācaḥ ᐞindraṃ tvām ᐞitaḥ asmādevajanadeśāt ᐞacchāguḥ ābhimukhyena gacchantu |
idaśabdāt ‘thā hetau ca chandasi’ iti vyatyayena thāpratyayaḥ |
indraṃ somasya pītaye stomairiha havāmahe | ukthebhiḥ kuvidāgamat || 4 || indram | somasya | pītaye | stomaiḥ | iha | havāmahe | ukthebhiḥ | kuvit | ā'gamat ||4||
ᐞstomaḥ trivṛtpañcadaśādistomasādhyaiḥ stotraiḥ ᐞuvathebhiḥ uvathaiḥ ihaśca ᐞiha karmaṇi ᐞsomasya ᐞpītaye somapānārtham ᐞindraṃ ᐞhavāmahe vayamāhvayāmaḥ |
ᐞkuvit bahuvāramāhūtaḥ sa indraḥ ᐞāgamat yajñaṃ pratyāgacchatu |
indra somāḥ sutā ime tāndadhiṣva śatakrato | jaṭharai vājinīvaso || 5 || indra | somāḥ | sutāḥ | ime | tān | dadhiṣva | śatakrato iti śata'krato | jaṭharai | vājinīvaso iti vājinī'vaso || 5 ||

he ᐞśatakrato ᐞindra ᐞime ᐞsomāḥ ᐞsutāḥ prāvabhisrvadarthamabhiputāḥ | he ᐞvājinīvaso annadhanaᐞ | yadvā | vājo'nnamāsu phalatvenāstīti vājinyaḥ kriyāḥ | tāsāṃ2 vāsaka he indra ᐞtān somasān ᐞjaṭhare ᐞdadhiṣva dhāraya || vājinīvaso | vājaśabdāt matvarthe ‘ata iniṭhanau’ iti inipratyayaḥ | ‘ṛṣebhyo dīp’ iti dīp | tāsāṃ vaso | ‘saṃbuddhau ca’ iti guṇaḥ | āmantritatvādādya- mikamanudāttatvam || || 5 ||
vigrā hi tvā dhanaṃjayaṃ vājeṣu dadhṛṣaṃ kave | ardhā te subhramīmahe || 6 || vigrā | hi | tvā | dhana'jayam | vājeṣu | dadhṛṣam | kave | ardhā | te | subhram | īmahe ||6||
he ᐞkave krāntadarśiścindra ᐞvājeṣu yuddheṣu ᐞdadhṛṣaṃ śatrūṇāmabhibhavitāram ata eva ᐞdhanaṃjayaṃ |
tādṛśaṃ ᐞtvā tvāṃ ᐞvigrā ᐞhi jānīmaḥ khalu |
ᐞadha anantaraṃ ᐞte tava ᐞsubhraṃ dhanam ᐞīmahe yācāāmahe |
tridelaṃṭi ‘vido laṭo vā’ iti maso mādeśaḥ |
1. kha-ga-ca-ja-ṇa-pha-bha-indraṃ tvām | 2. ca-senādhana | 3. kha-ga-ca-ja-ṇa-vaso | 4. ja- anighātaḥ | dyota'tistaṅaḥ iti dīrghaḥ | 5. ja-ṇa-dhanaśabde |
tadantāt pacādyaci 'yaho'ci ca' iti yaḍo luk |
laghūpadhaguṇe prāpte 'na dhātulope' iti tasya pratiṣedhaḥ |
imamindra gavāśiraṃ yavāśiraṃ ca naḥ piba |
imam | indra | go'āśiram | yava'āśiram | ca | naḥ | piba | ā'gatya | vṛṣabhaḥ | sutam || 7 ||
he indra gavāśiraṃ gavyamiśraṇopetaṃ tathā yavāśiraṃ yavamiśraṇopetaṃ vṛṣabhaḥ prāvabhiḥ sutam abhiputaṃ naḥ asmadīyam imaṃ somaṃ devayajanam āgatya piba ||
gavāśiraṃ yavāśiramityatra āṅpūrvasya śrīṇāteḥ kipi 'apaspṛdheyāmānucuḥ' iyādināśira ityādeśaḥ |

ā | na̭ḥ | tu॒jam | ra॒yim | bha॒ra | a॒ṃśam | na | prati̭'jānate | vṛ॒kṣam | pa॒kvam | pha॒lam | aṅgī̭'iva | dhunṷhi | indra̭ | sa॒m'pāra̭ṇam | vasṷ || 4 ||
he indra naḥ asmākaṃ tujaṃ śatrūṇāṃ bādhakaṃ rayiṃ dhanenopalakṣitaṃ putram ā bhara saṃpādaya |
yathā pitā pratijānate vyavahārajñāya putrāya svakīyasya dhanasya bhāgaṃ dadāti tadvat |
kiṃca pakva phalaṃ prati vṛkṣam aṅgīva aṅkuśī yathā dhunoti tathā tvaṃ saṃpāraṇaṃ asmadi- cchāyāḥ samyak pūrakaṃ vasu dhanaṃ dhunuhi cālaya |
' pṛ pālanapūraṇayoḥ ' ityasya ṇyantasya karaṇe lyuṭ |
sa vā̭vṛ॒dhāna oja̭sā puru॒ṣṭu bha̭vā naḥ su॒śrava̭stamaḥ ||
sva॒yuḥ | indra̭ | sva॒'rāṭ | a॒si | sma॒t'iṣṭi̭ḥ | sva॒yaṃśa̭sta॒raḥ | saḥ | va॒vṛ॒dhāna̭ḥ | oja̭sā | purṷ'stuta | bhava̭ | naḥ | su॒śrava̭ḥ'tamaḥ || 5 ||

he indra svayuḥ dhanavānasi | tathā svarāṭ svargasya rājā asi | smadiṣṭiḥ bhadravācyaḥ svayaṃśastaraḥ atiśayena prabhūtakīrtirasa | he puruṣṭuta bahubhirāhatendra saḥ tvam ojasā balena vāvṛdhānaḥ vardhamānaḥ san naḥ asmadarthaṃ suśravastamaḥ atiśayena śobhanānnopetaḥ bhava || svayuḥ | svaśabdāt matvarthīyo yuḥ | svarāṭ | ' rāja dīptau ' | kip | vastrādinā ṣatvam | smadiṣṭiḥ | smat sumadityarthe | ukāralopaścāndasaḥ | bahuvrīhau pūrvapadasvaraḥ | puruṣṭuta | saṃhitāyāṃ ' statastomayośchandasi ' iti ṣatvam | bhava | bhavaterloṭi rūpam | ' dvyaco'tastiṅaḥ ' iti saṃhitāyāṃ dīrghaḥ | suśravastamaḥ | śravaḥśabdaḥ subantaḥ | bahuvrīhau ' ādyudāttaṃ dvyacaśchandasi ' ityuttarapadādyudāttatvam | tadantādatiśayene tamap | tasya pittvādanvāttatve bahuvrīhisvaraḥ || 5 ||
' yudhamasya te ' iti pañcacamaṣṭamaṃ sūktaṃ vaiśvāmitramaindram |
daśarātre caturthe'hani niṣkevalye ' yudhamasya te ' iti sūktaṃ nividvānam |
sutritaṃ ca—' kuha śruta indro yudhamasya ta iti niṣkevalyam ' ( ādha. śrau. 7.11 ) iti |
ṛṣabhanāmni ekāhe'pi niṣkevalya idaṃ sūktaṃ nividvānam |
sūtritaṃ ca—' yudhamasya ta iti madhyaṃdinaḥ ' ( ādha. śrau. 9. 7 ) iti ||
1. ca-pha-dhanarūpayaśasvān sa pūrvoktaḥ ojasā balena vāvṛdhānaḥ punaḥpunarvardhanaśīlaḥ puruṣṭuta bahubhiḥ stuta no'smākam |

yudhmasya te vṛṣabhasya svarāja ugrasya yūnaḥ sthavirasya ghṛṣvaiḥ | ajūryato vajriṇo vīryāṇindra śrutasya mahato mahāni || 1 || yudhmasya | te | vṛṣabhasya | svarājaḥ | ugrasya | yūnaḥ | sthavirasya | ghṛṣvaiḥ | ajūryataḥ | vajriṇaḥ | vīryāṇi | indra | śrutasya | mahataḥ | mahāni || 1 || he indra yudhmasya yodhanaśīlasya vṛṣabhasya abhimataphalasecakasya svarājaḥ dhanādhipateḥ ugrasya samarthasya yūnaḥ niyataharaṇasya sthavirasya ciraṃtanasya ghṛṣvaiḥ śatrūṇāṃ saṃgharṣakasya ajaryataḥ jarārahitasya vajriṇaḥ śrutasya triṣu lokeṣu prasiddhasya ata eva mahataḥ te tava vīryāṇi mahāni mahānti khalu || yudhmasya | 'yudha saṃprahāre' | 'iṣuyudhīndhidasi' ityādinā mapratyayaḥ | yūnaḥ | yauteḥ 'kaninyuvṛṣi' ityādinā kanina | 'śruvamaghonāmatadvite' iti saṃprasāraṇam | nisvaraḥ | sthavirasya | 'ajiraśiśaraśithila' ityādinā kiranpratyayānto nipātitaḥ | ghṛṣvaiḥ | 'ghṛṣu saṃgharṣe' | 'kṛvigṛdhivacchavi' ityādinā kinpratyayānto nipātyate | niccādāyudāttaḥ ||

mahā~ asi mahiṣa vṛṣṇyaibhirdhanuspṛgu sahamāno anyān | eko viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā sa yodharyā ca kṣayaryā ca janān || 2 || mahān | asi | mahiṣa | vṛṣṇyaibhiḥ | dhanuspṛt | ugra | sahamānaḥ | anyān | ekaḥ | viśvasya | bhuvanasya | rājā | saḥ | yodharyā | ca | kṣayaryā | ca | janān || 2 || he mahiṣa mahanīya 'ugra indra tvaṃ mahānasi | 'dhanuspṛt dhanāni dānabhogatyāgaiḥ pāraṃ nayastvaṃ vṛṣṇyebhiḥ vīryaiḥ 'anyān śatrūn 'sahamānaḥ abhibhavan vartase | tathā 'viśvasya sarvasya 'bhuvanasya 'ekaḥ asahāyaḥ 'rājā 'saḥ tvaṃ 'yodharyā 'ca sapatnān prahara | 'janān 'kṣayaryā 'ca nivāsaya | bādhakān hatvā sādhujanān svasthāne sthāpayetyabhiprāyaḥ || mahiṣa | 'maha pūjāyām' | 'avimahoṣṭiṣva' (u. sū. 1. 45) iti ṭipapratyayaḥ | āmantritatvātnighātaḥ | vṛṣṇyebhiḥ | vṛṣṇi bhavāni | 'bhave chandasi' iti yat | 'yato'nāva' ityādināyudāttaḥ | yodharyā | 'yudha saṃprahāre' ityasya ṇyantasya loṭi rūpam | 'cādiṣu ca' iti na nighātaḥ | nisvaraḥ | kṣayaryā | 'kṣi nivāsagatyoḥ' ityasya ṇyantasya loṭi rūpam | atrāpi pūrvavadanighātaḥ ||

pra mātrābhī ririce rocamānaḥ pra devebhirviśvato apratītaḥ | pra majmanā diva indraḥ pṛthivyāḥ prorurmaho antarikṣādajīpī || 3 || pra | mātrābhīḥ | ririce | rocamānaḥ | pra | devebhiḥ | viśvataḥ | apratītaḥ | pra | majmanā | divaḥ | indraḥ | pṛthivyāḥ | pra | uroḥ | mahaḥ | antarikṣāt | ṛjīpī || 3 ||
vapratīta: etāvatasya sāmarthyamityaparicchidyamānaḥ vṛjīpī somavān vindraḥ vmātrābhiḥ|
majyati śatrūn duḥkhasāgare iti majna balam|
tathā vdivaḥ vpṛthivyāḥ dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ ca2 vpra ririce|
tathā vuroḥ vistīrṇāt vmahaḥ mahataḥ vantarikṣāt api vpra ririce||
' māṅ māne śabde ca ' ityasmāt ' huyāmāśubhasibhyastṛn ' iti granpratyayaḥ|
' dvalope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ' iti saṃhitāyāṃ dīrghaḥ|

uruṃ gaṃbhīraṃ januṣābhyugraṃ viśvavyacasamavataṃ matīnām| indraṃ somāsaḥ pradivi sutāsaḥ samudraṃ na sravata ā viśanti || 4 || urum | gaṃbhīram | januṣā | abhi | ugram | viśvavyacasam | avatam | matīnām | indram | somāsaḥ | pradivi | sutāsaḥ | samudram | na | sravataḥ | ā | viśanti || 4 ||
vuruṃ mahāntam ata eva vgaṃbhīraṃ mahākāśaṃ vjanuṣā janmanā svabhāvata eva vugraṃ śatrūṇāṃ bhayaṃkaram|
vviśvavyacasaṃ viśvavyāsaṃ vmatīnāṃ stutīnāṃ stotṛṇāṃ vā vavataṃ rakṣakaṃ tādṛśam vindraṃ vpradivi pūrvairvahaḥsu vsutāsaḥ grāvabhirabhipūtāḥ vsomāsaḥ somāḥ vabhi ābhimukhyena vā vviśanti|
yathā vsravataḥ sravantyo nadyaḥ samudram āviśanti tadvat||
' vyaceḥ kuṭādivamanasīti vaktavyam ' ityatra ' anasi ' iti paryudāsāt ḍittvābhāvaḥ|

yaṃ sormamindra pṛthivīdyāvā garbhaṃ na mātā bibhṛtastavāyā| taṃ tai hinvanti tamu te mṛjantyadhvaryavo vṛṣabhaṃ pātuvā u || 5 || yam | somam | indra | pṛthivīdyāvā | garbham | na | mātā | bibhṛtaḥ | khā''yā | tam | te | hinvanti | tam | ū~ iti | te | mṛjanti | adhvaryavaḥ | vṛṣabham | pātuvai | ū~ iti ||5||
he vindra vpṛthivīdyāvā dyāvāpṛthivyau vtvāyā svakāminayā vtaṃ vsomaṃ vbibhṛtaḥ antardhārayata|

varṣaka he indra ᵥadhvaryavaḥ adhvaraṃ yajamānāyecchantaḥ ᵥte svadatha ᵥtaṃ somaṃ ᵥhinvanti prerayanti | kiṃca ᵥte tava ᵥpātavai pānāya ᵥtaṃ somaṃ ᵥmṛjanti śodhayanti | ᵥu prasiddhau | pṛthivīdyāvā | ‘ divo dyāvā ’ iti dyāvādeśaḥ | āyudāttaḥ | ‘ nottarapade'nudāttādāvapṛthivīrudrapūṣamanthiṣu ’ ityatra paryudāsāt ‘ devatādvandve ca ’ ityubhayapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ | kṛtasamāsasya viparyāschāndasaḥ | | bibhrataḥ | | ‘ dubhran dhāraṇapoṣaṇayoḥ ’ ityasmālluṭi ‘ bhṛjāmin ’ ityabhyāsasyetvam | yadvattayogādanighātaḥ | ajādipratyayaparatvābhāvātra ‘ abhyastānāmādiḥ ’ iti svaro na bhavati | pratyayasvaraḥ | | tvāyā | tvāmicchatītyarthe ‘ supa ātmanaḥ kyac ’ | pūrvapadadakārasyākāraśchāndasaḥ | | a pratyayāt ’ iti bhāve'pratyayaḥ | | ‘ supāṃ suluk ’ iti tṛtīyāyāḥ savarṇadīrghaḥ | ekādeśasvaraḥ | | adhvaryavaḥ | adhvara- micchantaḥ | supaḥ kyac | | kyadhvarapṛtanasyarci lopaḥ ’ ityakāralopaḥ | | kyācchandasi ’ ityupapratyayaḥ | pratyayasvaraḥ | | pātavai | | pā pāne ’ | tumarthe ’ tavaipratyayaḥ | | antaśca tavai yugapat ’ iti dhātvantasya pratyayasya codāttatvam | | ujaḥ ’ iti pragṛhyasaṃjñā || || 10 ||
‘ marutvān ’ iti pañcamaṃ navamaṃ sūktaṃ vaiśvāmitraṃ traiṣṭubhamaindram |
daśarātre caturthe'hani marutvatīyaśastre etat sūktaṃ ‘ nividdhānīyam ’ |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ śrudhī havamindra marutvān ’ indrati marutvatīyam ’ ( āśva. śrau. 7. 11 ) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ maruvā~ indra yudhamasya ta iti madhyaṃdinaḥ ’ ( āśva. śrau. 9. 7 ) iti ||
maruvā~ indra vṛṣabho raṇāya pibā somaṃmanuṣvādhaṃ madāya |
ā siñcasva jaṭhare madhva ūrmiṃ tvaṃ rājāsi pradivaḥ sutānām ||
marutvān | indra | vṛṣabhaḥ | raṇāya | piva | somam | anu'svadham | madāya | ā | siñcasva | jaṭhare | madhvaḥ | ūrmim | tvam | rājā | asi | pradivaḥ | sutānām || 1 ||
he ᵥindra yaḥ ᵥvṛṣabhaḥ apāṃ varṣitā ᵥmarutvān |
sa tvam ᵥanuṣvādhaṃ svadhayā savanīyapuroḍāśādirūpeṇa ᵥagnenānugataṃ ᵥsomaṃ ᵥraṇāya ramaṇīyasaṃgrāmārthaṃ ᵥmadāya taṃ somaṃ ᵥpiba |
kiṃca ᵥmadhvaḥ madakarasya somasya ᵥūrmiṃ saṃghātaṃ bahurasaṃ ᵥjaṭhare |
yataḥ ᵥtvaṃ ᵥpradivaḥ pūrvaivahaḥsu ᵥsutānām abhiṣutānāṃ somānāṃ ᵥrājāsi īśitāsi |
uktamarthaṃ yāsko bravīti—‘ marutvānindra marudbhistadvān vṛṣabho varṣitāpāṃ raṇāya ramaṇīyāya saṃgrāmāya piba somamanuṣvādhamanvannaṃ madāya madanīyāya jaitrāya ( siñcasva jaṭhare madhva ūrmim |
tathā ca ‘ daśame'hani ’ iti khaṇḍe sūtraṃ-marutvānindreti marutvatīyamiti |
padmamārathasya kathā śubhā rāvayasaḥ sanīlā marutvānindra vṛṣabho raṇāyeti sūtritatvāt |

mādhate | idamapītaranmadhvetasmādeva | tvaṃ rājāsi pūrvaivyahaḥ su tānām' (niru. 4. 8) iti || anusvadham | svagrāmanugamya vartamānam | 'atyādayaḥ krāntādyarthe dvitīyā' iti samāsaḥ | saṃhitāyāṃ 'pūrvapadāt' (pā. sū. 8. 3. 106) iti ṣatvam | nirudakāditvādantodāttatvam | ūrmim | 'arterūcca' iti mipratyayaḥ | dhātoḥ ū ityādeśo raparaḥ | pratyayasvaraḥ ||
sūtritaṃ ca— 'sajoṣā indra sagaṇo marudbhi- riti bhakṣayitvaitapātram' (āśva. śrau. 5. 14) iti ||
sajoṣā indra sagaṇo marudbhiḥ somaṃ piba vṛtrahā śūra vidvān |
jahi śatrū~rapa mṛdho nudasvābhayaṃ kṛṇuhi viśvato naḥ ||
sajoṣāḥ | indra | sagaṇaḥ | marudbhiḥ | somam | piba | vṛtrahā | śūra | vidvān | jahi | śatrūn | apa | mṛdhaḥ | nudasva | artha | abhayam | kṛṇuhi | viśvataḥ | naḥ || 2 ||
he 'śūra balavan he 'indra 'sajoṣāḥ saṃgato devaiḥ 'marudbhiḥ 'sagaṇaḥ marudbhireva 'vṛtrahā vṛtrasya hantā 'vidvān karmaviṣayābhijñastvaṃ 'somaṃ 'piba |
uta ṛtubhirṛtupāḥ pāhi somamindraṃ devebhiḥ sakhibhiḥ sutaṃ naḥ |
uta | ṛtubhiḥ | ṛtupāḥ | pāhi | somam | indra | devebhiḥ | sakhibhiḥ | sutam | naḥ | yān | ā | abhajaḥ | marutaḥ | ye | tvā | anvahana | vṛtram | adadhuḥ | tubhyam | ojaḥ || 3 ||
'uta api ca he 'ṛtupāḥ kālanirvāhakatvā ṛtūnāṃ pātaḥ |
yadvā ṛtubhiḥ 'marudbhiḥ saha somaṃ pibatīti ṛtupāḥ |
tādṛśa he 'indra 'sakhibhiḥ samānakhyānaiḥ 'ṛtubhiḥ marudbhiḥ 'devebhiḥ devaiḥ sahitastvaṃ 'naḥ sambandhinaṃ 'sutam abhiṣutaṃ 'somaṃ 'pāhi piba |
kiṃca 'yān 'mahataḥ 'ābhajaḥ yuddhasahāyārthamevatvā 'ye ca marutaḥ 'tvā tvāṃ yuddhe' svāminam 'anu abhajanta |

1. kha-na-la-sa-aṃterū ca | 2. kha-ga-gha-ca-ja-ṇa-na-pa-pha-la-sa- ' marudbhireva ' nāsti | 3. kha-ga-ca- ja-ṇa-na-sa-saṃgrāmaḥ | 4. kha-ga-ca-ja-ṇa-na-sa-naj samāse | 5. gha-ja-ṇa-ṛtubhiḥ nirvāhakaḥ | 6. ja-savane | 7. gha-ja-ṇa-kiṃca tvam | 8. kha-ga-ja-ṇa-ta-na-yudhi |

hananādirūpaṃ parākramam ᵥadadhuḥ akurvan || abhajaḥ | ‘ bhaja sevāyām ’ ityasya laṅi rūpam | yaddhatta- yogādanighātaḥ | ahan | ‘ hana hiṃsāgatyoḥ ’ ityasya laṅi sipo halḍyādinā lopaḥ | pādāditvāt anighātaḥ | adadhuḥ | dadhāterlaṅi jheḥ ‘ sijabhyasta0 ’ iti jus | vākyabhedādanighātaḥ ||
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ ye tvāhihasye maghavanvadhañjani yājyā ’ ( āśva. śrau. 5. 14 ) iti ||
ye tvāhihasye maghavanvadhañjanye śāmbare harivo ye gaviṣṭhau |
ye tvā nūnamanumadanti viprāḥ pibeṃdra somaṃ sagarṇo marudbhiḥ ||
ye | tvā | ahi'hasye | magha'van | avardhan | ye | śāmbare | hari'vaḥ | ye | go'iṣṭhau | ye | tvā | nūnam | anu'madanti | viprāḥ | piba | indra | somam | sa'gaṇaḥ | marudbhiḥ ||4||
he ᵥmaghavan dhanavan ᵥindra ᵥye marutaḥ ᵥahihasye vṛtrahananarūpe karmaṇi ᵥtvā tvām ᵥavardhan |
‘ prahara bhagavo jahi vīrayasva ’ iti baladānenāvīvṛdhan |
he ᵥharivaḥ aśvavannindra ᵥye ca ᵥśāmbare śambaravadhasaṃbandhini yuddhe tvāmavīvṛdhan |
indraḥ śambaramavadhīdityasminnarthe mantravarṇaḥ—‘ yaḥ śambaraṃ parvateṣu kṣiyantaṃ catvāriṃśyāṃ śaradyanvinadat |
ojāyamānaṃ yo ahiṃ jaghāna ’ ( ṛ. saṃ. 2. 12. 11 ) iti |
tathā ᵥye marutaḥ ᵥgaviṣṭhau paṇināma kairasuraiḥ saha gavārye yuddhe ca tvāmavīvṛdhan |
ᵥviprāḥ medhāvinaḥ ᵥye ca marutaḥ ᵥnūnam idānīṃ tvām ᵥanumadanti mādayanti tādṛśaistaiḥ ᵥmarudbhiḥ ᵥsagaṇaḥ san imaṃ ᵥsomaṃ ᵥpiba ||
‘ vṛdha vṛddhau ’ ityasya vyatyayasya laṅi rūpam |
madi stutyādiṣu ityasya laṭi vyatyayena parasmaipadam |
marutvantam | vṛṣabham | vavṛdhānam | arka'arim | divyam | śāsam | indram | viśva'sāham | arvase | nūtanāya | ugram | sahaḥ'dām | iha | tam | huvema || 5 ||
he indra ᵥmarutvantaṃ marudbhistadantaṃ ᵥvṛṣabhaṃ meghabhedanadvārā apāṃ varṣakaṃ ᵥvavṛdhānaṃ vṛtrahananādikarmasu utsāhena vardhamānam ᵥakavāriṃ prabhūtaśatruṃ² yadvā akutsitārim |

śāsanaṃ hitopadeśāhitaparihārābhyāṃ śāsitāraṃ viśvāsāhaṃ viśvasya pratipakṣasya sarvasyābhibhavitāram ugraṃ śatrupu udvarṇa sahodāṃ yuddhasahakāriṇāṃ marutāṃ balapradaṃ taṃ tādṛśasāmarthyopetam indraṃ nūtanāya navatarāya avase rakṣaṇāya iha karmaṇi huvema tvāmāhayema |
‘ sadyo ha ’ iti pañcadaśaṃ sūktaṃ vaiśvāmitraṃ traiṣṭubhamaindram |
agniṣṭome mādhyandinasavane maitrāvaruṇaśastre ‘ sadyo ha jātaḥ ’ ityetatsūktam |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ sadyo ha jāta evā svāmindraḥ ’ (āśva. śrau. 5. 16) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ sadyo ha jāta ityaharahaḥśasyaṃ maitrāvaruṇaḥ ’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 4) iti |
‘ aharahaḥśasyānīti hotrākā dvitīyādiveva ’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 1) iti sūtritam |
sādyaske ekāhe marutvatīye śastre ‘ sadyo ha jātaḥ ’ ityādyā sūktamukhyā |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ sadyo ha jāto vṛṣabhaḥ kanīnasvaṃ sadyo apibo jāta indra ’ (āśva. śrau. 9. 5) iti |
sadyo ha jāto vṛṣabhaḥ kanīnaḥ prarbhūtamāvṛtandhasaḥ sutasya |
sādhoḥ piba pratikāmaṃ yathā te rasāśiraḥ prathamaṃ somyasya |
sadyaḥ | ha | jātaḥ | vṛṣabhaḥ | kanīnaḥ | pra'bhartum | āvṛta | andhasaḥ | sutasya | sādhoḥ | piba | prati'kāmam | yathā | te | rasa'āśiraḥ | prathamam | somyasya || 1 ||

vṛṣabhaḥ vṛṣṭidvārā apāṃ varṣitā sadyaḥ tadānīmeva jātaḥ utpannaḥ kanīnaḥ kamanīyaḥ indraḥ sutamya abhiputasya andhasaḥ havirlakṣaṇasya annasya somasya prabhartu prakarṣeṇa bhartāraṃ saṃgrahītāraṃ yaja- mānam āvat rakṣatu |

he hota: 'mahāṃ mahāntam 'indraṃ 'śaṃsa śastraiḥ stuhi | 'yasmin indre rakṣitari sati 'viśvāḥ 'kṛṣṭayaḥ sarve manuṣyāḥ 'somapāḥ yajñamanuṣṭhāya somapāḥ santaḥ 'kāmam | kāmyate iti kāmaḥ svargādiḥ | tam 'ā 'avyan sarvataḥ prāpnuvanti | 'dhiṣaṇe devamanuṣyādīnāṃ dhārayitryau | yadvā | pragalbhe samarthe svāśritān rakṣitumiti dhiṣaṇe dyāvāpṛthivyau | 'devāḥ ca 'sukratum | kratuḥ' karme jagatpālanādi | śobhanaḥ kraturyasyāsau sukratuḥ | tādṛśaṃ 'vivvataṣṭaṃ vibhunā brahmaṇā taṣṭaṃ jagadādhipatye sthāpitaṃ mahāntaṃ 'vṛtrāṇāṃ pāparūpāṇāṃ 'ghnaṃ hantāraṃ 'yam indraṃ 'janayanta ajanayan || śaṃsa | 'śansu stutau' ityasya loṭi rūpam | pādāditvādanudāttaḥ | 'aco'tastiṅaḥ ' iti saṃhitāyāṃ dīrghaḥ | avyan | vī' kāntigatyādiṣu' | laṅi rūpam | yadvṛttayogādanighātaḥ | adasvaraḥ | sukratum | 'katvādyaśca' ityuttarapādādyudāttaḥ | dhiṣaṇe | 'dhiṣaṇā prāgalbhye' ityasmāt 'dhredharṣa ca saṃjñāyām' iti kyupratyayaḥ | dhiṣa ityadeśaḥ | pratyayasvaraḥ | ghnam | hanteḥ 'puṃsi saṃjñāyām' iti ghaḥ | 'ho hanteḥ' iti kutvam | pratyayasvaraḥ | janayanta | janayerdhantasya laṅi rūpam | yadvṛttayogādanighātaḥ ||

daśamī poḍaśī ca dve jagatyau trayodaśī gāyatrī dvādaśīviṃśīdrāviṃśayastisro'nuṣṭubho'ṣṭādaśī bṛhatī śiṣṭāstriṣṭubhaḥ |
āghyendrāparvatadevatākā pañcadaśīpoḍaśyau vāgdevatye taduttarāśatamau rathāṅgedevatākāḥ śiṣṭā aindrayaḥ ||

indrāparvatā bṛhatā rathena vāmīriṣa ā vahataṃ suvīrāḥ | vītaṃ havyānyadhvareṣu devā vardhethāṃ gīrbhirīḻayā madantā || 1 || indrāparvatā | bṛhatā | rathena | vāmīḥ | iṣaḥ | ā | vahatam | suvīrāḥ | vītam | havyāni | adhvareṣu | devā | vardhethām | gīrbhiḥ | īḻayā | madantā || 1 ||
he indrāparvatau bṛhatā rathena āgatya vāmīḥ vananīyāḥ suvīrāḥ śobhanaputropetāḥ iṣaḥ annāni ā vahatam asmadarthaṃ dhārayatam |
1. ca-ja-pūpaśabdāt | 2. ja-ṇa-krādiniyamāt | 3. kha-ga-caṃ-ja-ṇa-na-bha-sa- 'prati' nāsti | 4. kha-ga-na-bha-sa-tvām; ca-la-tvā |
kiṃca he devau dyotamānau 'adhvareṣu asmatsambandhiṣu yajñeṣu 'havyāni havanayogyāni puroḍāśādīni havīṃṣi 'vītaṃ bhakṣayatama |
tathā 'iḻayā asmābhirhatena haviṣā 'madantā havyantau yuvāṃ 'gīrbhiḥ stutilakṣaṇāmiḥ 1 asmadīyābhirvāgbhiḥ 'vardhetāṃ samṛddhau bhavatam ||
vī kāntyādiṣu ityasya loṭi adāditvācchapo luk |
‘vṛdha vṛddhau’ ityasya loṭi āthāmo lasāvedhātukasvare dhātusvaraḥ ||
sūtritaṃ ca— ‘tiṣṭhā su kaṃ maghavanmā parāgā ayaṃ yajño devayā ayaṃ miyedhaḥ’ (ādha. śrau. 6. 11 ) iti||
tiṣṭhā su kaṃ maghavanmā parā gāḥ somasya nu tvā surbhūtasya yakṣi |
piturna putraḥ sicamā rebhe ta indra svādiṣṭhayā girā śacīvaḥ ||

he 'maghavan dhanavannindra 'kaṃ sukhenasmin yajñe 'su tiṣṭha suṣṭhu kaṃcitkālamatra tiṣṭha | 'mā 'parā 'gāḥ asmadīyādyajñānmā gaccha | tatra kāraṇamāha | 'subhutasya suṣṭhubhiputena 'somasya somena 'nu kṣipraṃ 'tvā 'tvāṃ 'yakṣi yaje | he 'śacīvaḥ śaktiman 'indra 'te tava 'sicaṃ vastraprāntaṃ 'svādiṣṭhayā svādutarayā stutilakṣaṇayā 'girā 'ā 'rebhe ālabha | gṛhnāmītyarthaḥ | tatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ | 'piturna yathā 'putraḥ madhurayā vācā piturjanakasya celāñcalaṃ 'gṛhṇāti tadvat || su kamiti nipātadvayam | prathamasya ‘nipātā ādyudāttāḥ’ ityādyudāttatvam | dvitīyasya ‘cādayo'nudāttāḥ’ ityanu- dāttatvam | somasya yakṣi | ‘yaja devapūjāsaṃgatikaraṇadāneṣu’ | ‘svaritajitaḥ’ ityātmanepadam | tasya luṅi sici ‘ekācaḥ’ itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ | vrādinā parasmai | ‘paṭhoḥ kaḥ si’ iti katvam | sicaḥ sakārasya ṣatvam | nighātaḥ | rebhe | ‘ḍulabhaṣ prāptau’ | laṭyuttama iṣṭi rūpam | ralayorbhedaḥ | nighātaḥ | svādiṣṭhayā | svāduśabdādiṣṭani rūpam | nivādādyudāttaḥ ||
śaṃsādhvaryo prati me gṛṇīhīndrāya vāhaḥ kṛṇavāva juṣṭam |
edaṃ barhiryajamānasya sīdāthāṃ ca bhūdukathamindrāya śastam ||

'othā modaiva' ityādikaḥ hoturutsāhajananaḥ pratigaraḥ ( āśva. śrau. 7. 11 ) |
tathā 'indrāya juṣṭaṃ prītiyuktaṃ vāhaḥ stotraṃ kṛṇavāva karavāva |
tvaṃ yajamānasya idaṃ barhiḥ asmin barhiṣi ā sīda upaviśa |
atha ca anantaram indrāya indrārthamāvābhyāṃ kriyamāṇam ukthaṃ śastraṃ śastaṃ praśastaṃ bhūt bhavatu ||
jāyedastaṃ maghavantsedu yonistadidhvā yuktā harayo vahantu |

he maghavan dhanavannindra astam | asyante kṣipyante padārthā atretyastaṃ gṛham | jāyate jāyaiva gṛhaṃ bhavati | na gṛhaṃ gṛhamisāhurgṛhiṇī gṛhamucyate iti smṛteḥ | tathā set sā jāyaiva yoniḥ puruṣasya miśraṇasthānam | u prasiddhārthaḥ | tasmāt tadis tatra gṛhe eva yuktāḥ rathe yojitāḥ harayaḥ aśvāḥ tvā tvāṃ vahantu | vayaṃ tu yadā kadā ca tvadarthaṃ somaṃ sunavāma abhiṣutaṃ karavāma tadāsmābhiḥ prahitaḥ dūtaḥ agniḥ tvā tvām accha ābhimukhyena dhanvāti gacchet || astam | asu kṣepaṇe | asihasimṛmṛvāmi0 ityādinā tanpratyayaḥ | niccāt ādyudāttaḥ | sunavāma | buñ abhibhave ityasya loṭi rūpam | yadvṛttayogādanighātaḥ | tvā | yudhmattatakṣuvantaḥpādam iti saṃhitāyāṃ paratvam | dhanvāti | dhavi gatyarthe | leṭāḍāgame rūpam | nighātaḥ ||

parā yāhi maghavannā ca yāhīndra ātarubhayatrā te artham |
yatrā rathasya bṛhataḥ nidhānaṃ vimocanaṃ vājino rāsabhasya ||

he indra somam apāḥ | atraiva sthitvā somaṃ piba | athavā astaṃ gṛhaṃ pra yāhi prakarṣeṇa gaccha | te tava gṛhe kalyāṇīḥ maṅgalakāriṇī jāyā śacī vidyate | suraṇaṃ śobhanagītādi- dhvaniścāsti | yadvā | suraṇaṃ suramaṇīyaṃ yathā bhavati tathā gṛhe jāyā tiṣṭhati | yatra ityyādi gatam | dakṣiṇāvat | atra sthitau satyāṃ rathe yojitānāṃ vājināṃ vimocanaṃ khādanapānādinā dakṣiṇāvat prayo- janavadbhavati | vimuktebhyo vājibhyaḥ khādanaṃ pānaṃ copaharanti || apāḥ | pā pāne | luṅi gātisthā iti sico luk | aḍāgamasvaraḥ | kalyāṇīḥ | kalyāṇamasyāstīti matvarthe chandasīvannipau iti īpratyayaḥ | pratyayasvaraḥ | suraṇam | raṇa śabdārthaḥ | asmādakṛcchrārthe khal | litsvaraḥ | pratyayasya viśvādanu- dāttatve dhātusvaraḥ | samāse kṛduttarapadasvaraḥ ||
ime bhojā aṅgiraso virūpā divasputrāso asurasya vīrāḥ |
viśvāmitrāya dadato maghāni sahasrasāve pra tiranta āyuḥ ||
ime | bhojāḥ | aṅgirasaḥ | virūpāḥ | divaḥ | putrāsaḥ | asurasya | vīrāḥ | viśvāmitrāya | dadataḥ | maghāni | sahasrasāve | pra | tirantaḥ | āyuḥ || 7 ||
he indra ime yāgaṃ kurvāṇāḥ bhojāḥ saudāsāḥ kṣatriyāsteṣāṃ yājakāḥ virūpāḥ nānārūpāḥ medhātithiprabhṛtayaḥ aṅgirasaḥ ca divaḥ asurasya devebhyo'pi balavato rudrasya putrāsaḥ putrāḥ vīrāḥ |
balavanto marutaḥ te sarve ᵥviśvāmitrāya mahaṃ ᵥsahasrasāve |
tasminnaśvamedhe ᵥmaghāni mahanīyāni ᵥdhanāni ᵥdadata: prayacchantaḥ santaḥ ᵥāyu: jīvanamannaṃ vā ᵥpra ᵥtirante prakarṣeṇa vardhayanti ||
divasputrāsa iti saṃhitāyāṃ ‘ ṣaṣṭhyā: patiputra° ’ iti visarjanīyasya satvam |
rūpaṃrūpaṃ maghavā bobhavīti māyā: kṛṇvānastanvaṃ pari svām |

ᵥmāyā: anekarūpagrahaṇasāmarthyopetā: ᵥkṛṇvāna: kurvāṇa: ᵥsvāṃ ᵥtanvaṃ svakīyāṃ tanūm |
tathā ca mantravarṇa:—‘ indro māyābhi: pururūpa: ’ ( ṛ. saṃ. 6.47.18 ) iti |
ᵥṛtāvā satyavān tādṛśa indra: ᵥdiva: svargalokāt ᵥpari ᵥmuhūrtam ekasminneva muhūrte nānādeśavartiṣu yajñeṣu tatrāpi ᵥtri: triṣu savaneṣu ᵥāgāt āgacchati ||

ᵥmahān tapasā atiśayitasāmarthyavān ᵥṛṣi: atīndriyārthadraṣṭā ᵥdevajā: dyotamānānāṃ tejasāṃ janayitā ᵥdevajūta: taistejobhirākṛṣṭa: ᵥnucakṣā: nṛṇāṃ karmanetṛṇāmadhvaryādīnāmupadraṣṭā sa: ᵥviśvā- mitra: ᵥarṇavam udakavantaṃ ᵥsindhuṃ vipādacchudradrayo: saṃbhedam ᵥastaṃbhrāt niruddhavegamakarot |

haṃsāiva kṛṇutha ślokamadribhirmardanto gībhiradhvare sute sacā |
devebhirviprā ṛṣayo nṛcakṣaso vi pibadhvaṃ kuśikāḥ somyaṃ madhu ||

sudāsaḥ paijavanasya rājñaḥ aśvaṃ rāye tasya digvijayana dhanalābhāya pra muñcata |
rājā devānāṃ svāmīndraḥ vṛtraṃ karmavighna- kāriṇamasuraṃ prāgapāgudak pūrvapaścimattareṣu deśeṣu jaṅghanat bhṛśaṃ hatavān |

'rāsu śabde' ityasya laṅi 'bahulaṃ chandasi' iti śapo luk |
kiṃ tai kṛṇvanti kīkaṭeṣu gāvo nāśīraṃ duhe na tarpanti gharmam |
ā no bhara pramagandasya vedoṃ naicāśākhaṃ maghavannandhayā naḥ ||

kriyābhyāṃ dānahomalakṣaṇābhiḥ kiṃ phaliyatītyaśraddadhānāḥ pratyuta pibata khādatāyameva loko na para iti vadanto nāstikāḥ kīkaṭāḥ teṣu |
etena sāṃnāyyādyarthamapi nopayujyante ityapi sūcitaṃ bhavati |
evaṃ kacidapi vaidike karmaṇyanuyuktāstā gāḥ 'naḥ asmabhyam 'ā 'bhara
haigupyādirakṣaṇaparimāṇaṃ gato'rtho māmeva gamiṣyatīti buddhayā pareṣāṃ dadātīti magando vārdhuṣikaḥ |
nīcāsu śūdrayoniṣu utpāditāḥ śākhā putrapautrādiparaṃparā yena sa nīcāśākhaḥ |
eteṣāṃ taddhanaṃ tava nopayujyate asmadāyattaṃ tu taddhanaṃ yāgādidvārā tavopayujyate |
etamarthaṃ yāsko'pyāha—‘kiṃ te kurvanti kīkaṭepu gāvaḥ |
kīkaṭāḥ kiṃkṛtāḥ kiṃ kriyābhiḥ itiprepsāḥ vā |
naiva cāśiraṃ duhe na tapanti gharmaṃ caraṇam |
magandaḥ kusīdī māṃgado māmāgamiṣyatīti ca dadāti |
pramadako vā yo'yamevāsti loko na para iti prepsuḥ |
paṇḍako vā paṇḍakaḥ paṇḍagaḥ prādeko vā prādeyyāṇḍau |
tanno maghavan randhaya iti radhyatirvaśagamane (niru. 6. 32) iti ||
āṅpūrvāt śrīṇāteḥ kripi ‘apastṛdhethām’ ityādinā āśira ityādeśaḥ |
viśvāmitra- syābhibhūtaṃ balaṃ vāk ca samantataḥ |
tasmai brāhmīṃ tu saurīṃ vā nāmnā vācaṃ sasaparīm |
kuśikānāṃ matiḥ sā vāgamati tāmapānudat’ (anu. bhā. 3. 53) ||
ā sūryasya duhitā tatān śravo deveṣvamṛtamajurryam ||

ete 'saṃbughe sabaraḥ svīyasya kṣīrarūparasasya' dogdhyau ata eva 'dhenū jagataḥ prīṇayitavyau te' dyāvāpṛthivyau 'yatra antarikṣe 'samīcī parasparaṃ saṃgate satyau 'dhāpayete svīyaṃ rasamanvanyaṃ pāyayete 'ṛtasya udakasya 'sadasi sthānabhūte tasminnantarikṣe 'antaḥ sthite dyāvāpṛthivyau 'īḻe ahaṃ staumi |
vṛtilakṣaṇaṃ' rasaṃ dyauḥ pṛthivīṃ dhāpayate' āhutilakṣaṇaṃ
rasaṃ dyāṃ¹ pṛthivīti evamanyonyaṃ mātā ca duhitā ca bhavataḥ |
ṛtasya sadasi sthāne yajñasadane sthito'haṃ te ubhe staumi ||
tasminnupapade 'duha prapūraṇe' ityasmāddhātoḥ 'duhaḥ kaśca' iti kapratyayo ghaśāntādeśaḥ |
'dhed pāne' ityasya ṇyantasya laṭi 'nigaraṇacalanārthebhyaśca' iti parasmaipade prāpte 'pādiṣu dheṭa upasaṃkhyānam' ityātmanepadam |
anyasyāṃ vatsaṃ rihatī mimāya kayā bhuvā ni dadhe dhenururdhaḥ |

vanyasyāḥ: pṛthivyāḥ vvatsam agniṃ vrihatī udakadhārārūpayā jihvayā lihatī dyauḥ |
vkayā jalavarjitayā vbhuvā tatratyaṃ jalamādāya svakīyam vūdhaḥ megharūpaṃ vni vdadhe udakena nihitamakarot |
vsā jalavarjitā viḻā pṛthivī vṛtasya satyabhūtasyādityasya vpayasā udakena vapinvata varṣakāle siktā bhavati |
padyā vaste pururūpā vapūṃṣyūrdhvā tasthau tryavi rerihāṇā |
ṛtasya sadha vi carāmi vidvān mahevānāṃsuratvamekam ||

tathā ca mantravarṇaḥ— 'padyāṃ bhūmiḥ' (ṛ. saṃ. 10.90.14) iti |
yadvā pādasaṃcāre sādhuḥ padyā bhūmiḥ vpururūpā nānāvidha- svarūpāṇi vvapūṃṣi sthāvarajaṅgamakāni rūpāṇi vvaste ācchādayati |
saiṣā bhūmiḥ vūrdhvā uttara- vedyāmanonnatā satī svasārabhūtana haviṣā vtryavim |
trīn lokān avati svanatejasā vyāpnotīti vtryaviriti vā |
vṛtasya satyabhūtasyādityasya vsadha sthānaṃ vvidvān jānāno'haṃ vvi vcarāmi havirbhiḥ tamādityaṃ paricarāmi ||

ᵥvṛṣabhaḥ apāṃ varṣakaḥ ᵥyat yaḥ parjanyātmendraḥ ᵥanyāsu dikṣu ᵥroravīti meghadvārā bhṛśaṃ śabdaṃ karoti ᵥsaḥ parjanya indraḥ ᵥanyasmin ᵥyūthe diśāṃ vṛnde ᵥretaḥ udakaṃ ᵥni ᵥdadhāti tatra varṣati |

tathā rātriryāya- yāgānāṃ stotrāṇāṃ bhāgabhūtā yā rātriḥ socyate |
ᵥsaḥ ᵥrājā ᵥhi tattatkarmānurūpaphalapradānena sarveṣāṃ rājā khalu ||

ᵥṣoḻhā māsānāṃ dvandvayogakāle ṣoḍhā dṛśyamānā ṛtavo'śvā nirūpyante |

‘ṣaṣa utvaṃ datadaśāsūtarpadādeḥ ṣutvaṃ ca’ (pā.sū. 6.3. 109. 3-4) ityutvaṃ ṣutvaṃ ca |

mahī samairaccamvā samīcī ubhe te asya vasunā nyṛṣṭe | śruṇe vīro vindamāno vasūni mahaddevānāsuratvamekam || 20 || mahī iti | sam | airat | camvā | samīcī iti sam'īcī | ubhe iti | te iti | asya | vasunā | nyṛṣṭe iti ni'sṛṣṭe | śruṇe | vīra: | vindamāna: | vasūni | mahat | devānām | asura'tvam | ekam || 20 ||

imāṃ ca na: pṛthivīṃ viśvadhāyā upa kṣeti hitamitro na rājā | dura:sada: śarmasado na vīrā mahaddevānāsuratvamekam || 21 || imām | ca | na: | pṛthivīm | viśva'dhāyā: | upa | kṣeti | hita'mitra: | na | rājā | pura:sada: | śarma'sada: | na | vīrā: | mahat | devānām | asura'tvam | ekam || 21 ||
ᵛviśvadhāyāḥ viśvasya dhātā sarvākṣo vā ᵛnaḥ asmākaṃ ᵛrājā indraḥ ᵛimāṃ ᵛpṛthivīm antarikṣa ᵛca ᵛupa tayoḥ samīpe ᵛkṣeti nivasati |
yathā kasyacit hitapadeṣṭā suhṛt samīpe nivasati tadvat |
ᵛvīrāḥ samarthā yuddhasahāyā marutaḥ ᵛpuraḥsadḥ yuddhārthaṃ purato niścayena gantāra indrasya ᵛśarmasado ᵛna |
yatra yatrāsau tatra tatra saṃnidhiṃ kurvāṇā ityarthaḥ ||
‘ kṣi nivāsagatyoḥ ’ ityasya laṭi ‘ bahulaṃ chandasi ’ iti vikaraṇasya luk |

niṣidhvarīsta oṣadhīrutāpau rayiṃ ta indra pṛthivī bibharti | sakhāyaste vāmabhājaḥ syāma mahadevānāmamuratvamekam || 22 || niḥ'sidhvarīḥ | te | oṣadhīḥ | uta | āpaḥ | rayim | te | indra | pṛthivī | bibharti | sakhāyaḥ | te | vāma'bhājaḥ | syāma | mahat | devānām | asura'tvam | ekam || 22 ||
he parjanyātmaka ᵛindra ᵛoṣadhīḥ oṣadhayaḥ ᵛte ᵛniṣidhvarīḥ niṣidhvaryo ᵛnitarāṃ ᵛsvataḥkartṛka- siddhamayaḥ |
ᵛuta api ca ᵛāpaḥ tvatto niḥsṛtāḥ |
ᵛpṛthivī ᵛte tava bhogayogyaṃ ᵛrayiṃ dhanaṃ ᵛbibharti |
‘ puru vasūni pṛthivī bibharti ’ (ṛ. saṃ. 3.51.5) iti hi nigamaḥ |
tataḥ ᵛte tava ᵛsakhāyaḥ haviṣpradānenopakārakāḥ 2 stotāraḥ 3 vayaṃ ᵛvāmabhājaḥ ᵛsyāma sarve vananīyadhanabhāgino bhavema |
‘ vano ra ca ’ iti ṅīp rephaśca |
nisaḥ sakāraṃ chāndasatvādanāhatya ‘ upasargārtsunoti ’ ityādinā patvam |
‘ ḍubhṛñ dhāraṇapoṣaṇayoḥ ’ ityasya laṭi ‘ bhṛñāmit ’ ityabhyāsasyetvam |

yasya niḥśvasitaṃ vedā yo vedebhyo'khilaṃ jagat |
‘na tā minanti’ ityṛcaṃ tṛtīyaṃ viśvāmitrasya vācaḥ |
asmin sūkte prāyeṇādityaiḥ saha saṃvatsaraḥ stūyate ||
na tā minanti māyino na dhīrā vratā devānāṃ prathamā dhruvāṇi |
na rodasī adruhā vedyābhirna parvatā ninamaṃ tasthivāṃsaḥ ||

‘devānām indrādīnāṃ ‘prathamā prathamāni sṛṣṭyanantarabhāvini ‘dhruvāṇi sthirāṇi kenāpi cālayitumaśakyāni ‘tā tāni loke prasiddhāni ‘vratā vratāni loka- pālanādikarmāṇi ‘na ‘minanti na hiṃsanti |

tripājasyo vṛṣabho viśvarūpa uta nyudhā purudha prajāvān| anīkaḥ patyate māhināvāntasa retodhā vṛṣaḥ śaśvatīnām || 3 || tri'pājasyaḥ| vṛṣabhaḥ| viśva'rūpaḥ| uta| tri'udhā| purudha| prajā'vān| tri'anīkaḥ| patyate| māhinā'vān| saḥ| retaḥ'dhāḥ| vṛṣabhaḥ| śaśvatīnām || 3 ||
vtripājasyaḥ: grīṣmavarṣāhimantākhyaistribhirṛtubhiḥ pājasyamuro yasya sa tripājasyaḥ|
'indrasya kroḍo'dityai pājasyam' (vā. saṃ. 25. 8) iti aśvamedhamantre uraḥparatayājñānāt, pājasi bale sādhuriti vyutpatteśca sarveṣāmaṅgānāṃ madhye uraso balavattvāt|
vmāhināvān mahattvavān saṃvatsarābhimānī devaḥ vpatyate āgacchati|
vvṛṣabhaḥ secanasamarthaḥ vsaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ vśaśvatīnāṃ bahvīnām oṣadhīnāṃ puṣpaphalādisaṃpattaye vretodhāḥ retasa udakasya dhartā bhavati|
bahuvrīhau 'udhaso'naṅ' iti anaṅ sarvavidhīnāṃ chandasi vikalpitatvāt puṃsyapi bhavati|

abhīkaṃ āsāṃ padvīrabodhyādityānāṃmahe cāru nāma| āpaścidasmā aramanta devīḥ pṛthagvrajantīḥ pariṃ bhīmavṛkṣan || 4 || abhīke| āsāṃ| padvīḥ| abodhi| ādityānām| ahe| cāru| nāma| āpaḥ| cit| asmai| aramanta| devīḥ| pṛthak| vrajantīḥ| pariṃ| sīm| avṛkṣan ||4||
1. kha-ga-ca-sarve yeṣviti, ṇa-sarvaṃ yairiti | 2. gha-na-bha-la-dve bhūmī | 3. la-vrīhiyavādi- haprajāvān | 4. kha-ga-gha-ṇa-ta-na-bha-sa-garṇarūpetaḥ |
‘meṣādirathe savitari yo yo māsaḥ prapūryate cāndraḥ|
teṣāṃ caitrādīnāṃ māsānāṃ ˅cāru ˅nāma madhuśca mādhavaścetyādi nāmadheyam ˅ahne āhvayāmi|
kiṃca ˅devīḥ dyotanaśīlāḥ ˅pṛthak itastataḥ ˅vrajantīḥ gacchantyaḥ ˅āpaśrita āpo'pi ˅asmai saṃvatsarāya ˅aramanta saṃvatsara- saṃbandhimāsatuṣṭaye vṛddhyadvārā ramante|
trirā divaḥ savitarvīryāṇi divedive ā suva trino ahaḥ |
tridhātu rāya ā suvā vasūni bharga trātardhiṣaṇe sātaye dhāḥ ||
triḥ | ā | divaḥ | savitaḥ | vīryāṇi | divedive | ā | suva | triḥ | naḥ | ahaḥ | tridhātu | rāyaḥ | ā | suva | vasūni | bharga | trātaḥ | dhiṣaṇe | sātaye | dhāḥ || 6 ||
savitaḥ sarvasya preraka he āditya divaḥ dyulokādāgatya tvaṃ vīryāṇi sarvaiḥ saṃbhajanīyāni dhanāni divedive pratidinaṃ triḥ ā suva trivāramasmabhyaṃ preraya prayacchetyarthaḥ |
bhaga sarvairbhajanīya trātaḥ asmākaṃ rakṣaka he āditya tridhātu tridhātūni paśukanakaratnabhedena triprakārāni vasūni dhanāni rāyaḥ |
tāni ca naḥ asmabhyam ahaḥ sambandhiṣu triḥ triṣu savaneṣu ā suva prayaccha |
dhiṣaṇe mādhyamike he vāk sātaye dhana- lābhāya dhāḥ asmān kuru ||
trirā divaḥ savitā sauṣavīti rājānā mitrāvaruṇā supāṇī |
ārṣcidasya rodasī cidurvī ratnaṃ bhikṣanta savituḥ savāya ||
triḥ | ā | divaḥ | savitā | soṣavīti | rājānā | mitrāvaruṇā | supāṇī | iti su'pāṇī | ārṣaḥ | cit | asya | rodasī iti | cit | urvī iti | ratnam | bhikṣanta | savituḥ | savāya || 7 ||
savitā devaḥ divaḥ divastasya triḥ triṣu kāleṣu ā soṣavīti asmabhyaṃ dhanānyāsuvatu |
kiṃca rājānā rājānau supāṇī kalyāṇapāṇī mitrāvaruṇau āpaḥ |
cit api ca urvī vistīrṇe rodasī dyāvā- pṛthivyau etā devatāḥ savituḥ prerakasya asya devasya savāya savena preraṇena ratnam apekṣitamarthaṃ bhikṣanta yācante ||
